milf.quest.aluminum.blank_data_model.des:
<keyword>Hostile Neural Networks</keyword> allows you to train <keyword>data models</keyword> and run <property>simulations</property>, producing <keyword>mob predictions</keyword>, which can be used to generate mob loot.

The fundamental unit of this mod is the <keyword>Data Model</keyword> - an item which holds information about an entity that you can utilize to generate their drops. To get a Data Model, you must first craft a <keyword>Data Model Framework</keyword>, and <positive>use it on the target entity</positive> to build the model. Once you have your model, you will have to train it.
milf.quest.aluminum.card_wallet.desc: Holds several <property>Location Cards</property> in one item. The Tempad reads the wallet automatically, which makes it useful for carrying shared locations and grouped travel points.
milf.quest.aluminum.chronomark.desc: The <keyword>Chronomark</keyword> is an upgraded version of the <keyword>Timedoor Marker</keyword>. It supports a <keyword>portal offset of up to 5 blocks</keyword> in any direction, allowing the marker to be <positive>hidden underground or mounted on a ceiling</positive> while the Timedoor appears at a different height. It also provides <property>team-based access filtering</property> with <keyword>FTB Teams</keyword>.
milf.quest.aluminum.chronometer.desc: A <keyword>faster portable generator</keyword> than the basic <keyword>Chronon Generator</keyword>. It creates <keyword>Chronons</keyword> more quickly, but still stays in your inventory instead of being placed as a block.
milf.quest.aluminum.chronon_battery.desc: A stronger storage item for Chronon energy. It works like the Cell, but holds more power and keeps feeding carried devices while you travel.
milf.quest.aluminum.chronon_cell.desc: Stores <property>Chronon energy</property> for your devices. Keep it in your inventory or a §6Curios slot§r, and it will feed power to carried Tempad items automatically.§r
milf.quest.aluminum.chronon_generator.de: A <keyword>portable power source</keyword> that slowly creates <magic>Chronons</magic> while it is in your <property>inventory</property> or <property>Curios slot</property>. It has no storage of its own, so it is mainly used to <positive>charge</positive> <named>Cells</named> and <named>Batteries</named>.
milf.quest.aluminum.deep_learner.desc: Training a <keyword>Data Model</keyword> can be done in one of <keyword>two ways</keyword>: with a <keyword>Deep Learner</keyword> or with a <keyword>Simulation Chamber</keyword>. The <keyword>Deep Learner</keyword> allows you to store a few <keyword>Data Models</keyword> within, and <positive>kills</positive> you receive will begin to <property>train the model</property>. All models start out in the <warning>Faulty</warning> state, and must be trained up to §l<positive>Basic</positive> in the <keyword>Deep Learner</keyword>.§r
milf.quest.aluminum.location_broadcaster: when toggled on and carried in the inventory, makes the holder visible in the Teleport app of any Tempad with the Player Teleport upgrade installed. Right-clicking it toggles between active (green screen) and inactive (red screen).
milf.quest.aluminum.location_card.desc: Stores the <property>coordinates</property> of a <named>Timedoor</named> destination. <positive>Write it</positive> from a <keyword>marker</keyword>, then <positive>load it</positive> into a <named>Timedoor Projector</named> or <named>Tempad</named> to open the matching portal.
milf.quest.aluminum.loot_fabricator.desc: <keyword>Mob Predictions</keyword> will need to be processed in a <keyword>Loot Fabricator</keyword>, a device which uses <property>power</property> to convert predictions to <property>mob drops</property>. The drops which are available are based on a list of <keyword>pre-defined items</keyword>, and a <positive>target can be selected</positive> for each type of model. The <keyword>Loot Fabricator</keyword> will remember your choices for each type, so you can <positive>feed multiple types of predictions</positive> into a single fabricator.
milf.quest.aluminum.metronome.desc: The strongest Chronon generator in the mod. Place it as a block and charge it once to start it, then it stores and produces Chronons on its own. Multiple Metronomes link together and work faster as a network.
milf.quest.aluminum.nano_helmet.desc: <keyword>Looks OP</keyword> for such an easy craft, so idk where to put it :p
milf.quest.aluminum.netherite_belt.title: Blastproof Belt
Allows you to <positive>access your system</positive> from any point in the world when linked to <keyword>quantum ring</keyword>
milf.quest.aluminum.screening_device.des: The Screening Device is an advanced version of the Location Broadcaster that adds team-based filtering. When compatible mods are installed (FTB Teams, Cadmus, or similar), it can restrict which players are allowed to teleport to the holder, cycling through modes like “Just you,” “Everyone,” “Guildmates,” “Party members,” and “Team.”
milf.quest.aluminum.sim_chamber.desc: Once your model is <positive>Basic</positive> or higher, you can use the <keyword>Simulation Chamber</keyword> to run simulations. Simulations will always produce a <property>generalized prediction</property>, and may also produce a <keyword>Mob Prediction</keyword>, based on the <property>accuracy</property> of the model. The <keyword>higher tier</keyword> of the model, the higher the accuracy, up to <keyword>99.5% at Self Aware</keyword>. Running simulations requires <property>energy</property> (based on the model type) and a <property>catalyst item</property>, which is usually a <keyword>Prediction Matrix</keyword>.
milf.quest.aluminum.tempad.desc: Unlike the <keyword>Timedoor Projector</keyword>, the <keyword>Tempad</keyword> automatically detects all <keyword>Timedoor Markers</keyword> and <keyword>Chronomarks</keyword> owned by the player, making <keyword>Location Cards</keyword> optional for personal travel.
milf.quest.aluminum.tempad_2.desc: Mod adds a complete <property>fast travel system</property> built around glowing portal doorways called <keyword>Timedoors</keyword>, powered by a unique <keyword>Chronon energy system</keyword> with <keyword>generators</keyword>, <keyword>cells</keyword>, and <keyword>batteries</keyword>
milf.quest.aluminum.tempad_2.title: Tempad
milf.quest.aluminum.time_twister.desc: The <named>Time Twister</named> tracks the player's personal timeline and allows <positive>backtracking</positive> to previous locations. It records dimension changes and death events, presenting them on a radial display. Selecting a point <positive>teleports</positive> the player back to that location and <warning>erases all timeline entries</warning> after the chosen point.
milf.quest.aluminum.timedoor_marker.desc: Sets the <keyword>target point</keyword> for teleportation. <positive>Place it</positive> where you want the <magic>portal to lead</magic>, then <positive>write its coordinates</positive> onto a blank <property>Location Card</property> by <positive>right-clicking it</positive>.
milf.quest.aluminum.timedoor_projector.d: The simplest way to open <keyword>Timedoors</keyword>. Load a <property>Location Card</property> into it, then right-click to open a portal by hand or power it with <warning>Redstone</warning> when placed as a block. It is the <property>best early-game teleport tool</property> and <warning>does not need Time Steel</warning>.
milf.quest.aluminum.wireless_terminal.de: One of the most useful items in any situation. You can configure it via the button to the <keyword>top right</keyword> of your character so it will <positive>refill</positive> whatever block you're holding straight from your <keyword>system</keyword> as well as search through your system to pick blocks via the <keyword>middle mouse button</keyword>
milf.quest.aluminum.workstation.desc:
The <keyword>Workstation</keyword> is a two-part block that serves as a docking station for the <keyword>Tempad</keyword> and a stationary <keyword>Timedoor terminal</keyword>. <positive>Right-click</positive> the docking pad with a <keyword>Tempad</keyword> to dock it, which unlocks the <keyword>cassette slot</keyword> for upgrade tapes and enables the <property>Portal Setup app</property> on the terminal screen.

Upgrade tapes are installed by right-clicking them into the cassette slot on the back of the Workstation while a Tempad is docked. Each upgrade permanently adds new functionality to that specific Tempad. 

When a Tempad is docked and the terminal receives a Redstone signal, it opens a Timedoor to the selected destination. The Portal Setup app allows fine-tuning the Timedoor’s position and rotation up to 5 blocks in any direction, as well as toggling whether the portal is upright or flat on the ground. A constant Redstone signal keeps the Timedoor open indefinitely at a cost of 10 Chronons per second.
milf.quest.automation_n_stuff.basic_chun:
A single player can have up to <keyword>9 active chunk loaders</keyword> 

If you haven't logged into the server for <keyword>7 days</keyword>, the <keyword>chunk loader</keyword> will <warning>stop working</warning>.
milf.quest.automation_n_stuff.basicmagne: The <keyword>Basic Magnet</keyword> <positive>picks up Items and Experience</positive> within a <property>5 block range</property> of the player!
milf.quest.automation_n_stuff.centrifuge: §4Separates§r resources into their components via fast motor go brrr.§r
milf.quest.automation_n_stuff.essentia_c:
Your first <named>essentia storage cell</named>. Put it in an <keyword>ME Drive</keyword> and the network can store essentia like items.

<property>4k</property>, <property>16k</property> and <property>64k</property> tiers come later - each needs better <keyword>processors</keyword> to link more components together.

Essentia stays <warning><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.2>volatile</shake></warning> even in digital form. This warded housing of <keyword>thaumium</keyword> and <keyword>quartz glass</keyword> keeps it contained.

Combine it with an <property>essentia storage component</property> to get a cell.
milf.quest.automation_n_stuff.essentia_e: Like the item <keyword>Export Bus</keyword>, but for essentia: <aqua><wave>pushes</wave></aqua> essentia from the network into the container it faces.
milf.quest.automation_n_stuff.essentia_i: Like the item <keyword>Import Bus</keyword>, but for essentia: <aqua><wave>pulls</wave></aqua> essentia from the container it faces into the network.
milf.quest.automation_n_stuff.gadget_bui: Place blocks fast in <keyword>line</keyword>, <keyword>wall</keyword>, <keyword>floor</keyword>, <keyword>column</keyword>, <keyword>stair</keyword>, and <keyword>grid</keyword> shapes. §7Shift-right-click§r to choose the block, then use the settings menu and <positive>right-click</positive> to build. It uses blocks from your inventory or linked storage and shows a preview first§r
milf.quest.automation_n_stuff.gadget_cop: Copy a 3D build area and paste it elsewhere. Use <keyword>Copy</keyword> to select the area, then <keyword>Paste</keyword> to place it. You still need the blocks in your inventory, and you can <keyword>rotate</keyword>, <warning>mirror</warning>, §7offset§r, or §7anchor§r the preview before placing§r
milf.quest.automation_n_stuff.gadget_cut: Move a build to a new place instead of copying it. Select the area, use <keyword>Cut</keyword> to store it in the gadget, then <keyword>Paste</keyword> to place it later. It also keeps block entity data, including chest contents, but it has no undo
milf.quest.automation_n_stuff.gadget_des: Clear <keyword>large areas</keyword> very fast for <positive>digging</positive>, tunnels, or land cleanup. §7Shift-right-click§r to set the <keyword>size and shape</keyword>, then <positive>right-click</positive> to destroy the marked area. <warning>It gives no drops</warning>, so use it only when you do not need the blocks back§r
milf.quest.automation_n_stuff.gadget_exc: Replace one block type with another without breaking the build. §7Shift-right-click§r the block you want to match, choose exchange mode, then <positive>right-click</positive> the area. It can work on connected areas, use fuzzy replacement, and support block entities if enabled§r
milf.quest.automation_n_stuff.inspector_:
§oAll Building Gadgets items need <property>Forge Energy</property>§o. Use the <keyword>settings menu</keyword>(<warning>X</warning> key with gadget in hand) to change <positive>modes</positive>, set <keyword>range</keyword>, §7anchor§r the preview, and <warning>undo</warning> the last action where the tool allows it.§r

You can also use the <warning>U</warning> key to <warning>undo</warning> your last action!
milf.quest.automation_n_stuff.portable_e:
Your essentia, <positive>in your pocket</positive>. <positive>RMB</positive> opens its terminal - deposit or withdraw with <keyword>phials</keyword> and <keyword>jars</keyword>. You can also <positive>RMB</positive> a filled container onto the cell in your inventory to empty it.

Holds up to <property>12 aspect types</property> at half the capacity of a regular cell. Recharge it in a <keyword>Charger</keyword>, <keyword>Energy Cards</keyword> extend the battery.

§7Shift+RMB§r on an <warning>empty</warning> cell disassembles it. Also works in an <keyword>ME Drive</keyword>.§r
milf.quest.automation_n_stuff.template_m: Save a copied build as a <property>template</property> and load it later. Put a Copy-Paste Gadget with copied data in the <property>left slot</property>, <keyword>paper</keyword> in the <property>right slot</property>, give the template a <property>name</property>, and save it. You can also share the <warning>template code</warning> with other players.
milf.quest.basic_information.armor_quick: Now you can <positive>hot-swap armor</positive> by simply <positive>right-clicking</positive> it, or if you, <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>fancy pants</wiggle>, want to have the whole hat-check room of armor, you can <positive>sneak right-click</positive> an <keyword>armor stand</keyword> to hot-swap the whole set!
milf.quest.basic_information.boss_checkl:
<keyword><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.0>Boss Checklist</shake></keyword> adds a list of all bosses from the modpack to the game, which can be accessed via the radial menu <keyword>"R"</keyword>.

The menu displays all bosses from various mods, which you can <positive><pulse base=0.6 amplitude=1.2>mark as defeated</pulse></positive>, or they will be marked automatically if the mod is installed on the server. For each boss, you can view their <property>model/image, mod name, drops, spawn conditions</property>, and other additional info.
milf.quest.basic_information.bridging.de:
<keyword>Bridging</keyword> allows for placing blocks in gaps in front, above, or below blocks, even if the surface isn't visible! When it's available, a <property>crosshair</property> is shown to indicate where that block will be placed. When the <keyword>F3 menu</keyword> is visible, there's an extra outline showing the exact position it's placing in (but you can turn it on all the time in the config)

You can turn this mode on and off in the radial menu; press <keyword>«R»</keyword> to open it.

You can read more details <click action=open_url value='https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/bridging-mod'><u>here</u></click>.
milf.quest.basic_information.clavis.desc: Clavis transforms the traditional loot system: every loot chest is now locked and can be opened through a simple yet engaging <keyword>mini-game</keyword>. The better you perform, the <positive>richer your reward</positive> - up to nearly <positive><bounce amplitude=1.5 frequency=1.2 phase=1.0>double the loot</bounce></positive> for a perfect result.
milf.quest.basic_information.crawl.desc: You can press "<positive>C</positive>" to <positive>crawl</positive> and say hi to all your <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.5 phase=1.0>worm-like friends</wiggle>!
milf.quest.basic_information.crawl.title: Crawl
milf.quest.basic_information.discord.des: If you're having an <warning>issue</warning> or want to suggest an <positive>idea</positive>, you're always welcome to join our <click action=open_url value='https://discord.com/invite/xAaFCCqKAn'><u><magic>Discord</magic></u></click>!
milf.quest.basic_information.findme.desc: Press <keyword>"Y"</keyword> on an item in your inventory (or in EMI) to <positive>highlight similar items in nearby chests</positive>
milf.quest.basic_information.harvest_wit: <positive>Right-click</positive> on a <keyword>fully grown crop</keyword> to replant it with the power of worm-friendship!
milf.quest.basic_information.horseman.de:
This mod adds <keyword>horse improvements</keyword> you haven't thought you needed.

• When mounted, clicking on a fence will <positive>leash the horse</positive> to it. Requires <keyword>Lead</keyword> in the special slot that's added to horse inventory.

• Ridden horses can <positive>swim</positive> now. Press jump (spacebar) when in water.

• Horses now <positive>fit in boats</positive>.

• Makes traversing forests easier by tweaking <property>Leaves collision</property>. You'll get stuck on leaves much less now.

• Increases <property>horse step height</property> by <keyword>10%</keyword>. Allows riding up a path to a full block and not get stuck.

• When mounted, your <property>mining speed</property> will remain the same as on ground. Removes <keyword>80%</keyword> block break speed penalty when mounted.

• Keeps player's looking direction when mounting a horse. Rotates horse instead of you.

• When horse is not moving, player can move the camera independently of the ridden horse, up to <keyword>100 degrees</keyword> (after which horse will follow the rotation).

• Makes horse <warning>disappear (almost)</warning> when rider is looking down. <warning><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>Watch your step!</shake></warning>

You can read more details <click action=open_url value='https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/horseman'><u>here</u></click>.
<keyword>ItemLocks</keyword> allows you to <positive><pulse base=0.6 amplitude=1.0>lock</pulse></positive> item slots in your inventory, preventing you from moving items unwillingly.

• Toggle lock on individual slots by holding <positive>LOCK</positive> (Default: C) and left clicking a slot.

• Bypass a lock by holding <warning><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.2>BYPASS</shake></warning> (Default: B) and interacting with a slot.

• Making a slot empty while bypassing a lock does not remove the lock.

• Empty slots with a lock are unlocked until it's occupied.
milf.quest.basic_information.jump_over_f: When <keyword>walls and fences</keyword> hold you, fret not, now you can <positive><bounce amplitude=1.5 frequency=1.2 phase=1.0>jump them</bounce></positive>!
milf.quest.basic_information.little_joys:
Adds small <property>rewarding events</property> such as <magic>Dig Spots</magic>, <magic>Fishing Spots</magic>, <magic>Drop Rushes</magic> and <magic>Gold Rushes</magic>.

• <magic>Dig Spots</magic> holding <positive><bounce amplitude=1.5 frequency=1.2 phase=1.0>small treasures</bounce></positive>

• <magic>Fishing Spots</magic> guaranteeing a <positive>catch with treasure</positive>

• <magic>Drop Rushes</magic> for <keyword>bonus harvests</keyword> in a simple <property>timed challenge</property>

• <magic>Gold Rushes</magic> for <keyword>extra ores</keyword> while <positive>mining</positive>
milf.quest.basic_information.mouse_tweak:
<keyword>Mouse Tweaks</keyword> replaces the standard <keyword>RMB</keyword> dragging mechanic, adds two new <keyword>LMB</keyword> dragging mechanics and an ability to quickly move items with the <keyword>scroll wheel</keyword>.

You can also <pulse base=0.6 amplitude=1.2><positive>sort items</positive></pulse> in your inventory or chests by clicking the <keyword>middle mouse button</keyword>!

More info for Mouse Tweaks: <click action=open_url value='https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mouse-tweaks'><u>here</u></click>


More Mouse Tweaks - complements Mouse Tweaks by adding more mouse functionality

<keyword>ALT+LMB</keyword> to drop a slot
<keyword>CTRL+LMB</keyword> to quick-move all matching slots
<keyword>CTRL+ALT+LMB</keyword> to drop all matching slots
<keyword>SHIFT+RMB</keyword> for bulk crafting or trading

More info for More Mouse Tweaks: <click action=open_url value='https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/moremousetweaks'><u>here</u></click>
milf.quest.basic_information.nutrition.d:
Nutritional tracks <keyword>what kinds</keyword> of food you eat, not just how much.

• Every food falls into categories: <property>fruit, grain, protein, vegetable, dairy, and source</property>.

• Each category has its own level from 0 to 100. Eating that food type raises it, eating other things lets it slowly decay.

• Your overall diet tier (<keyword>malnourished, starving, surviving, nourished, gourmand</keyword>) depends on these levels and gives you passive bonuses or penalties - health, decay rate, etc.

• Eating <warning>too little or too much</warning> of one category triggers extra effects - both good (strength, mana regen) and bad (weakness).

• Keep a high diet tier for several days in a row and you unlock a <property>bonus effect</property> - it isn't a one-time permanent buff, it's kept active for as long as you maintain the diet, and gets removed if your diet drops too low <warning><shake amplitude=0.8 frequency=1.2>or you die</shake></warning>.

• The <warning>Nether and the End</warning> drain your nutrient levels faster than the Overworld - eating well matters more there.

• Open the full nutrition screen through the radial menu(R button) to see all your levels and current tier.

• The small icon next to your hotbar shows your current diet tier at a glance.

In short: eat a <keyword>varied diet</keyword> to stay strong. Ignore one category for too long and you'll feel it.
milf.quest.basic_information.plonk.desc:
By pressing <keyword>'P'</keyword> on any side of a block, you can stick up to <keyword>4 items</keyword> to it, so it's time to open your own flea market with strong desires to unlock better storage solutions!

More info <click action=open_url value='https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/plonk'><u>here</u></click>
milf.quest.basic_information.plonk.title: Plonk
milf.quest.basic_information.shake_ampli:
In this modpack, there are <keyword><bounce amplitude=2.0 frequency=1.5 phase=1.0>pings</bounce></keyword> for players, set to <keyword>button 5</keyword> on the mouse by default. For convenience, we recommend setting pings to <keyword>ALT</keyword> or the middle mouse button (<keyword>wheel</keyword>).

You can also <property>specify a channel for pings</property>, so you don't have to <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.5>listen to the sounds of other people's pings</shake>. To do this, use the command <keyword>/pingwheel channel NameChannel</keyword>
milf.quest.basic_information.showcase_it: By pressing "<positive>Shift + X</positive>" on an item in your inventory, you can <positive>link said item in chat</positive>
milf.quest.basic_information.trade_cycli:
Cycle the trades of every <keyword>villager</keyword> that hasn't been traded before without needing to wait for <property>working hours</property> or replacing the <keyword>workstation block</keyword> over and over again.

Sometimes the <keyword><bounce amplitude=1.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>Cycle button</bounce></keyword> isn't available; in that case, you can use the <keyword>«C»</keyword> shortcut key
milf.quest.basic_information.trashslot.d:
Press <keyword>T</keyword> to reveal the <keyword>trash slot</keyword> in your inventory, so you no longer have to litter around whenever you fill your pockets with "useful" items and suddenly there's no space left. Of course, later down the line you'll unlock <property>plastic, paper, metal</property>, and all the other types of trash that you'll <warning>HAVE to filter</warning> into corresponding, progressively expanding trash slots, because <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>of course we need to complicate things</wiggle>. How could we possibly be modpack devs otherwise, eh?

You can read more details <click action=open_url value='https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/trashslot'><u>here</u></click>, but be aware and don't believe a single word, because we know better.
milf.quest.basic_information.why_do_some: A square, a diamond, a circle - they don’t mean anything; they’re just decorations. The heart icon indicates that this quest is very useful, and we highly recommend completing it! The gear icon usually means that the quest is a main quest and you need to complete it!
Why do some quests come in different forms?
milf.quest.basic_information.zume.desc:
Mod adds a keybind which <positive><circle radius=0.8 frequency=1.2 phase=0.0>zooms in</circle></positive> your <keyword>FOV</keyword> while it's held down, allowing you to see <keyword><wave amplitude=1.2 frequency=0.8 wavelength=3.0>further away</wave></keyword>, and keybinds for <keyword>increasing and decreasing the zoom level</keyword>.

By default on the <keyword>«G»</keyword> button!

You can read more details <click action=open_url value='https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/zume'><u>here</u></click>.
milf.quest.basic_information.zume.title: Zume
milf.quest.bhow_to_automate.basic_wip_ch:
Many players are used to there being <keyword>2 ways</keyword> to automate <keyword>redstone</keyword> and <keyword>AE2</keyword> in Minecraft, but this is not the case.

<keyword>Modern Industrialization</keyword> provides completely elementary principles of <property>automation</property>:

• <property>Overclocking</property>
• <property>Recipe Locking</property>
• <property>Change the number of items</property> that are created or incoming.
• <property>Item/fluid auto-extraction</property>

In the next quests we'll talk more about all of these principles with pictures for the laziest of the lazy, as well as provide some tips to automate stuff from different mods!
milf.quest.bhow_to_automate.capacity.des:
You can change the <keyword>Capacity mechanism</keyword> by <positive>scrolling the wheels</positive> at the bottom to decrease capacity, or up to increase capacity.

Why is this necessary?

Sometimes we need to have a small number of items, for example, when we first start automating the creation of <keyword>electrical circuits</keyword>, we do not need to have too many of them, <keyword>1 to 10 pieces</keyword> will be enough to start with, in order not to waste all our <keyword>aluminum reserves</keyword>, we limit their creation and keep a couple of them in the mechanism, take them as needed.

The <keyword>Configurable Chest</keyword> works by the same logic, only it has many slots in it
milf.quest.bhow_to_automate.item_locking:
To avoid random items getting in, you can lock the input and output slots so that only the required item gets into the machine, that way up to a point you can not filter the pipes at all as you like, they can only get in where the required item is specified.

Blocked items are marked with an orange outline.

You can also from EMI insert a recipe by pressing the «+» with Shift, all necessary items will be locked automatically.
milf.quest.bhow_to_automate.overclocking:
The whole idea of <property>automation</property> is that you make a different <keyword>creation machine</keyword> for each item, for example, for <keyword>plates of bronze</keyword>, <keyword>tin</keyword>, <keyword>steel</keyword>, etc. you make your own <keyword>compressor</keyword> each, and feed that machine <keyword>infinite amounts</keyword> of the ingots you need.

Why is this necessary?

• Earlier we wrote about the principle of overclocking, it allows you to quickly create a lot of items, thereby creating a “Buffer” of certain items, in our example it is plates, these plates can later be used in other chains of production taking them from this place.
• We save tons of time by ridding ourselves of micromanagement, all we have to do is take care of the endless supply of ingots, more on that next!

Here we can also note that we don't need <keyword>pipes</keyword> to pull out the result, it will come out through the <keyword>mechanism into the barrel</keyword>, if you activate the <positive>right mode</positive> in the mechanism, of course.
milf.quest.bhow_to_automate.spectrum.des: You may have already noticed this little icon next to pedestal output - you can place <magic>crafting tablets</magic> with desired crafts here! When the pedestal has a <magic>crafting tablet</magic> inside it, it changes behavior - now it only accepts items that could be used in a specified craft (that means that if your crafting table output is, for example, a piston, the pedestal will accept any type of planks, even if you used one specific type in the <magic>tablet</magic>) and nothing else (note: items could §o§lonly§r§r be inserted from the top of the pedestal). Then if the pedestal is powered by redstone, it will output the crafting result from the bottom and §o§lonly§r§r from the bottom§r
milf.quest.bronze_age.any_hooks.title: Any Hooks
milf.quest.bronze_age.any_planks.title: Any Planks
milf.quest.bronze_age.ashen_goggles.desc:
Cloth soaked in alchemical <bone>ash</bone> becomes flexible yet tough <keyword>Ashen Fabric</keyword>, and from it - the <keyword>Ashen Cloak</keyword> set. Solid armor that looks quite dashing.

The <keyword>Ashen Goggles</keyword> also show machine info, like a <keyword>Tinker's Lens</keyword> that is always on. And every piece has slots for <magic>Inflictor Gems</magic>.
milf.quest.bronze_age.atmospheric_bellow:
<keyword>Atmospheric Bellows</keyword> limit the coil to <property>blasting</property> recipes, but <positive>double its speed</positive>.

Can not be used together with the <keyword>Char Instiller</keyword>.
milf.quest.bronze_age.blazing_ray.desc:
The <keyword>Blazing Ray</keyword> looks like a gun but works like artillery: each shot fires a <flame>straight beam of pure Ember</flame> until it hits a block or a creature.

Fired in quick succession it gets <warning>inaccurate</warning> - augments like the Focal Lens or Diffraction Barrel deal with that, each in its own way.
milf.quest.bronze_age.bronze_barrel.desc:
<keyword>Bronze barrels</keyword> can be used to store and move <keyword>32 stacks</keyword> of one item. 

• <positive>Left-click</positive> to give a stack to a placed barrel (<positive>shift</positive> to give as much as possible).

• <positive>Right-click</positive> to take a stack from a placed barrel (<positive>shift</positive> to take only 1 item).

If you <positive>break</positive> a barrel it will keep its stored contents, and you will get an item that you can interact with.

• Left-click on a barrel item with an item to insert it into the barrel.

• Left-click the barrel item on an empty slot to extract some items from it.
milf.quest.bronze_age.bronze_bending_mac: Bends things with <keyword>double the speed</keyword> of compressor!
milf.quest.bronze_age.bronze_boiler.desc:
All the <keyword>bronze machines</keyword> use <property>steam</property> to operate
Automatically <positive>outputs steam</positive> from the top
Tired of making <keyword>plates</keyword> and <keyword>rings</keyword> manually? This thing could <positive>lend a hand</positive>!
milf.quest.bronze_age.bronze_cutting_mac: Turns <keyword>ingots into rods</keyword> and <keyword>rods into bolts</keyword> when provided with <keyword>lubricant</keyword>
milf.quest.bronze_age.bronze_macerator.d: <positive>Crush ore</positive> and other things into <keyword>powder</keyword>, with <keyword>increased yield</keyword>!
milf.quest.bronze_age.bronze_solar_boile:
Turns <property>water into steam</property>, but require manual maintenance via gentle <keyword>axe rubs</keyword>

Automatically outputs <property>steam</property> from all sides, so be <warning>aware</warning> not to clog up your water pipes with steam
milf.quest.bronze_age.bronze_tank.desc:
<keyword>Bronze tanks</keyword> can store <keyword>4 buckets of fluid</keyword> each, you can use them to interact with machines, and you can place them in the world.

When placed in the world, you can <positive>right-click</positive> them with <keyword>buckets or other tanks</keyword> to transfer fluids.

Also, you can <positive>stack them</positive> in your inventory if they have the same contents. How nifty!
milf.quest.bronze_age.char_instiller.des:
The <keyword>Char Instiller</keyword> limits the coil to <property>smoking</property> recipes, but <positive>doubles its speed</positive>.

Can not be used together with <keyword>Atmospheric Bellows</keyword>.
milf.quest.bronze_age.cinder_staff.desc:
Hold RMB with the <keyword>Cinder Staff</keyword> to charge a <flame>sphere of pure Ember</flame> in front of you.

The longer you charge, the stronger the hit - at full power it <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>almost kills</shake> a typical monster in one shot.
milf.quest.bronze_age.clockwork_axe.desc:
The <keyword>Clockwork Axe</keyword> - a powerful <positive>unbreakable</positive> axe that runs on Ember.

Like the other clockwork tools, it doubles as a weapon and <flame>sets enemies on fire</flame>.
The <keyword>Clockwork Pickaxe</keyword> is a pickaxe and a shovel in one. Like all clockwork tools it is <positive>unbreakable</positive>, but needs Ember from your containers to work.

It hits hard, <flame>sets enemies on fire</flame>, and takes both tool and weapon enchantments.
milf.quest.bronze_age.copper_charger.des:
The <keyword>Copper Charger</keyword> fills portable Ember containers. Give it Ember, put the container inside with RMB, and take it out the same way once it is <flame>charged</flame>.

Everything your Ember tools and weapons burn comes from containers charged here.
milf.quest.bronze_age.ember_amulet.desc:
The <keyword>Ember Ring</keyword>, <keyword>Amulet</keyword> and <keyword>Belt</keyword> <positive>reduce the Ember cost</positive> of clockwork tools and Ember weapons.

Each piece gives a different reduction, and they <property>stack</property> - wear all three.
milf.quest.bronze_age.ember_bulb.desc:
The <keyword>Mantle Bulb</keyword> is worn in a <property>curio slot</property>, so it takes no inventory space and no hand.

The price is a <warning>much smaller capacity</warning>.
milf.quest.bronze_age.ember_cartridge.de: The <keyword>Mantle Cartridge</keyword> holds <positive>more Ember</positive> than a jar, but it only works while <property>held in your hand</property> - usually the off hand.
milf.quest.bronze_age.ember_grit.desc:
<keyword>Ember Grit</keyword> is crushed Ember crystal that still <flame>burns hot</flame>. Crush an <keyword>Ember Crystal</keyword> with the <keyword>Flat Stamp</keyword> to get <property>3</property> grit.

It is the fuel for the <keyword>Ember-powered</keyword> machines.
milf.quest.bronze_age.ember_jar.desc:
The <keyword>Mantle Jar</keyword> is a small portable Ember container. Ember tools can draw from it <positive>anywhere in your inventory</positive>.

Charge it at the <keyword>Copper Charger</keyword>.
milf.quest.bronze_age.ember_powered_comp:
The <keyword>Ember-powered Compressor</keyword> runs the same recipes as the bronze one, but <positive>without steam</positive> - it burns <keyword>Ember Grit</keyword> from a separate slot instead.

Recipes run <positive>1.5x faster</positive>, and grit is not spent on every operation - roughly <property>one per three</property> crafts.
milf.quest.bronze_age.ember_powered_cutt:
The <keyword>Ember-powered Cutting Machine</keyword> runs the same recipes as the bronze one, but <positive>without steam</positive> - it burns <keyword>Ember Grit</keyword> from a separate slot instead.

Recipes run <positive>1.5x faster</positive>, and grit is not spent on every operation - roughly <property>one per three</property> crafts.
milf.quest.bronze_age.ember_powered_mace:
The <keyword>Ember-powered Macerator</keyword> runs the same recipes as the bronze one, but <positive>without steam</positive> - it burns <keyword>Ember Grit</keyword> from a separate slot instead.

Recipes run <positive>1.5x faster</positive>, and grit is not spent on every operation - roughly <property>one per three</property> crafts.
milf.quest.bronze_age.ember_powered_mi_f:
The <keyword>Ember-powered Furnace</keyword> runs the same recipes as the bronze one, but <positive>without steam</positive> - it burns <keyword>Ember Grit</keyword> from a separate slot instead.

Recipes run <positive>1.5x faster</positive>, and grit is not spent on every operation - roughly <property>one per three</property> crafts.
milf.quest.bronze_age.ember_powered_mixe:
The <keyword>Ember-powered Mixer</keyword> runs the same recipes as the bronze one, but <positive>without steam</positive> - it burns <keyword>Ember Grit</keyword> from a separate slot instead.

Recipes run <positive>1.5x faster</positive>, and grit is not spent on every operation - roughly <property>one per three</property> crafts.
milf.quest.bronze_age.gate_pearl_4.desc: If you can finish this gateway, you might just get some useful items.
milf.quest.bronze_age.gate_pearl_5.desc:
If you don't like animal domestication, you don't have to do animal domestication.

You can instead make a Gateway of the Emerald Grove. Right clicking with it will open a portal that summons waves of enemies, and if you can successfully beat all of them, you will receive a pack of domesticated animals
milf.quest.bronze_age.gem_case.desc:
Apotheosis Gems will very quickly take up a lot of your storage space. 

The Gem Case fixes that by allowing you to stack these gems.
milf.quest.bronze_age.gem_dust.desc: Gem Dust is necessary to for making better use of Apotheosis gems. Drop an anvil on some gems to get Gem Dust.
milf.quest.bronze_age.grandhammer.desc:
The <keyword>Grandhammer</keyword> is a heavy melee weapon running on Ember.

Blocks broken with it are <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>obliterated</shake> - <warning>no drops at all</warning>. Because of that it can not take Fortune or Silk Touch.
milf.quest.bronze_age.hearth_coil.desc:
Forget stone furnaces. The <keyword>Hearth Coil</keyword> <flame>heats up</flame> on Ember, and the hotter it gets, the <positive>faster</positive> it smelts items placed on top.

Results are kept inside the coil - pipe them out from the bottom or through a <keyword>Mechanical Core</keyword>.
milf.quest.bronze_age.heat_insulation.de:
Keeping the coil hot eats a lot of Ember. Each <keyword>Heat Insulation</keyword> raises its maximum heat by <property>75</property> and makes it cool down <positive>30% slower</positive>.

With a bit of redstone control the coil can become <positive>much more efficient</positive>.
milf.quest.bronze_age.inflictor_gem.desc:
Hold the <keyword>Inflictor Gem</keyword> in your hand when you take damage - it will <glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.05>absorb that type of damage</glitch> and remember it.

Stitch the gem to <keyword>ashen armor</keyword> with a <keyword>string</keyword> in a crafting grid: each gem cuts damage of its type by about <positive>a third</positive>. To take gems off, put the armor into the grid alone.
milf.quest.bronze_age.iron_belt.title: Steel Belt
milf.quest.bronze_age.mi_upgrader.desc: Yet another <positive>revolutionary invention</positive> from the "Things that one person asked for and we spent quite some time bringing them to life" department of <named>PLACERS™</named> - the almighty <named>FINGMER</named> (Functionally Irreversible Neatly Game-designed Machine and whatever Else Replacer). With this little thing, your everyday routine of replacing things with the better versions of themselves will become as easy as saying the word "concrete"! By virtue of our CEO, Ms. S., being so thorough in following the production of our products, each and every unit of this wondrous apparatus will <positive>flawlessly upgrade ANY compatible block</positive> (when provided with <property>proper materials</property>, of course) without missing a single bit of content inside! <property>Reusable</property> too (as long as you don't lose it), even within the crafting table! Craft one today and become one of thousands of happy customers who have already brought their factory to another level!
Any charged container will do: a <keyword>Jar</keyword> in the inventory, a <keyword>Cartridge</keyword> in hand or a <keyword>Bulb</keyword> in a curio slot.

Ember tools and weapons <flame>drain it</flame> on every use - keep it topped up at the Charger.
milf.quest.bronze_age.sigil_of_malice.de: True perfection will still require a little luck. In your travels you may encounter the §6Sigil of Malice§r, an esoteric artifact which <keyword>randomly changes</keyword> an affix item. What exactly it does is a mystery.§r
milf.quest.bronze_age.steam_blast_furnac: Hot enough furnace to produce <keyword>steel</keyword>, as well as some <keyword>other useful resources</keyword>
milf.quest.bronze_age.steam_farmer.desc:
Your ultimate farming solution!
<named>Automatic farm</named> with <property>2 configurable sizes</property>.

Will <positive>turn grass into farmland</positive> around itself, <positive>hydrate soil</positive> when provided with water, <positive>plant crops</positive> when provided with seeds and <positive>harvest all the crops</positive> if there's enough output room for everything that could be harvested from plants (e.g. for wheat you need 2 output slots: one for seeds and one for wheat itself)
milf.quest.bronze_age.trading_post.desc: <keyword>Trading Post</keyword> allows you to <positive>trade with all villagers in a area at once</positive> in a single interface
milf.quest.bronze_age.weapons.title: Weapons
milf.quest.bronze_age.wrench.desc:
Using a <keyword>wrench</keyword>, you can <positive>rotate any machine</positive> by right-clicking. You can rotate the <keyword>output side</keyword> by sneaking while you <positive>shift-click</positive>.

§lWith the wrench in your hand, you can also see how to build a particular multi-block! To do this, place the main block of the multi-block.§r

<warning>Note that breaking a machine with the wrench will not drop it.</warning> Use a <keyword>pickaxe</keyword> for that!
The <keyword>chicken nest</keyword> <positive>collects eggs dropped by nearby chickens and stores them for later pickup</positive>.

§lUsage§r
• <keyword>Right-click</keyword> a chicken nest to collect eggs.
• You can also use a <keyword>hopper</keyword> to pull eggs from the nest.
milf.quest.diverse_content.decree.desc:
There exists another item as well, called a <keyword>Decree</keyword>. A Decree determines what kind of bounties show up on a bounty board. For example, an <property>Armorsmithing Decree</property> makes it so that objectives and rewards related to armor show up on the board (leather, iron, chestplates, boots, etc). You can have up to three decrees on a bounty board at once, and it will mix and match objectives and rewards from all three when new bounties appear!

You can find new Decrees as rewards for certain bounties, or they can be traded with villagers at higher villager levels.
milf.quest.diverse_content.feeding_troug:
The <keyword>feeding trough</keyword> <positive>feeds nearby animals for breeding</positive>.

§lUsage§r

• <keyword>Right-click</keyword> a feeding trough to insert animal feed.
• The feeding trough will <positive>automatically feed nearby animals</positive> when they are hungry.
• The feeding trough will <warning>stop feeding animals</warning> if the area gets too crowded.
milf.quest.diverse_content.green_fertili: <keyword>Green Fertilizer</keyword> can be applied to farmland to <positive>increase crop output</positive>. It can be combined with <click action=open_quest value='diverse_content/yellow_fertilizer'><u>Yellow Fertilizer</u></click>.
milf.quest.diverse_content.market.desc: Used to <positive>purchase most seeds</positive> in the modpack.
milf.quest.diverse_content.q4b3c2c61b4a1:
<keyword>Bounty boards</keyword> can be found throughout the world in villages, and they'll generate bounties inside of them. These bounties often ask for you to bring back an item, or kill some mobs in return for whatever rewards they're offering. If you can complete the bounty, you just have to bring it back to the bounty board and <keyword>right click</keyword> the board to <positive>redeem your rewards</positive>!

Just like items, bounties can have different tiers of rarity. Some bounty rewards are more rare than others, and bounties with higher rarity have a better chance of having these more rare rewards! Rarity follows the same pattern as in vanilla: <property>Common</property>, <property>Uncommon</property>, <property>Rare</property> and <property>Epic</property>.


§l<warning>In Bounty, you can find useful items such as backpacks, waystones, or lockpicks - this isn’t the full list of possible items.</warning>§r
milf.quest.diverse_content.red_fertilize: <keyword>Red Fertilizer</keyword> can be applied to farmland to <positive>boost growth speed</positive>. It can be combined with <click action=open_quest value='diverse_content/yellow_fertilizer'><u>Yellow Fertilizer</u></click>.
milf.quest.diverse_content.spray_can.des:
allows the <positive>recolor various blocks</positive> like <keyword>AE2 cables</keyword>, wool, terracotta, concrete etc. with a single item. Doesn't use dye beyond the initial crafting recipe. Infinite durability.

• <keyword>Shift and scroll</keyword> on the item to select the color. <keyword>Right click</keyword> on blocks to recolor them according to the selected color. 
• <keyword>Shift and right click</keyword> to batch recolor blocks of the same type and color connected to eachother.
milf.quest.diverse_content.yellow_fertil: <keyword>Yellow Fertilizer</keyword> can be applied to farmland to <positive>prevent trampling of crops</positive>
milf.quest.endgame.holy_book_of_color.de:
"Be they ever so humble, 
Or ever so bold, 
Not a single contender 
Will withstand them all.

If you think you could try it, 
Or even succeed, 
Then beware of the changes,
They'll come from within.

All the past is forgotten,
As the future's your goal, 
Be afraid of the stasis
To progress us all."

- Extract from the Holy Book of Color on the ceremony to become the High Hierarch of Spectrum
milf.quest.endgame.old_diary.desc:
"Seek the truth for all-truth's sake,
Always learn from your mistake,
Never end your search to break,
And never let your thoughts be fake.

Let the colors lead your mind,
Free your soul from all-time twine,
Spectrum takes and spectrum blinds,
But your goals are still aligned.

Don't be humbled, don't you fear,
This rite'll not leave you seared,
And when the world around you smears
Just accept this gift and steer." 

- Words of passion that each of the Great Surface Explorer recieves after undergoing severe mutations to be able to walk outside of the Spectrum Depths
milf.quest.endgame.old_tablet.desc:
"Deeper went we for powers,
As our needs came to play,
We could gain grain in hours,
If we knew whom to praise.

We then went even deeper,
To a land never seen,
'Cause the colors transfigure
Only things so pristine.

If we find what we search for,
We could settle for good, 
Otherwise, we will try more,
Till we blaspheme sainthood"

- In Search Of Greatness, by the Fifth Herald of Color
milf.quest.first_steps.a_cage_for_our_an: You can use a <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/animal_cage'><u>cage</u></click> to catch mobs like sheep or cows and <positive>breed them</positive>. It's a very <property>lag-friendly block</property> - use it instead of having a large number of mobs in your area, as that can <warning>negatively impact server performance</warning>!
A cage for our animal friends
milf.quest.first_steps.a_cage_for_our_aq: You can use a <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/water_animal_container'><u>water container</u></click> to catch mobs like fish or axolotls and <positive>breed them</positive>. It's a very <property>lag-friendly block</property> - use it instead of having a large number of mobs in your area, as that can <warning>negatively impact server performance</warning>!
A cage for our aquatic animal friends
milf.quest.first_steps.a_cage_for_our_fl: You can use a <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/bird_catcher'><u>bird catcher</u></click> to catch mobs like bees or bats and <positive>breed them</positive>. This is a very <property>lag-friendly block</property> - use it instead of having large numbers of mobs in your territory, as that can <warning>negatively impact server performance</warning>!
A cage for our flying little friends
milf.quest.first_steps.animal_cage.desc:
With an <named>Animal Cage</named> in hand, <keyword>RMB</keyword> an animal to <positive>capture it</positive>. You can catch <property>several animals of the same kind</property> in a single cage.

<keyword>RMB</keyword> with the cage on an <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/a_cage_for_our_animal_friends'><u>Animal Pen</u></click> to store and interact with them, or <keyword>Shift + RMB</keyword> to <wind>let them go</wind>.

Works for most <nature>land animals</nature> such as cows, pigs and sheep.
To get a <keyword>domesticated version of animals</keyword>, you have to <positive>breed wild animals</positive>!

The farther back in the wild animal's lineage, the <keyword>greater the chance</keyword> that the animal will become <keyword>domesticated</keyword>
milf.quest.first_steps.any_baits.title: Any Baits
milf.quest.first_steps.any_beds.title: Any Beds
milf.quest.first_steps.any_boats.title: Any Boats
milf.quest.first_steps.any_bobbers.desc: We recommend that you read about each <wind>type of bobber</wind>!
milf.quest.first_steps.any_bobbers.title: Any Bobbers
milf.quest.first_steps.any_c_seeds.title: Any #c:seeds
milf.quest.first_steps.any_catenary_item: Various <keyword>leads and chains</keyword> can be <positive>used on fences/walls</positive> by <positive>right clicking</positive> them and connecting two of them together so that you can <positive>quickly move along</positive> these connections using <keyword>any pickaxe</keyword>!
milf.quest.first_steps.any_connectors.de: A <keyword>connector</keyword> links cooking tables, sinks, fridges, ovens and counters into one <property>continuous kitchen network</property>, letting ingredients and heat sources be shared across the whole setup.
milf.quest.first_steps.any_cooking_table: The Heart of the Kitchen. A <keyword>cooking table</keyword> is the central block of the kitchen - it lets you access <property>ingredients</property> stored in nearby connected containers directly from the crafting grid, and shows you every recipe you can currently cook.
milf.quest.first_steps.any_counters.desc: A <keyword>counter</keyword> is a basic connector block that also works as storage and worktop - place several around your cooking table to extend the kitchen and store extra ingredients.
milf.quest.first_steps.any_fridges.desc:
A <keyword>fridge</keyword> keeps ingredients cool and lets a connected cooking table pull food out of it, just like any other kitchen storage - freeing up chest space near your stove.

Fridges can hold <property>upgrade items</property> in their upgrade slot:
• <keyword>Ice Unit</keyword> - provides <named>snow and ice</named> for recipes that need them
• <keyword>Preservation Chamber</keyword> - <positive>prevents the last item of a slot from being used up</positive>, so you never run out of a key ingredient
milf.quest.first_steps.any_fridges.title: Any Fridges
milf.quest.first_steps.any_hats.desc: Some of the <named>hats</named> change the behavior of the minigame!
milf.quest.first_steps.any_hats.title: Any Hats
milf.quest.first_steps.any_hooks.desc: We recommend that you learn about each <wiggly>type of hook</wiggly>!
milf.quest.first_steps.any_hooks.title: Any Hooks
milf.quest.first_steps.any_logs.desc: Can only be acquired via <keyword>axe</keyword> (because we care about the well-being of your fists, you masochist (•ᴗ•) )
milf.quest.first_steps.any_logs.title: Any Logs
milf.quest.first_steps.any_ovens.desc:
An <keyword>oven</keyword> lets a connected cooking table use its <property>baking recipes</property>, just like a vanilla furnace would - but shared across the whole kitchen network.

An oven can hold a <property>Heating Unit</property> in its upgrade slot, letting it be heated using <positive>energy</positive> instead of fuel.
milf.quest.first_steps.any_ovens.title: Any Ovens
milf.quest.first_steps.any_sinks.desc: A <keyword>sink</keyword> supplies <named>water</named> to nearby cooking tables for recipes that need it. <warning>It does not generate water on its own</warning> - connect it to a water source or pipe.
milf.quest.first_steps.any_sinks.title: Any Sinks
milf.quest.first_steps.any_ytech_aqueduc:
Connect several <named>aqueducts</named> to pipe <aqua><wave>water</wave></aqua> in a straight line from point A to point B.

Each aqueduct block holds <property>two buckets of water</property> and interacts with the other components of the aqueduct system.
milf.quest.first_steps.aqueduct_valve.de:
Allows water to be <positive>pumped</positive> from rivers into the <property>aqueduct network</property>!

In the future, you will have the opportunity to <positive>generate water infinitely</positive>!

§l<property>Does not consume water</property> in biomes such as rivers and oceans§r
milf.quest.first_steps.are_you_sure_it_s:
• <positive>Place</positive> the ship <magic>far away into water</magic> - they need space to spawn.

• <positive>Right-click</positive> to <positive>sit in the ship</positive>.

§lWhile sitting in the Ship§r:§r
• Press <keyword>Radial Menu Button</keyword> to <positive>open/close the sail</positive>.
• <keyword>\[W\] / \[S\]</keyword> to <positive>increase or decrease sail speed</positive>.

• <keyword>Third Person View (F5) + Mousewheel</keyword> = <positive>Adjust camera distance</positive>.

• <positive>Right-click</positive> an entity to <positive>dismount</positive> it from the ship.

• To <positive>open inventory</positive> outside of the ship: <positive>crouch + right-click</positive>.

You can read more about each ship, their speeds, and other details <click action=open_url value='https://github.com/talhanation/wiki/wiki/Small-Ships-Wiki'><u>here</u></click>!
Are you sure it's Small Ships?
milf.quest.first_steps.atlas.desc:
This is the first navigation method; more convenient navigation methods will become available later.

- Can be worn in a <property>curio slot</property> to <positive>unlock the minimap</positive>.
- While worn, can be <positive>opened</positive> by using <keyword>\[M\]</keyword>
- When held, the <property>entity radar</property> is enabled
- By pressing <keyword>\[B\]</keyword>, you can <positive>place markers</positive>. You can also press <keyword>\[B\]</keyword> while looking at a <keyword>fire pit</keyword>, <keyword>bed</keyword>, <keyword>banner</keyword> etc. to add them as a marker.
- To display a marker on the minimap, <positive>open the atlas</positive> and press <positive>RMB</positive> on it
- Displays the <keyword>coordinates</keyword>
- Every <magic>dimension</magic> will have its exclusive map
- You can <warning>lock the atlas</warning> by <positive>shift clicking</positive> it, preventing new maps from being created.
- You can also <positive>place an Atlas on a Lectern</positive> and access the worldmap from there
- §lAtlases can be cloned and merged within a <keyword>Cartography table</keyword>§r
milf.quest.first_steps.basket.desc: <named>Bundle</named>'s lil bro, look at it, so <positive>cute</positive> ❤
milf.quest.first_steps.belt.desc: Provides <keyword>storage</keyword> and easy access to any type of tool you put inside it
milf.quest.first_steps.bird_catcher.desc: Same as the <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/animal_cage'><u>Animal Cage</u></click>, but for <wind>flying creatures</wind> such as bats and bees.
milf.quest.first_steps.birds_nest.desc: <keyword>Bird nests</keyword> can sometimes be obtained from foliage when you <positive>cut down trees</positive>. Birds are very useful because they <positive>collect</positive> all kinds of debris in their nests. Who knows what you might find there?
milf.quest.first_steps.blessing_and_grac: Life and death have always walked together. One tome grants growth, the other a worthy end
milf.quest.first_steps.bloomery_base.des:
The <named>bloomery base</named> is <keyword>set into the ground</keyword> - <keyword>RMB</keyword> on a <nature>dirt</nature> block to replace it

It can only be lit with exactly <property>4 coal</property> in the fuel slot - <warning>charcoal doesn't count as fuel</warning>, though it can still be an ingredient. Add the ingredients with <keyword>RMB</keyword>, then light it: <keyword>hold RMB</keyword> on it with a <named>Firestarter</named>

Coal <flame>burns down</flame> as the recipe goes and <warning>can't be taken out while lit</warning>. Take the result out with <keyword>Shift + RMB</keyword> with an empty hand

Some recipes need <wind>extra air</wind>: put a <named>kiln</named> on top of the base and pump <named>bellows</named> next to it
milf.quest.first_steps.bone_needle.desc: Sharp as a needle... literally (and performs as one too)
milf.quest.first_steps.bottled_letter.de: You can write your own <named>message in a bottle</named> and toss it into the sea—other players will have the chance to <positive>fish it out</positive> and read it!
milf.quest.first_steps.brick_dust.desc: Put <keyword>terracotta</keyword> on a <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/tree_stump'><u>Tree Stump</u></click> with <keyword>RMB</keyword>, then hit it with a <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/lead_hammer'><u>Lead Hammer</u></click> <property>a few times</property> to <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>crush</shake> it into <property>2</property> <bone>Brick Dust</bone>
milf.quest.first_steps.bronze_anvil.desc:
The <named>bronze anvil</named> works <keyword>just like the stone one</keyword> and uses the same hit minigame, but it handles <positive>everything the stone anvil can and more</positive>

It's needed to forge <named>iron bloom</named> into <named>iron ingots</named> and to hammer <named>copper, tin and lead</named> ingots into <named>plates</named>. Some of its recipes need <property>several items at once</property> - the minigame only starts once they are all on the anvil

Its recipes are <warning>tougher</warning> - each hit adds less progress, so <keyword>aim carefully</keyword>

<bone>Four whole crucibles of bronze went into it</bone>, so treat it with respect
milf.quest.first_steps.chunk_claiming.de:
As a true apex predator of this blocky world, you have to <positive>mark your territory</positive> to assure your dominance over this particular domain (and protect it from others just as apex and just as predators as yourself), and that's where this handy new <keyword>flag</keyword> comes into play! 
<positive>Place it</positive> on unclaimed soil to <positive>claim it</positive> for your team (or yourself if that's what you fancy). Works similar to the claim chunk FTB function, just without the actual map involved (since you haven't unlocked one yet).

§lYou can press <keyword>F3 + G</keyword> to enable <property>chunk highlighting</property>.§r
milf.quest.first_steps.clay_crucible.des:
A <named>clay crucible</named> melts ore into <flame><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>molten metal</shake></flame> - up to <property>1000 mB</property> at a time. Place it with <keyword>Shift + RMB</keyword>

Set it <keyword>on dirt</keyword>, put <named>crushed copper, tin, lead or gold</named> and <named>coal</named> inside with <keyword>RMB</keyword>, one item per click, then light it: <keyword>hold RMB</keyword> on it with a <named>Firestarter</named>

Break the crucible to pick it up <positive>together with the metal</positive>, then <keyword>RMB</keyword> on a mold to pour it

<keyword>Shift + RMB</keyword> with an empty hand takes the items back out. <warning>You can't add items while there is still liquid inside</warning>
milf.quest.first_steps.clay_mold_ingot.d:
An <named>ingot mold</named> has <property>3 slots</property> of <property>250 mB</property> each - one ingot per slot

<keyword>RMB</keyword> with a filled <named>crucible</named> pours metal into the next free slot. The slots are independent, so <positive>different metals</positive> can share one mold

When the metal has <aqua>cooled down</aqua> (about <property>20 seconds</property>), hit the mold with a <named>hammer</named> using <keyword>RMB</keyword>: it <warning><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>shatters</shake></warning>, dropping the ingots and some <named>potsherds</named>

<warning>The mold is single-use</warning> - wait until every filled slot has hardened, otherwise the metal that is still liquid will be lost
milf.quest.first_steps.cooking_pot.desc:
<keyword>Cooking for Blockheads</keyword> is compatible with <keyword>Farmer's Delight</keyword> - if a <named>cooking pot</named> and a <named>stove</named> are placed adjacent to each other, they form a multiblock, and connecting it to your kitchen network <positive>automatically pulls the right ingredients</positive> into the pot for any recipe it can cook.

The <named>cooking pot</named> also acts as a <property>workstation</property> - a nearby villager can claim it and become a <keyword>Chef</keyword>.
milf.quest.first_steps.copper.title: Copper
milf.quest.first_steps.copper_belt.title: Bronze Belt
milf.quest.first_steps.copper_horn.desc:
Can be used to <positive>summon a horse</positive> from any location in the world. 

It is crafted from <keyword>3 copper ingots</keyword> and <keyword>1 Goat Horn</keyword>.
milf.quest.first_steps.cow_jar.desc: A <named>Cow Jar</named> - supplies a connected cooking table with <keyword>milk</keyword>, letting you craft recipes that normally require a <property>milk bucket</property> without needing an actual bucket.
The <named>Crafting Station</named> works like a normal crafting table, except that it can <magic>access adjacent inventories</magic>, and items <positive>stay on it</positive> after you close it.
milf.quest.first_steps.crafting_table.de:
Finally
Let's just pretend that there's no saw on this thing's texture and move on until you can make said saw to satisfy your meticulousness needs.
milf.quest.first_steps.crafting_workspac: One of the most important blocks in the modpack (until you find a way to perform such a human-dependent procedure via machinery *wink*) allows you to <positive>construct blocks</positive> from ingredients in a <keyword>3x3x3 grid</keyword>
milf.quest.first_steps.divining_rod.desc:
Indicates the amount of water for a <keyword>Well Pulley</keyword>.

Looking <positive>down</positive> gives <keyword>more water</keyword>, looking <positive>up</positive> gives <keyword>less</keyword>.
milf.quest.first_steps.dockyard.desc:
The <named>dockyard</named> is where ships are <keyword>built, upgraded and repaired</keyword>. Place it <aqua>near water</aqua> and open it with <keyword>RMB</keyword>

In the <keyword>Build</keyword> tab pick a ship type and a <nature>wood type</nature> - the menu shows the ship's stats and the materials it needs. They are taken <warning>straight from your inventory</warning>. Building takes a while, then the ship appears on the nearest free water spot, which has to be <warning>big and deep enough</warning> for it

The <keyword>Modify</keyword> tab works with a ship within <property>16 blocks</property>: install <positive>upgrades</positive>, mount <named>cannons</named>, hang <named>shields</named>, dye the sails, put up banners, rename the ship and <positive>repair</positive> its hull and sails

Every ship type has its own quirks with <wind>wind</wind>, biomes and cargo - <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>read its description</wiggle> in the menu before choosing
milf.quest.first_steps.escape_rope.desc: An easy way to <magic><wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>teleport</wiggle></magic> your way <positive>out of caves</positive>.
milf.quest.first_steps.fire_pit.desc:
The <named>fire pit</named> is your first source of <flame>heat</flame>. It's <keyword>dug into the ground</keyword> - <keyword>RMB</keyword> on a <nature>dirt</nature> block to replace it

Put up to <property>4 logs</property> in with <keyword>RMB</keyword>, then light it: <keyword>hold RMB</keyword> on it with a <named>Firestarter</named>. One log burns for about <property>30 seconds</property>

Every burnt log leaves <positive>charcoal</positive> behind, up to <property>16</property>. Take it out with <keyword>Shift + RMB</keyword> once the fire is out - <warning>when there's no room left for charcoal, the fire goes out by itself</warning>

The fire pit will come in handy for a long time: later on, a lot of other stations are <keyword>built on top of it</keyword>
milf.quest.first_steps.fire_striker.desc:
A sturdier way to light <named>fire pits</named>, crucibles and bloomeries - <property>32 uses</property> instead of the Firestarter's <property>8</property>

Hold the striker in your <keyword>main hand</keyword> and <named>flint</named> in your <keyword>off hand</keyword>. <keyword>Hold RMB</keyword>, then <keyword>hold LMB</keyword> until the <flame><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.2>sparks</shake></flame> catch. The flint is <positive>not used up</positive>

<warning>It only lights stations</warning> - for setting regular blocks on fire you still need a Firestarter
milf.quest.first_steps.fish_radar.desc: A handy <keyword>radar</keyword> that shows which <named>fish</named> you can <positive>catch</positive> in the area where you are
milf.quest.first_steps.flint_axe.desc: You know what you will use this for, don't you?
milf.quest.first_steps.flint_chisel.desc:
With a <named>chisel</named> you can <keyword>carve blocks right in the world</keyword>

Take the chisel in your <keyword>main hand</keyword> and a <named>hammer</named> in your <keyword>off hand</keyword>. <keyword>Hold RMB</keyword> and strike a placed block with <keyword>LMB</keyword>, about once per second

Hits on the <keyword>top face</keyword> chip away the top layers, hits on the <keyword>sides</keyword> chip away the side layers. Once the number of chipped layers matches a recipe, the next hit turns the block into the result

Hold <keyword>Shift</keyword> to keep chipping past a finished shape - this way one block of <named>stone</named> can become different things. <warning><shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>Chip too much and the block crumbles</shake></warning>

Some carved pieces split into parts with a single strike. Every hit costs durability of <warning>both the chisel and the hammer</warning>
milf.quest.first_steps.flint_knife.desc:
§mUse an axe for the combat instead, as it's more powerful. But shh, I didn't tell you that§r

Can also collect <keyword>Grass Fibers</keyword> from grass
milf.quest.first_steps.forge_hammer.desc:
New quest chapter
The <keyword>Forge Hammer</keyword> is necessary for the early parts of tech. Place a material (usually ingots) in them to view available recipes, although most will also require a <keyword>Hammer</keyword> item in the second slot. Using the Forge Hammer is <warning>not as resource efficient</warning> as using machines:

A <keyword>Forge Hammer</keyword> will turn two ingots into one plate, while a <keyword>Compressor</keyword> will turn one ingot into one plate.
milf.quest.first_steps.furnace.desc:
It's the <flame>furnace</flame>. You know it, you love it.

But here it <warning>won't smelt metals</warning>: ores, raw metal and dust of <keyword>copper, iron, gold, tin, lead, nickel and antimony</keyword> have to go through the <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/clay_crucible'><u>clay crucible</u></click> or the <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/bloomery_base'><u>bloomery</u></click> instead
milf.quest.first_steps.glitch_hello_worl:
§lWelcome to <grad colors=#848dcb,#45509d freq=0.5>MI:Lost Favor!§r</grad>§r

As this modpack is <property>progress dependent</property>, we introduced quite a number of <warning>restrictions</warning>, as well as <positive>simplifications</positive> to the gameplay! 

No hostile monsters spawn around you(Almost), wicked bastards are lurking around in the <magic>dungeons</magic>, <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.2>waiting for the opportunity to strike</shake> at the first unwary wanderer that happens to stumble across their domain, so be <warning>cautious</warning>. 

<keyword>Maps</keyword> are essential to not get lost here, so you'll have an opportunity to make a scribbled one quite early, but the proper one will require the <property>tech knowledge</property> you don't possess as of the time being, but <positive><fade minAlpha=0.4 frequency=1.0>worry not</fade></positive>, as it will come to you eventually.

Press <keyword>R</keyword> to open the <positive>Radial Menu</positive>, where you'll find most of the modpack important <keyword>keybindings</keyword>.

Inhabitants of those long-forgotten <magic>places</magic> around the world experienced burglary firsthand and thus know how to protect their possessions, <warning>locking them behind those magical locks</warning>
milf.quest.first_steps.grass_fibers.desc: Use your newly acquired <keyword>sharp flint</keyword> to <positive>harvest</positive> some <keyword>grass</keyword>
milf.quest.first_steps.grass_twine.desc: Even <nature>grass</nature> can become quite strong when you <positive>weave it properly</positive>.
milf.quest.first_steps.gravel.desc: First things first, get some <keyword>gravel</keyword> to begin your journey, it'll surely be handy.
milf.quest.first_steps.iron.title: Iron
milf.quest.first_steps.iron_bloom.desc:
An <named>iron bloom</named> is a <flame>spongy lump</flame> of iron and slag. It's made in the <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/bloomery_base'><u>bloomery</u></click> from <property>2</property> <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/crushed_iron'><u>crushed iron</u></click> and <property>2</property> <named>charcoal</named>

This recipe <wind><wave>needs extra air</wave></wind>: put a <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/kiln'><u>kiln</u></click> on top of the bloomery and pump <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/pot_bellows'><u>bellows</u></click> next to it

The bloom isn't an ingot yet - <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>forge</shake> it into an <named>iron ingot</named> on a <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/bronze_anvil'><u>bronze anvil</u></click>

Don't forget to decorate your base with <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/chunk_claiming'><u>flags!</u></click>
milf.quest.first_steps.kiln.desc:
The <named>kiln</named> goes <keyword>on top of a Fire Pit</keyword> and works only while the pit is <flame>burning</flame>

Put <keyword>one block</keyword> inside with <keyword>RMB</keyword> - anything with a smelting recipe will do. In about <property>10 seconds</property> it's ready, take it out with <keyword>Shift + RMB</keyword>. Some recipes <warning>won't progress at all without bellows</warning>

The kiln can also heat a <named>clay crucible</named>: <keyword>Shift + RMB</keyword> on an empty kiln puts the crucible on top. Close it with a <named>Clay Plate</named> lid - in this mode the crucible heats up <warning>only while the bellows are pumping</warning>. <keyword>Shift + RMB</keyword> with an empty hand removes the lid once it's done

It is also the top part of the <named>bloomery</named>

<wiggly>And yes, you can wear it on your head</wiggly>
milf.quest.first_steps.label.desc:
Labels functions similar to §9§lItem Frames§r§r but can adapt to all surfaces and be physically connected to any solid block no matter the shape.§r

• By <keyword>shift-clicking</keyword>§r on a Label with an item you'll be able to change its image, showing that item you selected. §r

• Clicking on a §lLabel§r will let the player §l§9interact§r§r with the §9block§r behind, making it perfect for your §9storage systems§r. §r

• Can accept §lGlow Ink Sacks§r to make then §lglow§r in the §8dark§r. §r

• Can be §4<shake>c</shake>§r§6<shake>o</shake>§r<keyword><shake>l</shake></keyword>§2<shake>o</shake>§r<property><shake>r</shake></property>§9<shake>e</shake>§r§5<shake>d</shake>§r with §nany§r dye. §r

• Using a §7Feather§r on them will display the item name. §r
milf.quest.first_steps.lead_2.title: Lead
milf.quest.first_steps.lead_hoe.desc:
Most crops need <aqua>water</aqua> to grow, and they <warning>drink it</warning>. Water next to a field can slowly <shake amplitude=1.0 frequency=1.0>dry up</shake>, so keep an eye on it and top it up when it runs low.

If the field is far from water, <keyword>aqueducts</keyword> can carry it there.
milf.quest.first_steps.leather_helmet.de: Better than nothing, and fancy furthermore, eh?
Since looking for ores is <keyword>hella frustrating</keyword> (especially when most of the ores are escaping your vision due to... reasons), the process of <keyword>sniffing</keyword> the ores out could use a little bit more of... <keyword>sniffing!</keyword> Those <keyword>stone nose</keyword> imitations imbued with ancient sinus inducing stuff should help you with that, <positive>marking all the deposits</positive> of some specific type in the vicinity of <positive>500 blocks around you</positive> for a short duration! You won't get more of those for quite some time, so prepare <keyword>something to mark</keyword> the location of the vein in advance.
milf.quest.first_steps.lunch_basket.desc: A convenient way to <positive>store food</positive>. A lot of food. <positive>LMB</positive> to change mode, <positive>RMB</positive> with the <warning>closed</warning> one to change selected food, <positive>RMB</positive> with the <positive>opened</positive> one to <positive>eat</positive> said food. To <positive>put food</positive> in the box, <positive>RMB</positive> on the box with food.
milf.quest.first_steps.making_leather_ra: Next, get some <named>raw hide</named>. It drops from <nature>animals</nature>, so <blood>get hunting</blood>.
milf.quest.first_steps.making_leather_ta: To make <keyword>leather</keyword>, first craft a <named>Tanning Rack</named> and place it down.
milf.quest.first_steps.making_leather_th: <keyword>RMB</keyword> the <named>raw hide</named> onto the <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/making_leather_tanning_rack'><u>Tanning Rack</u></click>, then, with a <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/flint_knife'><u>knife</u></click> in hand, <keyword>RMB</keyword> the rack <property>a few times</property> to turn it into <positive>leather</positive>.
milf.quest.first_steps.mech_trowel.desc:
The <named>Trowel</named> lets you give <magic>more interesting textures</magic> to walls and floors.

When you use it, it places <wiggly>random blocks</wiggly> from your <keyword>hotbar</keyword>.
milf.quest.first_steps.millstone.desc:
To power it, <positive>leash a mob</positive> to it. <property>Any leashable mob</property> will do.

Some items are processed more <keyword>efficiently</keyword> here than by hand.

You can install a "<keyword>SPEED UPGRADE</keyword>" to <wind><bounce amplitude=1.5 frequency=1.2 phase=1.0>speed up</bounce></wind> the milling. The upgrade is a <magic>speed potion</magic>.
milf.quest.first_steps.orb_of_the_forest: A <keyword>Tree Capitator</keyword> that is... packed inside a <property>small orb</property>? <nature><bounce amplitude=1.5 frequency=1.2 phase=1.0>Gimme two please</bounce></nature> ('-')
milf.quest.first_steps.pebble.desc:
<named>Pebbles</named> have a chance to drop when breaking <keyword>gravel</keyword>, just like flint.

They can also be obtained by <keyword>LMB</keyword> with cobblestone on stone, or by <blood><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>breaking your fingers</shake></blood> obliterating cobblestone splinters barehanded. The choice is yours \<3
milf.quest.first_steps.pend_hi_wrld.desc:
ADHD edition
"R" - <keyword>Radial menu</keyword>.

Mobs - <positive>gone</positive>.

Dungeons - <warning><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>scary</shake></warning>.

Maps - <property>later</property>.

Chests - <warning>locked</warning>.

Have fun, unlock stuff.

Good luck, <positive><bounce amplitude=1.2 frequency=1.5 phase=1.0>sweetie pie</bounce></positive> \<3
milf.quest.first_steps.pet_rock.desc: The <named>perfect companion</named> for your digging sessions! Provides <positive>emotional support</positive> in the time of need and is passable as a chair when you need some structural support too! Don't forget to <positive>feed it</positive> with... something… It's not picky at all, and <positive>hydrate it</positive> at least once a day for it to grow into a <property>strong and healthy boulder</property> one day!
milf.quest.first_steps.pet_rock_on_a_lea: And, of course, don't forget to walk with your <named>cute little pet rock</named> daily! It's quite playful when you let it roam freely, so don't let it loose without the <keyword>leash</keyword>. As the good rock that it is, it'll help you <positive>locate the precious little minerals</positive> around (that it's in no way jealous of and in no way wants them all gone ('◡')) by telling you the exact amount of the <property>ores</property> and their types in the opposite direction of the side of the block you'll rub it on in a <wiggle a=0.5 f=0.5>3x3x60</wiggle> space!
milf.quest.first_steps.pot_bellows.desc:
<named>Pot bellows</named> pump air into a <named>kiln</named>. Place them right next to the kiln <keyword>while facing it</keyword>

Pump with <keyword>RMB</keyword> - or just <bounce amplitude=1.5 frequency=1.2 phase=1.0>jump on them</bounce>. One pump lasts <property>2 seconds</property>

Bellows <positive>speed up</positive> the kiln, but the <named>fire pit</named> below <warning>burns through its logs much faster</warning>

They are <wind>required</wind> to heat a <named>crucible</named> on a kiln and for some <named>kiln</named> and <named>bloomery</named> recipes
milf.quest.first_steps.potsherd.desc:
<named>Potsherds</named> are what's left of <bone>broken ceramics</bone>: they drop when you <warning><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>shatter</shake></warning> a <named>clay mold</named> after casting

Any ceramic item - a <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/clay_crucible'><u>clay crucible</u></click>, a clay plate or a mold - can also be smashed into <property>5 potsherds</property> on a <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/stone_anvil'><u>stone anvil</u></click>

And they make a decent <blood>throwing weapon</blood>: hold <keyword>RMB</keyword> to wind up and release to <wind><bounce amplitude=1.5 frequency=1.2 phase=1.0>throw</bounce></wind>. A shard that hits the ground <positive>can be picked back up</positive>
milf.quest.first_steps.q00ff5f61cb6d32b8:
Crafting on a <keyword>stick</keyword> let's you <positive>craft items</positive> without the need to <positive>place a crafting table</positive> on the ground

Put your favorite workbench on a stick in the designated curios slot and press the keybind to open it <warning>(default SHIFT + V)</warning>
milf.quest.first_steps.q67f8922e4579fa8c: If you put this ring on, you won't be able to take it off later! Seven curses will befall whoever bears it - double damage from any source, aggressive neutral creatures, weakened armor, reduced damage to monsters, eternal burning, torn soul on death and incurable insomnia. BE SURE to familiarize yourself with them before putting on the ring!
