Seven blessings will reward those who withstand - bonus Looting and Fortune levels, +300% experience, +10 Enchanting Power, unique creature drops, the functionality of the Ring of Ender, and the ability to craft and use unique relics unobtainable any other way! To unlock new crafts, a player must spend 99.5% of their TOTAL time in the world under a curse. Keep in mind that the longer you go without wearing the ring, the longer you’ll have to spend in the world with it. You'll find a way to deal with most of the curses in the future!
milf.quest.first_steps.roasting_contrapt:
The <named>roasting contraption</named> is set up <keyword>only on a fire pit</keyword> and <flame>roasts</flame> food while the pit is burning

It holds up to <property>6 items</property>, one per click with <keyword>RMB</keyword> - anything that can be cooked on a campfire. Each one is ready in about <property>10 seconds</property> and <positive>never burns</positive> afterwards

<warning>Food that is still roasting can't be taken out.</warning> Collect the ready food with <keyword>Shift + RMB</keyword> with an empty hand

Every cooked item makes the <named>fire pit</named> <warning>burn its logs a bit faster</warning>
milf.quest.first_steps.rope_and_nail.des: A <keyword>bed for daytime</keyword>. The hammock can only be placed between two Nails and Rope.
milf.quest.first_steps.saddle.desc: Keep in mind that the horses have been greatly <click action=open_quest value='basic_information/horseman'><u>improved</u></click>!
milf.quest.first_steps.selling_bin.desc: In the <named>Selling Bin</named>, you can <positive>sell</positive> the fish you've caught; the <property>price</property> depends on the fish's size and other fish characteristics.
milf.quest.first_steps.sharp_flint.desc: Simply <positive>smash</positive> a piece of <keyword>flint</keyword> against <bone>stone</bone> to <warning><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>sharpen it</shake></warning>.
milf.quest.first_steps.skillet.desc: The <named>Skillet</named> is used for pan-frying recipes - simply <positive>right-click</positive> it with a valid ingredient. It also acts as a <property>workstation</property>, letting a nearby villager become a <keyword>Chef</keyword>.
milf.quest.first_steps.starcatcher_rod.d:
The fishing system has been <property>significantly overhauled</property>, and <positive>many custom modpack items</positive> have been added to the loot, but you must use <keyword>this fishing rod</keyword> to catch fish.

You can read more about fishing and other important information in the <named>guide</named> - it's as detailed as possible!
milf.quest.first_steps.stone_anvil.desc:
The <named>stone anvil</named> is the first place to <keyword>crush</keyword> and <keyword>shape</keyword> things with a <named>hammer</named>

Put the item on it with <keyword>RMB</keyword>

Look at the anvil with a hammer in your <keyword>main hand</keyword> and markers will start running along an arc. Press <keyword>RMB</keyword> when a marker reaches <positive>the bottom of the turn</positive> - the more precise the hit, the more progress it gives

<warning>Every hit costs hammer durability</warning>, and <warning><glitch frequency=0.7 shiftChance=0.06>looking away resets the progress</glitch></warning>. <keyword>Shift + RMB</keyword> with an empty hand takes the item back
milf.quest.first_steps.stone_basin.desc:
A <named>stone basin</named> mixes up to <property>4 items</property> with <property>500 mB</property> of <aqua>liquid</aqua>

Put the items in with <keyword>RMB</keyword>, one per click, and pour the liquid in with <keyword>RMB</keyword> using a filled container like a <named>waterskin</named>

To stir, keep <keyword>both hands empty</keyword>: <keyword>hold RMB</keyword> on the basin, then <keyword>hold LMB</keyword>. Each recipe needs its own number of <wave>full turns</wave>, and stirring only works once the basin holds a valid recipe

Take the result out with <keyword>Shift + RMB</keyword> with an empty hand
milf.quest.first_steps.stone_hammer.desc: <named>Hammers</named> are important. Early on you'll use them in place of machines like <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/forge_hammer'><u>Forge Hammers</u></click>, but they have <warning>limited durability</warning> and are <property>not as resource-efficient</property>.
milf.quest.first_steps.stone_mortar_and_: Used to <positive>crush items</positive> to make them less intact
milf.quest.first_steps.strainer.desc:
<property>Passively produces</property> various <keyword>resources</keyword> depending on <keyword>mesh</keyword> in it. Has to be placed in §9river§r or §9ocean§r <magic>biome</magic>.§r

<c value=#4EC847><fade>🛈 Strainer must be under falling water</c></fade>
milf.quest.first_steps.tape_measure.desc: Since the measuring unit is... literally all around you, it's much easier to produce an accurate <keyword>tape measure</keyword>
milf.quest.first_steps.tin.title: Tin
milf.quest.first_steps.tome.desc: <keyword>Bottomless... book?</keyword> For all those pretty scribbled treatises «you» wrote about this beautiful world
You can <positive>create</positive> your own <named>fishing tournaments</named> and compete to see who's the best angler!
milf.quest.first_steps.tree_stump.desc:
Gives a <keyword>1 to 2 ratio</keyword> when chopping <keyword>logs into planks</keyword>, as opposed to the <keyword>1 to 1</keyword> in a crafting grid.

Put a log on it with <keyword>RMB</keyword>, then keep pressing <keyword>RMB</keyword> with an <named>axe</named> to <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>chop</shake> it. <warning>Every chop costs axe durability</warning>

<positive>No need to swap items</positive>: hold the <named>axe</named> in your <keyword>main hand</keyword> and the logs in your <keyword>off hand</keyword> - <keyword>RMB</keyword> on an empty stump takes a log from the off hand, and the following presses chop it
milf.quest.first_steps.twine_mesh.desc: This <keyword>mesh</keyword> can catch basic resources, such as <keyword>sand</keyword>, <keyword>gravel</keyword>, <keyword>clay</keyword> and <keyword>fish</keyword>
milf.quest.first_steps.water_animal_cont: Same as the <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/animal_cage'><u>Animal Cage</u></click>, but for <aqua>aquatic creatures</aqua> such as squids and salmon.
milf.quest.first_steps.waterskin.desc: A leather <named>waterskin</named> - your first way to carry <aqua>water</aqua> around. It holds <property>500 mB</property> and accepts <warning>water only</warning>
milf.quest.first_steps.waterskin_2.desc:
<keyword>RMB</keyword> on a <aqua>water source</aqua> to fill the waterskin. The source <positive>is not used up</positive>, so even a single puddle is enough

<keyword>RMB</keyword> on a <named>stone basin</named> to pour the water in - one full waterskin fills it completely. It can also be used in crafting - for example, <named>wheat dough</named> takes some water straight from it
milf.quest.first_steps.well_pulley.desc: A <keyword>manual well</keyword>. Produces different amounts of <keyword>water</keyword> in different biomes. Can be connected to a <property>system of aqueducts</property>
milf.quest.first_steps.wheat_dough.desc:
Put <nature>wheat</nature> in the crafting grid and a <aqua>water</aqua> container <keyword>right next to it on the right</keyword> - the recipe takes <property>100 mB</property> of water and gives back the container

You <positive>don't need an iron bucket</positive> for this - a <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/waterskin'><u>waterskin</u></click> works <wave>just as well</wave>
milf.quest.first_steps.where_s_my_ore.de:
Ore is generated by <keyword>veins</keyword>. To figure out if the ore you need is beneath your feet, you need to look for <keyword>ore samples</keyword> on the surface. As soon as you find the sample you’re looking for, feel free to dig down - sooner or later, you’ll find the ore you need. Also, most ore is <warning>hidden from view</warning>; the further you progress in the modpack, the more ore you’ll start to notice!

In the future, you'll have an <positive>easy way</positive> to find the ore you need.

You can find out at what <property>height</property> the ore you want will spawn by hovering your cursor over it in <keyword>EMI</keyword>.
milf.quest.first_steps.white_kitchen_flo: Purely <named>decorative flooring</named> for your kitchen - place it down to give the room a clean, tiled look. No functional effect on cooking.
milf.quest.first_steps.wooden_box.desc: The chest predecessor and your first(<click action=open_quest value='basic_information/plonk'><u>or not first?</u></click>) reliable storage, can store up to 9 stacks of items
milf.quest.magic_step_i.a_pickaxe_no_an_: A pickaxe? No. An axe? No. A shovel?
milf.quest.magic_step_i.advanced_alchemi:
Regular smelteries are slow, need fuel and cannot handle large amounts of slurry - it gets <warning>unstable</warning> when too much gathers in one place. The <magic><pulse>Advanced Alchemical Furnace</pulse></magic> solves all of that: it processes far more slurry at once and <positive>much faster</positive>.

<named>Structure</named> (3x3, two layers), formed with <keyword>Salis Mundus</keyword>:
- one layer: a basic <keyword>Essentia Smeltery</keyword> in the center surrounded by <property>8 Advanced Alchemical Constructs</property>;
- the other: <keyword>Alembics</keyword> in the 4 corners, <keyword>Alchemical Constructs</keyword> on the 4 sides, the center left empty.
Check the exact layout in the book entry.

<named>Power - vis instead of fuel:</named>
- <fire>Ignis</fire> makes the heat, and it needs a <warning>constant supply even when idle</warning>;
- <curse>Perditio</curse> breaks items down almost instantly;
- <aqua>Aqua</aqua> keeps the slurry from settling and causing trouble.
Perditio and Aqua are used only while smelting.

Each Advanced Alchemical Construct needs a <magic>Primordial Pearl</magic> - the book says the pearl is not consumed in the crafting, so you do not need eight of them.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.alder_sapling.de: Only saplings can mutate. Fully-grown trees will not.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.alembic.desc:
The smeltery only turns items into raw <poison>slurry</poison> - the <keyword>Arcane Alembic</keyword> placed on top distills it into individual aspects. Stack several alembics for more storage.

Essentia is taken out of an alembic with <keyword>phials</keyword>, <keyword>jars</keyword> or tubes. Running the smeltery on <fire>Alumentum</fire> makes distillation <positive>much faster</positive>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.altar.desc:
To construct an <keyword>altar</keyword>, a §lwitch§r must place §lsix <keyword>altar blocks</keyword> to form a <magic>rectangular platform</magic>.§r

<keyword>Altars</keyword> draw their power from nature, specifically from <property>plants</property> in the surrounding area. A <keyword>variety of plants</keyword> works better than having only a few.

Certain blocks may be <positive>placed on top</positive> of the <keyword>altar</keyword> to <property>multiply its effects</property>.

Upgrades have a §ltype§r, only the <keyword>best upgrade</keyword> within a type will be counted.§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.alumentum.desc: <keyword>Nitor</keyword> gives light, but barely any heat. <fire>Alumentum</fire> is its much more <shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>reactive</shake> cousin - the fuel your smeltery will burn.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.amethyst_golem_c:
free gem farm
The golem can collect gems from <keyword>amethyst</keyword>, <keyword>topaz</keyword>, and <keyword>citrine</keyword> geodes! Even better, it can turn blocks of these gems and turn them into their budding variants!

To make an Amethyst Golem, activate a Ritual of Awakening next to a Budding Amethyst Block.

You can kill the <keyword>golem</keyword> to get back the <keyword>charm</keyword>, which will easily resummon it.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.amulet_vis_craft: A portable recharge pedestal: while worn it recharges vis items in your hotbar, offhand, curios and armor.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.angry_ghost_face:
When something hits you while you wear this grim mask, the attacker has a chance to be struck by <curse><shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>Withering</shake></curse>. Serves them right.

Masks are applied by <magic>infusing</magic> a <keyword>Thaumium Fortress Helm</keyword>, so you need one first.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.anima_caster_tom:
This <keyword>tome</keyword> will allow you to <positive>crush</positive> <keyword>ore</keyword> and other items

In the future, you'll be able to <positive>create</positive> your own <magic>spell</magic> similar to this one
Allows you to share <property>knowledge of glyphs</property> in exchange for <keyword>experience</keyword>

The more <property>glyphs</property> there are, the more <keyword>experience</keyword> is required to share them.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.any_basic_gemsto:
<c value=#9966CC>Amethyst</c>§r geodes can be found in the bottom layers of the underground. §r

<c value=#E4D00A>Citrine</c>§r geodes can be found in the middle layers of the underground.§r

<c value=#4B98C0>Topaz</c>§r geodes are located in the top layers of the underground. Sometimes, they can even be found on top of the mountains! §r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.any_basic_pedest: All crafts on the pedestal can be triggered with either a <c value=#FEECD6>paintbrush</c>§r or a <c value=#FEC6DF>redstone signal</c>§r, whichever is more convenient.§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.any_brooms.desc:
One of the earliest ways of <positive>flying</positive>

After placing it down, crouch + right click to modify it
milf.quest.magic_step_i.any_brooms.title: Any Brooms
milf.quest.magic_step_i.any_colored_glow:
This block <c value=#FEECD6>does not react</c>§r to light in any way. It will always be the same color, no matter the lighting!§r

Incredibly well suited for a <c value=#CAE4C8>chromakey</c>§r, do we have any <c value=#FEECD6>content creation</c>§r enthusiasts?§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.any_colored_lamp: Just some <c value=#FEECD6>beautiful lamps</c>§r. Not all items have to have utility, right? §r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.any_gemstone_lam: These <c value=#FEECD6>Lamps</c>§r emit some <c value=#FEECD6>light</c>§r, and will also be needed in the future to improve your <c value=#9BB8ED>structures!</c>§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.any_phantom_fram:
Phantoms? Hate those guys
A <c value=#FEECD6>Phantom Frame</c>§r will become invisible once you insert an item into it.§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.any_shimmerstone: A kind of <c value=#FEECD6>lamps</c>§r, good for <c value=#9BB8ED>decorating your base</c>§r. Also emits cute <c value=#FEECD6>particles</c>§r!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.any_thaumaturge_:
<magic>Vis Crystals</magic> grow as colorful clusters in caves. Break a cluster and pick up a crystal - your fingers will <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>tingle strangely</shake>.

Then <wave>go to sleep</wave>: you will wake up with a <keyword>Dream Journal</keyword>, and only after that dream can you create the <named>Thaumonomicon</named>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.apotheosis_runes:
<keyword>Mob Spawners</keyword> can be reshaped with <magic>runes</magic>: faster spawns, more mobs, babies, burning, silence, no AI and much more.

Hold a rune and press <property>RMB</property> on a spawner to apply it. Most runes can be <magic>reversed</magic> by holding <keyword>Nether Quartz</keyword> in the other hand.

<warning>For now spawners cannot be picked up</warning> - work with them where they stand. Later in your progression you will learn to <positive>take them with you</positive>.

Look at a spawner with <keyword>Jade</keyword> to see its current stats, and check <keyword>JEI</keyword> for the exact effect and limits of every rune.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.apothic_enchanti:
Apotheosis overhauls Enchanting by adding <keyword>Enchanting Stats</keyword>.  These are special properties provided by bookshelves that change the behavior of the <keyword>Enchanting Table</keyword>. There are three primary stats, and a few secondary stats. In addition, the max level of the Enchanting Table is increased to <property>100</property>, and the max levels of most enchantments are automatically increased.

While enchanting, the most important stats are:

<positive>Eterna</positive>, a measure of enchanting strength, increasing the level cost;

<warning>Quanta</warning>, a measure of randomness, changing just how much RNG is involved;

and §5Arcana§r, a measure of mystical quality, which increases the number of enchantments received and makes rare enchantments more common.§r

<property>Secondary Stats</property>

Aside from the primary stats, there are a number of auxiliary stats that change some minor behaviors, or adjust how the primary stats behave.

<keyword>Enchanting Clues</keyword> change the number of enchantments you are shown when hovering a slot in the Enchanting Table. Typically, more clues are always better.

<keyword>Quantic Stability</keyword> ensures that Quanta will only be <positive>beneficial</positive>, instead of having a chance to cause negative effects.

<keyword>Allowing Treasure</keyword> causes treasure enchantments (such as Mending) to show up in the Enchanting Table. Though, be warned, <curse>curses</curse> are also treasure enchantments!

<keyword>Enchantment Filters</keyword> allow you to <warning>blacklist</warning> certain enchantments from the Enchanting Table. Blocks which provide this stat can be used to remove unwanted enchantments from the pool.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.arcane_bore.desc: The <keyword>Arcane Bore</keyword> <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.3>digs out</shake> an area in front of it on a redstone signal. It needs a pickaxe inside and the <named>Break</named> focus effect researched.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.arcane_ear.desc: The <keyword>Arcane Ear</keyword> <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>listens</wiggle> for a note block playing its note and sends a redstone pulse. There is also a toggle version.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.arcane_workbench: Made by sprinkling <keyword>Salis Mundus</keyword> on a block - check EMI for which one. Arcane recipes spend <property>vis</property> from the aura and <magic>Vis Crystals</magic> in addition to normal ingredients.
Placed on top of the <keyword>Arcane Workbench</keyword> or <keyword>Focal Manipulator</keyword>, it lets them draw vis from the <property>neighbouring chunks</property> too.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.arthana.desc: The §larthana§r is a ritual knife used for sacrifice. When used to kill certain mobs, they can drop rare materials. Enchanting it with Looting will increase the odds of these materials dropping.§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.athame.desc: The <keyword>Athame</keyword> is a fast and deadly weapon and you will need to use the <magic>Diamond Ritual</magic> to obtain its power
milf.quest.magic_step_i.attuned_stone.de:
An attuned stone is a diamond which has been infused with magical energy.

It can be charged to be used as a portable container for altar power, allowing the user to cast circle magic without an altar being present, and is also used in the creation of a variety of magical tools.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.bath_salts.desc:
Toss <keyword>Bath Salts</keyword> into water and it turns into a <aqua><wave>silvery, purifying liquid</wave></aqua> that brings <positive>temporary relief</positive> from Warp. The more warp you have, the shorter the protection lasts. The salts dissolve quickly if tossed around carelessly.

The research reveals itself once your Warp grows past <warning>10</warning>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.belladonna_flowe:
The plant will slowly grow and is harvestable.

Can be found in swamps or bought from the Merchant.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.bellows.desc: Self-pumping <wind>bellows</wind>: attached to a furnace (or an Infernal Furnace) they speed up smelting. Also needed for the smeltery pumps.
While not very common, Black Thorn trees are very distinctive trees. They are short and have silver-colored leaves, and are necessary for early magic.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.blazing_hellshel: The <keyword>Blazing Hellshelf</keyword> is a stronger, more aggressive <keyword>Nether</keyword>-themed bookshelf than the Glowing Hellshelf, and it also reveals an extra hidden enchantment in the table's menu, same as the Shelf of Sight.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.block_placer.des: The title speaks for itself. This machine <positive>places blocks</positive> upon receiving a <warning>redstone pulse</warning>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.blood_sigil.desc: When placed in a Mixing Cauldron, jumping inside of it three times will fill the cauldron with blood.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.book_of_shadows_: It has been noted that the book on this table consumes quite a lot of <warning>FPS</warning>, so <warning>keep that in mind!</warning>
milf.quest.magic_step_i.bookshelf.desc:
The primary means of acquiring stats is through <keyword>bookshelves</keyword>. Each bookshelf placed in a valid bookshelf location will contribute to the <keyword>Enchanting Table</keyword>. There are a total of <property>32 valid bookshelf locations</property>: the ring around the table (including corners) on the same Y-level, and one Y-level above. There must be an air block in-between the Enchanting Table and the bookshelf to be valid. Other blocks which provide stats (such as <keyword>skulls</keyword> or <keyword>candles</keyword>) must also be placed in a valid bookshelf location to contribute to the table.


Some blocks may provide stats dynamically, which means the tooltip is not completely accurate. For example, <keyword>candles</keyword> can be stacked (up to <property>4</property> in a single block space), and provide more <property>Arcana</property> when stacked.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.bookwyrm_charm.d: Augment a Ritual of Awakening with a Book and Quill to create a Bookwyrm Charm. Use it on a Storage Lectern to give it a new home while it works as your own personal warehouse manager.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.bottle_of_fading: Place these <c value=#FEECD6>microorganisms</c>§r near some food and <c value=#9BB8ED>wait</c>§r a bit. The bacteria will start to eat it and leave the <c value=#FEECD6>rests</c>§r behind. Maybe you can use this to <c value=#9BB8ED>your advantage</c>§r!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.bottle_taint.des:
A concentrated mixture of <poison>flux</poison> that reacts with almost anything to create <poison><shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>Taint</shake></poison>. Why would you want that? Sometimes progress requires risk.

The research appears once you have seen what flux overflow does - scan a <keyword>Flux Rift</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.bounce.desc: Grants the <named>"Bounce Off the Ground"</named> effect - which <positive>negates</positive> fall damage
milf.quest.magic_step_i.bounce.title: bounce
milf.quest.magic_step_i.brain_box.desc:
Normally a <magic>Thaumatorium</magic> remembers only <property>one formula</property> at a time. Attach a <keyword>Mnemonic Matrix</keyword> to its side and it can keep track of <positive>2 more formulas</positive> - each extra matrix adds another two.

Crafted from a <keyword>Clockwork Mind</keyword>, so you will need some progress in <named>Golemancy</named>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.broom.desc:
A <keyword>broom</keyword> can be used to <positive>sweep chalk away</positive> quickly, without having to spend time erasing it.

Conveniently, a <keyword>broom</keyword> can also make for an excellent <property>method of transportation</property> with some preparation.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.broom_keychain.d: Cosmetic. Combine this with any item in the crafting grid to have it hang off of your broom.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.broom_netherite_: Having this attached to your broom will let you fly in lava for some time.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.broom_seat.desc: Having this on your broom will not only let another player ride it alongside you, but will also give the broom 9 inventory slots
milf.quest.magic_step_i.broom_thruster_b:
Unreasonably fast? Maybe.

TOO fast? Never.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.broom_waterproof: Allows you to fly in water
milf.quest.magic_step_i.broom_whistle.de:
Combine this whistle with a broom in a crafting grid to bind the broom to it.

Using the whistle will them call the bound broom over to you.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.burning_spawner_:
Spawned mobs are <flame>wreathed in flame</flame>.

Does nothing to mobs that are immune to fire.

Hold the rune and press <property>RMB</property> on a <keyword>Mob Spawner</keyword> - the rune is consumed.
With <keyword>Nether Quartz</keyword> in the other hand the effect is <magic>reversed</magic> - the quartz is not consumed.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.candle.desc: When a <fire>candle</fire> is lit, it <positive>accelerates plant growth</positive>
milf.quest.magic_step_i.caster_bag.desc:
It has far more <property>storage space</property>!

§lBefore upgrading, empty your <named>Trinkets Pouch</named>§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.causality_collap:
A rift can collapse by itself during one of its chaos bursts, but that is <warning>rare</warning>. The <keyword>Causality Collapser</keyword> is an explosive made to <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>blow a rift apart</shake> on purpose.

On collapse the rift drops <curse>Void Seeds</curse> - the bigger the rift, the more seeds - and has a small chance to leave a <magic>Primordial Pearl</magic>.

Researching it needs the <named>Flux Rift</named> entry, plus <named>Infusion</named> and the <keyword>Vis Battery</keyword> from <named>Auromancy</named>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.centrifuge.desc: Splits compound essentia into its <property>components</property>. Essentia goes in from below and comes out on top - a great way to use up aspects you have no need for.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.chalice.desc: The <keyword>Chalice</keyword> works like a <property>bottomless milk bucket</property>, <positive>curing you</positive> whenever you require. The <keyword>Lapis Lazuli Ritual</keyword> will grant you this boon.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.chalice_2.desc:
A <keyword>chalice</keyword> may be placed on top of an <keyword>altar</keyword> to <property>increase its power capacity</property>. The chalice can be filled by <positive>using Redstone Soup</positive> on it.

§lChalice§r:§r
• +1x Power Capacity
milf.quest.magic_step_i.chopped_lavender: Take the dried plant and place it on a Herbalist Bench. Then, use the boline on it a few times to create chopped plants.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.chopped_rue.desc: Take the dried plant and place it on a Herbalist Bench. Then, use the boline on it a few times to create chopped plants.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.circle_magic.des:
<keyword>Circle Magic</keyword> are powerful rituals that allow one to perform many feats: <positive>teleportation</positive>, <positive>protection from monsters</positive>, <warning>entrapping monsters</warning> or even <positive>drawing out raw materials</positive> from their underground veins without a single strike of a pickaxe.

To cast <keyword>Circle Magic</keyword>, draw the specific circle for the specific ritual you want to perform, as shown in the <named>Art of Witchcraft</named> book. Then, throw the spell materials into the circle, near the <property>golden glyph</property> at the center. Finally, right click the golden glyph to activate the ritual.

Most rituals require <property>Altar Power</property>. They must be cast near an altar with enough power, but some rituals allow for that requirement to be replaced with a <keyword>Charged Attuned Crystal</keyword> thrown in with the materials.

Consult the <named>Art of Witchcraft</named> book to see what rituals are available and how to perform them.
You can <positive>collect</positive> an already drawn ritual by <positive>dropping</positive> the <keyword>talisman and redstone</keyword> into the circle, activating the ritual, and then <positive>placing it anywhere</positive> you want.

Cost: <keyword>2000 ME</keyword>
milf.quest.magic_step_i.cloth_chest.desc: Your first experiments produce <keyword>Enchanted Fabric</keyword> - the <keyword>Apprentice's Robes</keyword> made from it lower the vis cost of your work.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.clotted_cream.de: Clotted Cream removes all <c value=#C6BCE9>effects</c>§r from you, just like milk. Cream can be used as a replacement for milk in recipes, and has some of <c value=#FEECD6>its own</c>§r!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.cloud_ring.desc: A simple first infusion: the <wind>Cloudstepper Ring</wind> lets you jump higher and fall softer.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.cluster_iron.des: <named>Metal Purification</named>: drop a raw ore into the crucible with the right essentia to get a <keyword>Native Cluster</keyword>. Smelting a cluster gives <positive><bounce amplitude=1.5 frequency=1.2 phase=1.0>twice the ingots</bounce></positive>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.codex_entry.desc: This allows you to obtain a random <keyword>Level 1 glyph</keyword>; glyphs cannot be duplicated. Once you have learned all <keyword>Level 1 glyphs</keyword>, you will receive a small amount of <property>experience</property> for each codex.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.compacting_chest: <c value=#FEECD6>Compacting Chest</c>§r will try to compact all the items you put inside it in a 3x3, 2x2 or 1x1 pattern - this can be customized in the GUI.§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.condenser.desc: Too much <poison>Flux</poison> in the aura spawns Taint and worse. The <keyword>Flux Condenser</keyword> turns raw flux into flux essentia, which is much easier to handle. The entry appears once your aura gets polluted.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.condenser_lattic:
The <keyword>Flux Condenser</keyword> needs a <keyword>lattice</keyword> to actually pull flux from the aura. Attach lattice pieces on top of the condenser and to each other - more pieces work <positive>faster</positive>, but cost more essentia.

<warning>Rules:</warning> all pieces must be above the condenser, pieces farther than <property>8 blocks</property> detach, and packing many pieces into that range gives diminishing returns.
The simplest of nodes - it has no active function.

It only extends the reach of your <keyword>Pastel Network</keyword>, letting you cheaply bridge gaps between other nodes.
You may have already noticed this little icon next to pedestal output - you can place <magic>crafting tablets</magic> with desired crafts here! When the pedestal has a <magic>crafting tablet</magic> inside it, it changes behavior - now it only accepts items that could be used in a specified craft (that means that if your crafting table output is, for example, a piston, the pedestal will accept any type of planks, even if you used one specific type in the <magic>tablet</magic>) and nothing else (note: items could §o§lonly§r§r be inserted from the top of the pedestal). Then if the pedestal is powered by redstone, it will output the crafting result from the bottom and §o§lonly§r§r from the bottom§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.creeper_heart.de:
You can use the <click action=open_quest value='magic_step_i/pentacle'><u>Pentacle</u></click> to get the amount of Creeper Heart you need!

Mod creepers drop hearts too
milf.quest.magic_step_i.crucible.desc:
Once the <named>Alchemy</named> entry is researched, make it by sprinkling <keyword>Salis Mundus</keyword> on a block - check EMI for which one.

Items thrown into the crucible <wave>dissolve into essentia</wave>, and the right catalyst turns that soup into something new. Later it will even let you brew <magic>Vis Crystals</magic> from <keyword>Quartz Slivers</keyword>, so you won't have to hunt for clusters forever.
Harvested crystals lose their ability to grow. Infuse them back into <magic>placeable crystals</magic> and you can <nature>farm</nature> your own supply of primal vis crystals.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.curio_bag.desc:
A very handy <keyword>pouch</keyword> that can be opened via the <property>radial menu</property> and can be placed in the <keyword>trinket slot</keyword>!

It is also used to make a backpack.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.curio_rites.desc: The <blood>Crimson Cult</blood> guards a book called the <curse>Crimson Rites</curse>. Scan a cultist, find the book and study it - together with <named>Auromancy</named> it opens the <curse><glitch frequency=0.7 shiftChance=0.06>Eldritch</glitch></curse> branch.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.curiosity_band.d: Absorbs <positive>half the experience</positive> from orbs you collect and turns it into research knowledge. Slow, but every bit helps.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.deconstruction_t:
<named>Research Expertise</named> unlocks the <keyword>Deconstruction Table</keyword>. Put any item with aspects on it and it will slowly <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>break it apart</shake>, sometimes dropping a <property>research point</property> of a primal aspect.

A good way to get rid of junk and fuel your research at the same time.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.dioptra.desc: Shows the aura (or flux, on click) of a <property>13 chunk</property> area as a height map. A comparator can read the current chunk's level.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.distillery.desc:
The <keyword>distillery</keyword> allows witches to <positive>separate materials</positive> into their components by utilising differences in boiling and condensing points.

Processing <warning>consumes altar power</warning>, so the <keyword>distillery</keyword> must be placed accordingly.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.dominion_wand.de:
Linking tool
The Dominion Wand lets you say targets for the various Ars Nouveau blocks. It can designate homes for Amethyst Golems, storage chests for Storage Lecterns, and targets for Spell Turrets.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.dormant_shard.de: The <keyword>Dormant Shard</keyword> is used to craft an extra <keyword>Attuned Shard</keyword>, letting you link more <keyword>Warp Plates</keyword> together - place it inside an empty Warp Plate.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.dowsing_rod.desc: This dowsing rod will direct you towards swamps and jungles. Crouch + right click to choose which it will point you to. Right click to find a new one.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.dowsing_rod_2.de: Highlights geodes with bright lights, even through blocks. Most easy to see when looking down. The color of the light changes as you grow closer to the geode.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.dried_hanging_la: Once you have made the hanging variant, hold it and right click on the bottom of a block to hang it. After a while, it will turn into the useful dry variant.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.dried_hanging_ru: Once you have made the hanging variant, hold it and right click on the bottom of a block to hang it. After a while, it will turn into the useful dry variant.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.echoing_spawner_:
Spawned mobs drop an <positive>additional copy of their loot</positive>.

Can be applied <property>several times</property> - up to <property>3</property> echoes per spawner.

Hold the rune and press <property>RMB</property> on a <keyword>Mob Spawner</keyword> - the rune is consumed.
With <keyword>Nether Quartz</keyword> in the other hand one echo is <magic>removed</magic> - the quartz is not consumed.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.edges_of_the_wor: <named>Auromancy</named> is unlocked by <wave>exploring the edges of the world</wave>: descend to the <property>deepest depths</property> and climb the <property>highest peaks</property> you can find. The game will tell you in chat when each one counts.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.eldritch_eye.des:
The whispers finally make sense: the <curse>Eldritch Obelisks</curse> scattered across the world are <glitch frequency=0.7 shiftChance=0.06>doors</glitch>, and every door needs a key. The altar near an obelisk holds a keystone with <property>four empty sockets</property>.

<named>Unlocking:</named> the recipe comes from the hidden <named>Oculus</named> entry - the price of looking beyond. It needs the <named>Void Seeds</named> research and total Warp above <warning><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>50</shake></warning> (permanent + normal + temporary). Note: reaching 50 is not enough by itself - the entry is revealed only when a <curse>warp event</curse> actually happens to you (strange sounds, visions, effects), so you may have to wait for one.

Once <named>Oculus</named> shows up, it needs <property>2 Eldritch theories</property> from the <keyword>Research Table</keyword> and adds another <warning>6 Warp</warning>. Only then does the Eldritch Eye recipe unlock.

<named>Getting eyes:</named> infuse an <keyword>Eye of Ender</keyword> with a <curse>Void Seed</curse>, gold and lots of <curse>Alienis</curse>. They also drop from <blood>Eldritch Guardians</blood> and can be bought from <keyword>Pech</keyword> stalkers.

<named>Opening the way:</named> seat <property>4 Eldritch Eyes</property> in the keystone, then <wave>channel vis</wave> into the altar with your wand and hold it until the Eye opens. Walk away or let the aura run dry and the working fizzles - the vis is lost, but the eyes stay.

<warning>Once three eyes are in place, the obelisk stirs and its guardians come for you.</warning> The eyes are spent when the door opens. Beyond it lie the <curse>Outer Lands</curse> - a deadly labyrinth with a guardian at its heart.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.elemental_axe.de:
A thaumium axe infused with <aqua>water</aqua>. It chops trees <bounce amplitude=1.5 frequency=1.2 phase=1.0>from the top down</bounce> - even if you hit the bottom log - and the wood <aqua>floats</aqua> straight to you.

Hold <positive>RMB</positive> to pull all nearby items towards you. Comes with <keyword>Burrowing</keyword> and <keyword>Collector</keyword>. Hold <property>Shift</property> to use it as a normal axe.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.elemental_hoe.de:
A thaumium hoe infused with <property>order</property> and <curse>entropy</curse>. It tills a <nature>3x3 area</nature> at once.

Used on crops and plants, it works like <nature><wave>bone meal</wave></nature> at the cost of extra durability - and might even grow plants that regular bone meal cannot. Hold <property>Shift</property> to use it as a normal hoe.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.elemental_pickax:
A thaumium pickaxe infused with <fire>fire</fire> - it <flame><pulse>glows with the heat of a forge</pulse></flame>.

When you mine ore, there is a chance to get a <keyword>Native Cluster</keyword> instead (<keyword>Refining I</keyword>).

<positive>Sneak + RMB</positive> on any block sends out a <wave>sounding pulse</wave> that reveals ores hidden nearby (<keyword>Sounding II</keyword>), at the cost of some durability. Hold <property>Shift</property> while mining to use it as a normal pickaxe.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.elemental_shovel:
A thaumium shovel infused with <nature>earth</nature>. It digs dirt, sand and similar blocks in a <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>3x3 area</shake>.

<positive>RMB</positive> on a block face places a 3x3 patch of that block from your inventory; hold <property>Shift</property> to preview it and press <keyword>G</keyword> to change orientation. Comes with <keyword>Destructive</keyword>.
A thaumium sword infused with <wind>air</wind>. Every hit <wave>sweeps in a wide arc</wave>, striking foes around your target.

While blocking, it conjures a <wind>whirlwind</wind> that pushes enemies away, deflects projectiles and slowly lifts you up. <positive>Sneak + RMB</positive> toggles the whirlwind. It comes with <keyword>Arcing II</keyword>: a gust of wind hits extra targets for half the damage.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.empty_incense.de:
<keyword>Incenses</keyword> are a neat block that <property>spread herb-specific effects</property> in a specific area.

First you need to <positive>place</positive> a <keyword>chopped herb</keyword> in them by <positive>right-clicking</positive> it. After that you can light it with a <keyword>flint and steel</keyword> and it will begin spreading its <property>effect</property>. You can <positive>right-click</positive> the incense with a <keyword>Black Thorn Staff</keyword> to display its range.

<keyword>Lavender</keyword>: <property>Regeneration</property>
<keyword>Rue</keyword>: <property>Increased crop growth speed</property>
milf.quest.magic_step_i.enchantment_canv:
<c value=#FEECD6>Enchantment Canvas</c>§r helps you remove <c value=#C6BCE9>enchantments</c>§r from an item and reapply them if needed. §r

The canvas is <c value=#d33b2b>§lbound</c>§r§r to the §nitem type§r, and can only be <c value=#FEECD6>used on</c>§r the item it was originally used on.§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.epitaph.desc: Carry the <keyword>Epitaph</keyword> in your inventory, and if you <blood><fade minAlpha=0.3 frequency=0.8>die</fade></blood>, it will be consumed to mark your place of death with a <keyword>Fleeting Memorial</keyword>. Any <keyword>Waystone</keyword> can then offer it as a teleport destination - once you teleport there, the memorial disappears.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.essence_of_the_f:
When they grow from saplings, Black Thorn trees have a chance to create Essence of the Forest in their trunk. These will be easily visible on their black bark. Right click these while holding a Boline to harvest them. After harvesting, the logs will slowly regrow new Essences in place of the harvested ones.

They're useful for magic, and they are also yummy.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.essentia_crystal: The reverse of the smeltery: it pulls essentia from your tubes and slowly turns it into <magic>Vis Crystals</magic>. Feed it vis to make it work faster.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.essentia_input.d:
The <keyword>Filling Essentia Transfuser</keyword> takes essentia from a <property>tube network</property> or another essentia source and sends it <wave>through the air</wave> into <keyword>Warded Jars</keyword> up to <property>16 blocks</property> away in the direction it faces.

It uses the same trick that keeps essentia stable during infusion - now outside the altar. Great for filling a jar wall without running tubes to every jar.
The <keyword>Emptying Essentia Transfuser</keyword> does the opposite: it <wave>draws essentia out</wave> of jars within range and puts it into <property>tubes</property> or devices that need a specific type of essentia.

Pair it with the filling one to build a compact essentia storage that feeds your machines without a single tube between the jars.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.essentia_reservo: Stores up to <property>256 essentia</property> of any mix of types - void metal keeps them from blending.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.eternal_snowball: An inexhaustable barrage of <keyword>snowballs</keyword> can be obtained by performing the <keyword>Quartz Ritual</keyword>
milf.quest.magic_step_i.ethereal_bloom.d:
A <nature>Shimmerleaf</nature> flower whose dormant purifying power has been awakened in the crucible. Plant it, and its <magic><wave>soft glow</wave></magic> slowly but surely restores land corrupted by magic within about <property>8 blocks</property> back to its <positive>natural state</positive>.

It does not fight <poison><shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>Taint</shake></poison> head-on - but tainted growths cannot survive for long outside their native ground and <positive>wither away</positive> on purified soil. A few blooms around your base are cheap insurance against your own experiments with <poison>flux</poison>.

Requires the <keyword>Ethereal Bloom</keyword> research in the Alchemy section (<property>2</property> observations and <property>1</property> theory). Brew it in the <keyword>crucible</keyword> from a <nature>Shimmerleaf</nature>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.everfull_urn.des:
An <wave>endless fountain</wave> of water: fill buckets and bottles from it, and it automatically tops up liquid containers within <property>2 blocks</property> - perfect for keeping your <keyword>crucible</keyword> full.

Each bucket of water costs <property>1 vis</property> from the aura. The water tastes a bit... <glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.05>odd</glitch>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.experience_obeli: Stores up to <keyword>~1000 levels</keyword>, <positive>attracts experience</positive> from nearby, with an adjustable <keyword>experience collection radius</keyword>
milf.quest.magic_step_i.feel_the_first_t: Forbidden knowledge leaves <curse><glitch frequency=0.7 shiftChance=0.06>Warp</glitch></curse> on your mind. Some fades, some is permanent. The <keyword>Sanity Checker</keyword> shows how deep you have sunk.
Feel the first touch of Warp
milf.quest.magic_step_i.fetchling_helmet: §oUnbelievably useful§r, but keep in mind, it's <c value=#FEECD6>§lvery</c>§r fragile§r! §r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.flux_rift.desc:
The next step into <curse>forbidden knowledge</curse> lies beyond a <curse><glitch frequency=0.7 shiftChance=0.06>tear in reality</glitch></curse>. When <poison>flux</poison> in a chunk climbs above roughly <property>three quarters</property> of its aura, a <keyword>Flux Rift</keyword> may open there.

So you have to <warning>pollute an area on purpose</warning>: careless work with essentia does it fast - for example a basic <keyword>Essentia Smeltery</keyword> without venting ports turns part of the essentia into flux. Do it <warning>away from your base</warning>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.flux_rift.desc.1:
A rift <wave>feeds on flux</wave> and grows, slowly loses stability and from time to time releases a burst of chaos - <poison>wisps, taint seeds</poison> and worse. Its edges <blood>hurt</blood> on touch.

Find one and <positive><pulse>scan it with your Thaumometer</pulse></positive> - just looking is not enough: the scan is what moves your research forward (it unlocks the <named>Flux</named> and <named>Flux Rift</named> entries) and completes this quest. The real prize is inside: when a rift <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>collapses</shake>, it leaves <curse>Void Seeds</curse> behind.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.flux_rift.title: Flux Rift
milf.quest.magic_step_i.flux_scrubber.de:
Slowly removes any <poison>flux</poison> - both <poison>Goo</poison> and <poison>Gas</poison> - within <property>16 blocks</property>.

It needs <wind>Aer</wind> vis from a nearby <keyword>Vis Relay</keyword> or an <magic>energized node</magic>. As a bonus it reclaims a bit of the flux as <magic>Praecantatio</magic> essentia. Its internal buffer is <warning>tiny</warning> and it keeps working when full, so empty it regularly if you want all the essentia.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.focus_1.desc: A <keyword>Blank Lesser Focus</keyword> is an empty canvas. Shape it into a spell at the <keyword>Focal Manipulator</keyword>, then attach it to your wand.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.focus_2.desc: Infusion lets you craft an <keyword>Advanced Focus</keyword>, which can hold more complex spell patterns.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.focus_pouch.desc:
Carrying a whole collection of foci gets annoying fast. The <keyword>Focus Pouch</keyword> keeps them all in one place.

When you <property>swap the focus</property> on your wand, it looks in the pouch first, and the removed focus goes <bounce amplitude=1.5 frequency=1.2 phase=1.0>straight back in</bounce>. <positive>RMB</positive> the pouch to put foci in or take them out by hand. It also fits into the <keyword>belt</keyword> curio slot.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.fortress_helm.de: <keyword>Thaumium Fortress</keyword> armor - heavy, sturdy and infused for serious protection.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.free_cobble_or_n: You can read about all the combinations right on the glyph itself in <keyword>EMI</keyword>
What could be <c value=#FEECD6>better</c>§r than fresh chocolate? I don't know, do you? <glitch frequency=1.2 shiftChance=0.1>§0Damn it, the 4th wall is crumbling... You didn't see anything!§r</glitch>§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.fume_filter.desc: A <keyword>fume filter</keyword> can be added to <keyword>fume funnels</keyword> to further increase yield. With <keyword>two filters</keyword>, success is <positive>guaranteed</positive>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.fume_funnel.desc:
Adding <keyword>fume funnels</keyword> to the left and right of your <keyword>witch's oven</keyword> can <positive>drastically improve</positive> it's <keyword>yield</keyword>.

A third <keyword>fume funnel</keyword> can be placed on top of the <keyword>witch oven</keyword> as a <magic>decorativechimney</magic>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.gather_node_2.de:
Actively requests items/fluid from other nodes and places them in its connected inventory, based on its <warning>filter</warning>.

Request order:
1. <keyword>Sender Nodes</keyword>
2. <keyword>Provider Nodes</keyword>
3. <keyword>Storage Nodes</keyword>
milf.quest.magic_step_i.gather_some_gem_:
Dust can be obtained from gems by using the power of the <c value=#9BB8ED>anvil</c>§r, or rather <c value=#9BB8ED>gravity</c>§r. Just §l<wiggle>drop</wiggle>§r the anvil on the <c value=#9BB8ED>item</c>§r and it will be crushed!§r

Well... Or... Use a <keyword>macerator</keyword>....
milf.quest.magic_step_i.geode_shelf.desc: The <keyword>Geode-Encased Bookshelf</keyword> grants <positive>Quantic Stability</positive> - it reduces the chance of getting a curse from your enchants. Pair it with a <keyword>Deepshelf of Arcane Treasures</keyword> to safely fish for treasure enchantments.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.glow_vision_gogg: By using §3glow ink sacks§r (or §k<property>Light Blue Ink</property>§r), it grants the wearer <c value=#FEECD6>night vision</c>§r! §r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.goggles_revealin:
<named>Artifice</named> requires the second stage of <named>Metallurgy</named> (Thaumium) and scans of the <magic>Sensus</magic> and <magic>Machina</magic> aspects.

<keyword>Goggles of Revealing</keyword> show the vis and essentia inside things and <positive>reduce vis costs</positive>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.golden_chalk.des: No ritual circle is complete without a golden sigil at it's center.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.golem.desc:
Your first <magic>Golem</magic>! Unlike wild iron and snow golems, it has a <keyword>clockwork mind</keyword> that actually <property>takes orders</property>.

<named>Assembly:</named> open the <keyword>Golem Press</keyword> and pick up to 5 components - <property>material</property>, <property>head</property>, <property>arms</property>, <property>legs</property> and an optional <property>addon</property>. The press lists the items you need in your inventory and shows the resulting traits, health, armor and damage. It also needs <magic>Machina</magic> essentia through the ports under the press.

<named>Handling:</named> a golem does nothing without <keyword>Control Seals</keyword>. With no tasks it returns to where it was placed. <positive>Sneak + RMB</positive> picks it up. Click it with <aqua>dye</aqua> to color it and limit it to seals of that color.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.golem.desc.1:
<named>Materials:</named>
- <nature>Greatwood</nature> - light and agile, but weak;
- <property>Clay</property> - cheap, fireproof and fairly light, not sturdy;
- <keyword>Iron</keyword> - sturdy and fireproof, but heavy;
- <named>Brass</named> - lighter frame thanks to fine construction, less sturdy than iron;
- <magic>Thaumium</magic> - like iron, but tougher;
- <curse>Void Metal</curse> - lighter than iron and <positive>repairs itself</positive>.

Better materials unlock as you progress in <named>Metallurgy</named> and the <curse>Eldritch</curse> branch.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.golem.desc.2:
<named>Parts:</named>
- <property>Heads</property>: Clockwork, Perceptive (sees farther), Smart (biothaumic brain) and their combinations;
- <property>Arms</property>: Basic, <positive>Fine Manipulators</positive> (dexterous), <warning>Breakers</warning> (break blocks), <blood>Claws</blood> and <blood>Dart Launchers</blood> (combat);
- <property>Legs</property>: Basic, <wind>Uni-wheel</wind> (fast, can't jump), <bone>Climbing</bone> (scales walls), <wind>Levitation</wind> (flies, but slower);
- <property>Addons</property>: Armor Plating, Aggression Module, Carry Frame (two stacks of items).

Many parts are unlocked by their own research in the <named>Golemancy</named> tab.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.golem_builder.de: Build the structure from the book and use <keyword>Salis Mundus</keyword> on it to get a <keyword>Golem Press</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.golem_fetter.des:
A simple way to put your golems on <warning>pause</warning>. While the <keyword>Golem Fetter</keyword> gets a <property>redstone signal</property>, any golem that walks over it <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>freezes in place</shake> and drops its current task.

Turn the signal off and the golem goes back to work. Handy for doors, checkpoints or holding golems back until a job is ready.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.grapple_gun.desc: <keyword>Rare Earth</keyword> magnets enhanced with vis stick to <bounce amplitude=1.5 frequency=1.2 phase=1.0>virtually anything</bounce>. Mobility is key!
milf.quest.magic_step_i.grappling_hook.d: in skilled hands, a §lvery§r fast way to move around§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.grinning_devil_f:
<wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>Laughing in the face of danger</wiggle> pays off: this mask does not reduce the number of <curse><glitch frequency=0.7 shiftChance=0.06>Warp</glitch></curse> events, but makes them <positive>less severe</positive>.

Masks are applied by <magic>infusing</magic> a <keyword>Thaumium Fortress Helm</keyword>, so you need one first.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.hand_mirror.desc: A pocket version: open it anywhere and send items from your inventory to the linked mirror. It can only <warning>send</warning>, not receive.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.hanging_rue.desc: It can be found in the nature generation, or you can buy it on the <click action=open_quest value='diverse_content/market'><u>market</u></click>!
milf.quest.magic_step_i.heartbound_chest: <c value=#9BB8ED>This chest</c>§r is literally a safe, only the person who placed it down can open it. Incredible <c value=#C6BCE9>magic</c>§r!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.helm_of_revealin:
Gives a <keyword>Thaumium Fortress Helm</keyword> all the functions of the <keyword>Goggles of Revealing</keyword> - no more choosing between <property>protection</property> and <property>utility</property>. It does <warning>not</warning> give the goggles' vis discount.

This upgrade can be combined with any of the faceplates.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.hungry_chest.des: A <keyword>Hungry Chest</keyword> <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>gobbles up</shake> any items that touch it.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.ignore_condition:
The spawner <magic>ignores all spawn rules</magic> - light, grass for animals and everything else. Only free space and the mob limit still matter.

A direct upgrade of the <keyword>Rune of Perpetual Twilight</keyword>.

Hold the rune and press <property>RMB</property> on a <keyword>Mob Spawner</keyword> - the rune is consumed.
With <keyword>Nether Quartz</keyword> in the other hand the effect is <magic>reversed</magic> - the quartz is not consumed.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.ignore_light_spa:
The spawner <soul>ignores light levels</soul>: monsters spawn in bright light, and light-loving mobs in the dark.

Hold the rune and press <property>RMB</property> on a <keyword>Mob Spawner</keyword> - the rune is consumed.
With <keyword>Nether Quartz</keyword> in the other hand the effect is <magic>reversed</magic> - the quartz is not consumed.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.ignore_players_s:
The spawner works <wind>without a player nearby</wind> - the activation range no longer matters.

<wiggle amplitude=0.3 frequency=0.4>The mobs might get lonely.</wiggle>

Hold the rune and press <property>RMB</property> on a <keyword>Mob Spawner</keyword> - the rune is consumed.
With <keyword>Nether Quartz</keyword> in the other hand the effect is <magic>reversed</magic> - the quartz is not consumed.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.infernal_furnace: To research it you must go <flame>somewhere really hot</flame>. The <fire>Infernal Furnace</fire> is a multiblock smelter that sometimes gives bonus output.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.infused_beverage: Anyone <c value=#FEECD6>interested</c>§r is invited to read the §l<c value=#e4affa>Spectrum</c>§r§r guidebook, no point in copying the information to here!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.infused_spawner_:
A blank rune <magic><pulse>charged with enchanting power</pulse></magic>.

It opens the way to the strongest runes: <keyword>Stupor</keyword>, <keyword>Defiance</keyword>, <keyword>Solitude</keyword> and <keyword>Echoes</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.infusion_altar.d:
The <keyword>Runic Matrix</keyword> is the core of the <magic>Infusion Altar</magic>. Build the structure from the <named>Infusion</named> entry and use <keyword>Salis Mundus</keyword> on it to form the pillars.

The item to infuse goes on the central pedestal, the ingredients on <keyword>Arcane Pedestals</keyword> around it. Keep the altar <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.3><warning>symmetrical</warning></shake> - instability can go very wrong.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.infusion_enchant: <named>Infusion Enchantment</named> lets you add special infusion enchantments to almost any tool or weapon, not only thaumium ones. Each rank costs more essentia.
Placed under the altar pillars: the <keyword>Speed Stone</keyword> makes infusion faster but a bit pricier, the <keyword>Cost Stone</keyword> makes it cheaper but slower.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.ingot_brass.desc: <named>Metallurgy</named> starts with <keyword>Alchemical Brass</keyword>, brewed right in the crucible. Mechanisms, plates and most devices are built from it.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.ingot_thaumium.d: <magic>Thaumium</magic> is iron soaked in pure magic. You will need it <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0><warning>everywhere</warning></shake>: it opens <named>Artifice</named>, the <keyword>Essentia Smeltery</keyword> and most of the infusion recipes.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.ingot_void.desc: A <curse>Void Seed</curse> bound with metal becomes <keyword>Void Metal</keyword> - the material of the strongest gear in the mod. Beware the <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5><warning>warp</warning></shake> it brings.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.inlay.desc:
The <keyword>Stabilizer</keyword> can do more than calm the altar: when a discharge would knock an item off a pedestal - or <warning>destroy</warning> it - the hit can be redirected into the Stabilizer instead.

For that, connect the pedestals to the Stabilizer with <keyword>Redstone Inlay</keyword>. It is placed like redstone and has the same <property>15 block</property> limit; pedestals pass the charge on. A protected pedestal shows <magic>runes</magic> at its base.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.jar_brain.desc:
A reanimated <blood>zombie brain</blood> that keeps some of its old hunger: it <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>feeds on the thoughts</wiggle> of creatures slain nearby and stores their <positive>experience</positive>.

Give the jar a good shake to take the experience out. Particles above it show when it is full. It also boosts <magic>enchanting</magic> far better than bookshelves.

Infused from a <keyword>Warded Jar</keyword> with a <keyword>Zombie Brain</keyword>, spider eyes and a water bucket.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.jar_normal.desc: <keyword>Warded Jars</keyword> store essentia <property>indefinitely</property>. Attach a <keyword>Label</keyword> to lock a jar to a single aspect.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.jar_of_light.des: The <keyword>Jar of Light</keyword> summons a light that follows you around - use it again to dismiss it. A simple portable light source that doesn't need to be placed.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.kettle.desc:
Creating a <keyword>brew, infusion or potion</keyword> is a simple process, requiring either a <keyword>witch's cauldron</keyword> or <keyword>kettle</keyword>.

First, you must <positive>fill</positive> your <keyword>cauldron or kettle</keyword> with water from a <keyword>bucket</keyword>. You will know it is full if no more water can fit.

Next, <positive>place</positive> a <property>heat source</property> underneath your vessel such as <warning>fire</warning>, <warning>lava</warning> or a <keyword>campfire</keyword>. After a few seconds, the water should begin to <keyword>boil</keyword>.

The final step, after filling the vessel and waiting for it to boil, is to <positive>drop your ingredients</positive> into the vessel, in order, one by one

The water should start to <property>change colour</property>. Once added, the brew needs to <keyword>boil for a few seconds</keyword> to finish.

If you make a mistake during brewing, such as adding the <warning>wrong ingredient</warning> or removing the heat source, your brew will <warning>spoil</warning>.

When spoiled, the brew will <warning>turn brown</warning> and need to be <positive>removed using an empty bucket</positive>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.lamp_arcane.desc: The <keyword>Arcane Lamp</keyword> places <pulse><magic>invisible light</magic></pulse> in dark spots around it. No more torch spam.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.lamp_fertility.d:
Animals bathed in the gentle <magic>pink glow</magic> of this lamp fall into a <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>very romantic mood</wiggle> and look for a partner of their kind to breed - an <positive>automatic animal farm</positive> without feeding by hand.

It does nothing if there are already <property>8 or more</property> animals of a species nearby. It runs on <magic>Desiderium</magic> essentia, fed straight from an <keyword>essentia tube</keyword>. A <property>redstone signal</property> turns it off.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.lamp_growth.desc:
Light is good for plants - add some magic and it gets <positive>much better</positive>. Crops and other plants where this lamp's light shines brightest <nature><wave>grow much faster</wave></nature> than normal.

Unlike the <keyword>Arcane Lamp</keyword> it is made from, it gives <warning>barely any light</warning> on its own until it gets <nature>Herba</nature> essentia, fed straight from an <keyword>essentia tube</keyword>. A <property>redstone signal</property> turns it off.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.lava_sponge.desc: Yeah, it's a <c value=#FEECD6>sponge</c>§r. A <c value=#ff6600>Lava Sponge</c>§r. Any more questions...?§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.levitator.desc: Lifts any item or creature above it up to <wind>8 blocks</wind>; sneak to go down slowly. Placed sideways it pushes things along. Uses <property>1 vis per second</property> while working.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.lighting.title: lighting
milf.quest.magic_step_i.liquid_death_buc:
A liquid made mostly of <curse>entropy</curse> and <bone>death</bone>. It is so toxic that it <blood>dissolves flesh, bone</blood> and even harder things - nothing alive survives a swim in it.

The useful part: the <magic>essentia</magic> of every creature it dissolves forms into <magic>Vis Crystals</magic> you can harvest. A pool of it at the bottom of a mob farm turns mobs into crystals.

Brewed in the <keyword>crucible</keyword> from an empty bucket with a lot of <bone>Mortuus</bone>, <curse>Perditio</curse> and some <magic>Alkimia</magic>. <warning>Do not fall in.</warning>
milf.quest.magic_step_i.lucky_pickaxe.de:
What could be better than a pickaxe with §l<c value=#FEECD6>Fortune III</c>§r§r, and from such <c value=#FEECD6>simple resources</c>§r too? §r

Too bad its <c value=#9BB8ED>durability</c>§r leaves much to be desired, but it's better than nothing!§r
The <c value=#C6BCE9>Pigment</c>§r is a purer form of dye, obtained from the colored <c value=#CAE4C8>trees</c>§r you have created. §r
Simply break the leaves of the tree.

§n§l<c value=#FEECD6>Tip:</c>§r§r§r§r Use a <c value=#FEECD6>hoe</c>§r to destroy the <c value=#CAE4C8>leaves</c>§r, it's much faster than with a fist!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.magical_light.de:
<keyword>Magnum Torch</keyword> adds three kinds of very powerful torches that <positive>prevent mobs from spawning</positive> in a huge area. Only natural spawns will be prevented, so e.g. spawners and raids still work as they should.

• <property>Diamond</property>: All monsters, such as zombies, skeletons, creepers, spiders, phantoms and so on.

• <property>Emerald</property>: Passive mobs such as wandering traders and trader llamas (animals are technically affected, but not really, since they only spawn during world gen or from breeding, which are both unaffected by magnum torches)

• <property>Amethyst</property>: Cave and water mobs, such as bats, all squids, axolotls, and all fish
milf.quest.magic_step_i.mandrake_flowers:
The plant will slowly grow and is harvestable.

Can be found in swamps or bought from the Merchant.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.mind_clockwork.d: <named>Golemancy</named> opens only after <named>Artifice</named>, <named>Auromancy</named> and <named>Infusion</named>. The <keyword>Clockwork Mind</keyword> is a small but working <glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.05>artificial intelligence</glitch>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.mirror.desc: A linked pair of <magic>Magic Mirrors</magic> sends items through the <curse>void between worlds</curse> - even across dimensions. Throw or pipe items into one and they come out of the other.
The same trick as <magic>Magic Mirrors</magic>, but for <aqua>essentia</aqua>: a linked pair carries essentia across any distance.

<warning>Limitation:</warning> you <warning>cannot pipe</warning> essentia into them. They only pass along essentia that something is <wave>pulling</wave> from a source - for example an <keyword>Infusion Matrix</keyword> drawing from your jars. In practice, the altar can draw from jars on the other side of the mirror.

Like item mirrors, they put heavy stress on the aura and generate <poison><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>flux</shake></poison>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.molten_rod.desc:
The <c value=#FEECD6>Molten Rod</c>§r allows you to catch <c value=#ECB4B4>creatures</c>§r and do <c value=#ff6600>lava fishing</c>§r.§r

§l<c value=#FEECD6>Tip</c>§r: Not all fishing rods can catch <c value=#ECB4B4>creatures</c>§r. Those that can have a special <c value=#FEECD6>description</c>§r, and you can use <c value=#ff6600>REI</c>§r to find out which rods can catch <c value=#ECB4B4>creatures</c>§r.§r

<c value=#9BB8ED>Spoiler</c>§r: this isn't the earliest rod you unlock, just keep in mind!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.mugwort_bush.des:
The bush will slowly grow and is harvestable.

Can be found in swamps or bought from the Merchant.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.multitool.desc: It's a <c value=#FEECD6>shovel</c>§r, a <c value=#9BB8ED>pickaxe</c>§r, an <c value=#C7E2E9>axe</c>§r, and a <c value=#CAE4C8>hoe</c>§r §nall in one§r. It's like a Swiss tool!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.mutandis.desc:
§lMutations§r

While many plants are naturally occurring, herbology often requires witches to mutate existing plants to suit their needs.

This is done using <keyword>mutandis</keyword> or <keyword>mutandis extremis</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.mutandis.desc.1:
§lMutandis§r

Using <keyword>mutandis</keyword> on a block will make it start <property>mutating</property>, giving it a chance to turn into a different block based on nearby <magic>mutagens</magic> after a few minutes.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.mutandis.desc.2:
§lMutagens§r

<magic>Mutagens</magic> are the blocks a witch needs to place in the area surrounding a mutating plant. The more mutagens you place, the more likely it is for the plant to <property>mutate</property>.

The block in the center is the plant being mutated, while the surrounding blocks are its <magic>mutagens</magic>.

Check the relevant entry in the Art of Witchcraft book to see what mutations need which mutagens.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.nether_chalk.des: The Nether Chalk represents fire, the demonic, and The Nether.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.nitor_yellow.des: Your first alchemical creation - a tiny <flame>ever-burning flame</flame>. Completing it finishes the <named>Alchemy</named> entry and opens the rest of the branch.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.no_ai_spawner_ru:
Spawned mobs have <soul>no AI</soul>: they just float in place and do nothing - but unlike true no-AI mobs they can still be <property>pushed</property>.

<positive>The best rune for big farms</positive>: much lower server load and easy-to-control mobs.

Hold the rune and press <property>RMB</property> on a <keyword>Mob Spawner</keyword> - the rune is consumed.
With <keyword>Nether Quartz</keyword> in the other hand the effect is <magic>reversed</magic> - the quartz is not consumed.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.node_in_a_jar.de:
A way to <magic>move aura nodes</magic>. Enclose the node in a shell of <keyword>glass</keyword>, cap it with a roof of <keyword>wooden slabs</keyword> and strike the glass with your wand - the node gets trapped in a jar you can pick up.

The ritual costs a <warning>lot of vis</warning> from your wand and has a very good chance to <warning><shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>damage the node</shake></warning>.

While trapped, the node is <soul>dormant</soul>: none of its stranger behaviours, and it refills from the aura at half speed. You can still draw vis from it with a wand. Click the jar with a wand to <positive>set the node free</positive> - the jar breaks in the process.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.node_stabilizer_:
Does everything the normal <keyword>Node Stabilizer</keyword> does, with two big differences:

- weaker nodes still cannot drain the stabilized one, but now <property>it can drain them</property> - a way to grow your main node at the expense of its neighbours;
- much better chances to cure <warning>unstable</warning> and <curse>fading</curse> nodes.

The price: it takes far more power from the node. Its vis still does not drop, but even a <positive>bright</positive> node will barely <warning>refill at all</warning>.
Pries a node's tiny gateway open so vis <wave>pours out in a torrent</wave> - the node becomes <pulse><magic>energized</magic></pulse>.

<named>How:</named> put a <keyword>Node Stabilizer</keyword> directly under the node and the <keyword>Transducer</keyword> above it, then give a <property>redstone signal to the transducer only</property>. The node loses its stored vis while converting - this takes a while.

<warning>Danger:</warning> keep both devices running from now on. If the transducer loses its signal for too long, the node reverts. If the stabilizer is ever <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>removed or powered by redstone</shake>, the energized node <blood>explodes</blood>, spewing flux goo and gas around.

<named>What changes:</named> compound aspects are split into <property>primals</property> while energized. The node refills by gulping raw vis straight from the local aura - fast, but it <warning>drains the land</warning>. Hungry, tainted and sinister nodes stop their nasty behaviour while energized, and a tainted node feeds on <poison>flux</poison> instead, cleaning its surroundings.

Draw from it with a wand, through a <keyword>Recharge Pedestal</keyword> nearby, or carry the stream elsewhere with <keyword>Vis Relays</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.novice_spell_boo:
<positive>Left Alt</positive> to open book menu
Next Spell <positive>X</positive>
Previous Spell <positive>Z</positive>

By unlocking new <keyword>glyphs</keyword>, you increase your <property>mana pool</property>, which helps you cast more complex spells.

Currently, only <keyword>level 1 glyphs</keyword> are available to you.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.omni_gather_node: It works with both fluids and items at the same time!
milf.quest.magic_step_i.omni_provider_no: It works with both fluids and items at the same time!
milf.quest.magic_step_i.omni_sender_node: It works with both fluids and items at the same time!
milf.quest.magic_step_i.omni_storage_nod: It works with both fluids and items at the same time!
milf.quest.magic_step_i.onyx_shard.desc:
<c value=#FEECD6>Catch</c>§r the right phase of the moon and create your first <c value=#4040a1>onyx</c>§r!§r

You can create a §ostack§r of <c value=#4040a1>onyx</c>§r at once with 1 craft!§r

To create <keyword>Onyx</keyword>, you need a <keyword>new moon</keyword>.

<click action=open_quest value='magic_step_i/crystal_ball'><u>This</u></click> may help you.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.otherwhere_chalk: The Otherwhere Chalk is used for Rites having to do with teleportation and The End.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.paintbrush.desc: Use the <keyword>brush</keyword> and the <keyword>pigment</keyword> you found to <positive>repaint</positive> the <keyword>sapling</keyword> you made earlier in a different color
milf.quest.magic_step_i.pastel_network.d: The Pastel Network is a set of nodes that transfer items without line of sight - a much better alternative to hoppers, minecarts and pipes. Every node connects to others within a 12 block radius, and must be placed against an inventory to work. Nodes only interact with other nodes of the same color - painting them lets you run several separate networks close together without them mixing. Removing the redstone signal disables a node's function: Gather Nodes stop requesting, Provider Nodes stop offering, Sender Nodes stop pushing, and Storage Nodes can neither accept nor give items. Check out the list of node upgrades in the guidebook!
Automates simple crafts (planks to sticks, ingots to nuggets, etc.): takes items from the inventory above and puts results into the one below.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.paving_stone_bar:
A mystical <magic>ward</magic> that stops most creatures - and golems - from crossing it. It cannot stop <warning>other players</warning> and is not 100% foolproof.

For best results, build an <property>unbroken line</property> between your area and the outside. A redstone signal disables it. The runes above show its state: <magic>purple</magic> - blocking something, <aqua>blue</aqua> - disabled by redstone, <warning>red</warning> - there is a gap in the ward.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.paving_stone_tra:
Arcane stone soaks up enchantments like a sponge. This one adds a <bounce amplitude=1.5 frequency=1.2 phase=1.0>bounce to your step</bounce>: anything walking across it gets <positive>more speed and agility</positive> for a couple of seconds.

Lay a road of them between your base and the places you visit often.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.pentacle.desc:
Using the <keyword>Cinnabar Ritual</keyword> you can obtain the incredibly powerful <keyword>Pentacle</keyword>. Whatever mob is <positive>sacrificed</positive> to obtain it will result in the Pentacle <positive>spawning that mob for eternity</positive>.

For the <keyword>pentagram</keyword> to work, you must meet the <keyword>spawning conditions</keyword> for the mob you want to summon; for example, to summon a <keyword>bat</keyword>, you need a <keyword>stone block</keyword> beneath the pentagram and <keyword>dim lighting</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.pinnacle_spawner:
<flame><wave>An unstoppable engine of mob creation.</wave></flame> The last <keyword>tier rune</keyword> brings a spawner to its <magic>maximum potential</magic>.

Sets the spawner's core stats <property>directly</property>:
- spawn delay: <positive>20-20</positive> ticks;
- mobs per spawn: <positive>16</positive>;
- max nearby mobs: <positive>32</positive>;
- activation range: <positive>48</positive> blocks.

Hold the rune and press <property>RMB</property> on a <keyword>Mob Spawner</keyword> - the rune is consumed. Tier runes <warning>cannot be reversed</warning>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.poppet.desc:
Poppets can be spun with various materials to create magical poppets. These poppets will grant the target magical effects when certain conditions occur, at the cost of the Poppet's durability. The poppet has to either be in the target's inventory or on a Poppet shelf to take effect.

To give the Poppet a target, you must first use a Taglock Kit on the target and use it on the Poppet (crouch + right click with the taglock in the off-hand)

Poppets can also be Infused or made Sturdy.

Infused Poppets have greater effects. When a tool breaks, a Tool Poppet will prevent it from breaking and restore some durability. An Infused Poppet will instead FULLY restore that tool's durability.

Sturdy Poppets have additional durability.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.poppet_shelf.des: Instead of being in an inventory, Poppets can also be placed on a Poppet Shelf to be active. Each shelf can hold up to 4 Poppets.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.portal_block.des:
An empty world with nothing in it, handy to build your base somewhere in <keyword>infinty</keyword>!

P.S. To unlock the craft, improve your old pedestal!
milf.quest.magic_step_i.portal_scroll.de: The <keyword>Portal Scroll</keyword> opens a physical portal to a chosen destination that players, mobs and items can walk through - it disappears after <property>5 minutes</property>. Use a <keyword>Waystone</keyword> to "Return to Portal" and go back through it while it's still open.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.precision_dispel:
The Precision Dispeller is a specialized piece of machinery that allows you to selectively remove enchantments you don't want from an item, and remove curses for an XP cost of 30 base levels. It also returns slightly more XP than a vanilla grindstone.

The Precision Dispeller does not require binding to an Obelisk. When unbound, it will dispense any XP gained as XP orbs the same way as a vanilla grindstone, and draw XP from the player when removing curses.

However, should you want to, the Precision Dispeller can be bound to an Obelisk the same way as the Fountain. When bound, experience gained will be added to the Obelisk internal reservoir instead of being released as XP orbs. Likewise, the XP cost from curse removal will first be deducted from the Obelisk, and only deducted from the player if the amount of XP in the Obelisk is insufficient.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.present.desc:
You can make a <c value=#FEECD6>present</c>§r and give it to your <c value=#CAE4C8>friend</c>§r, or your <c value=#d33b2b>unfriend</c>§r!§r

You can also <c value=#C6BCE9>color</c>§r it however you like. More details can be discovered in the <c value=#FEECD6>Spectrum Guidebook</c>§r!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.primal_crusher.d: A pickaxe and a shovel at once, <shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>constantly shifting</shake> between forms. Better than both and also good against Taint.
Makes the items/fluid in its connected inventory available to the network.

It does not push items/fluid itself - only <keyword>Gather Nodes</keyword> can request and pull them.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.purple_archwood_:
Use <keyword>Mutandis</keyword> to create an <keyword>Archwood sapling</keyword>!

Use the <keyword>guidebook</keyword> to find the recipe.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.purple_shareston: A <keyword>Sharestone</keyword> is a special <keyword>Waystone</keyword> attuned to a precious material - right-click it to teleport to any other <keyword>Sharestone of the same kind</keyword>, no matter where it's placed.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.q2cbd884256778d8:
Mixing <c value=#C6BCE9>colors</c>§r seemed like such a simple and fun activity, but brown has, <c value=#ff6600>as always</c>§r, <c value=#ff6600>ruined</c>§r everything.§r

<c value=#ff6600>Collect all the pigments available to you to complete the quest!</c>§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.q351c8bb52e7cd0e: Build a <c value=#FEECD6>fusion shrine</c>§r! Keep in mind, it must have <c value=#FEECD6>access</c>§r to the <c value=#9BB8ED>sky</c>§r in order for it to work.§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.q50c095b07c5644c:
<magic>Aura Nodes</magic> are knots of concentrated magic, aligned to one or more aspects - usually primals, rarely compound ones. They are hard to see with the naked eye, but the <keyword>Thaumometer</keyword> shows them clearly, and faint <pulse>glimmers of light</pulse> often betray them.
