<named>Why you need them:</named> hold <positive>RMB</positive> on a node with your wand to draw <property>vis</property> from it - the main fuel for your wands and devices. A node refills itself by condensing raw vis from its <property>chunk's aura</property>.

<warning>Careful:</warning> draining an aspect completely can harm the node, and a node with all aspects used up <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.3>disappears</shake>.

<named>Node types:</named>
- <property>Normal</property> - a plain node;
- <soul>Pure</soul> - cleanses <poison>flux</poison> from the aura and spreads a calm biome around itself;
- <curse>Sinister</curse> - spreads a dark biome and summons <blood>guardians</blood> when players come close;
- <warning>Hungry</warning> - <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>pulls in</wiggle> items and creatures from about 15 blocks away and devours them, even eats blocks;
- <warning><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>Unstable</shake></warning> - keeps losing vis and lashes out with discharges;
- <poison>Tainted</poison> - feeds on flux instead of raw vis, spreads Tainted Lands and can turn other nodes tainted.

<named>Modifiers:</named> <positive>Bright</positive> nodes refill faster, <soul>Pale</soul> ones slower, <curse>Fading</curse> ones slowly decay. A node mirrors its home: starve the aura and it grows pale, let flux fester and it may become tainted.

<named>Nodes eat each other:</named> nodes react to their neighbours - <property>bigger nodes drain vis</property> out of smaller ones nearby to grow themselves. If you want to keep a small node alive, put a <keyword>Node Stabilizer</keyword> under it.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.q6071f775d9ab5db: The <property>essence of nature</property> itself. Can create new life and revive life long dead.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.radiance_staff.d:
<keyword>Invisible lighting</keyword>!

An incredibly convenient way to <positive>light up your base</positive>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.radiant_glass.de: This <c value=#9BB8ED>glass</c>§r integrates well into the interior, and also <c value=#FEECD6>glows</c>§r!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.razor_falchion.d: §nFragile§r yet useful, has <c value=#FEECD6>Looting III</c>§r by default!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.recall_concoctio:
The first proper brew of the "Superstitiously Enormous Gnomes Summit" (SEGS) department of P.L.A.C.E.R.S., which was "founded" in <obfuscate mode=constant interval=30 alphabet=numeric>19■■</obfuscate>. The concoction was allowed for public usage outside of the Whimsy Induced Polygon (WIP) range and approved by John the Redhatted themself after numerous proper trials on "volunteers." <warning><fade minAlpha=0.3 frequency=1.0>Brings the one consuming it unconscious</fade></warning> while the field agents in their pointy red hats <positive>transport the applicant</positive> to the <magic>location of one's choosing</magic>. The process is accomplished with the extremely high (but not unhealthy, we assure you) dosage of amnestics so that, in the eyes of the user, the whole operation happens instantaneously. The whole procedure is handled by professionals of their trade, and we guarantee the safety of both the customer and their belongings.

&z🛈 The company policy only allows for ONE desired destination to be saved in the records, and only in the "looking directly at them" proximity of beds or campfires (don't ask us about reasons, that's a corporate secret).§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.recharge_pedesta: Recharges wands and vis-powered gear from the surrounding <magic>aura</magic>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.redstone_calcula: Performs simple <property>arithmetic operations</property> on input signals. <positive>Use RMB</positive> to change the operation.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.redstone_control:
Gives the spawner <property>redstone control</property>: it works <warning>only while powered</warning> by a redstone signal.

A lever next to your farm becomes an on/off switch.

Hold the rune and press <property>RMB</property> on a <keyword>Mob Spawner</keyword> - the rune is consumed.
With <keyword>Nether Quartz</keyword> in the other hand redstone control is <magic>removed</magic> - the quartz is not consumed.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.redstone_relay.d: Works like a repeater, but can <property>filter</property> the signal strength. A small but handy tool for magical redstone.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.redstone_timer.d: Periodically emits a <warning>redstone pulse</warning>. By pressing <positive>RMB</positive> you can change the <keyword>length of the pulse</keyword>, and by pressing <positive>Shift+RMB</positive> you can change the <keyword>interval between pulses</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.redstone_transce:
By harnessing the powers of <c value=#C7E2E9>onyx</c>§r, you have discovered a way to to create a <c value=#d33b2b>wireless redstone transmitter</c>§r! It has a range of <keyword>12 blocks</keyword> and can be set to <keyword>different frequencies</keyword> by applying <property>pigment</property>. <positive>RMB</positive> to swap between <positive>sending</positive> and <positive>recieving</positive> a signal.§r

<keyword>P.S.</keyword> To unlock the craft, <positive>improve your old pedestal</positive>!
milf.quest.magic_step_i.research_table.d:
Place two <keyword>Wood Tables</keyword> side by side and <positive>right-click</positive> one of them with <keyword>Scribing Tools</keyword> - they will merge into a <magic>Research Table</magic>.

Scanning things with the <keyword>Thaumometer</keyword> gives you <property>observations</property>, while the table turns them into <property>theories</property>. Almost every page of the <named>Thaumonomicon</named> asks for one or the other, so this is the <pulse><keyword>heart of your studies</keyword></pulse>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.resonator.desc:
The <keyword>Essentia Resonator</keyword> is your <property>debugging tool</property> for tube networks. Use it on a tube or any essentia device to see what essentia it holds and how strong its <wave>suction</wave> is.

Remember: a tube carries only <warning>one type</warning> of essentia at a time, and the strongest suction wins. If a tube <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>vents gas</shake>, different suctions are fighting each other - the gas color hints at which ones.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.ritual_brazier.d:
Right click one of the many types of Ritual Tablets on this Brazier to prepare the ritual. Right click it again to activate the ritual.

Some rituals allow you to augment them before activating them by throwing items into the Brazier.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.ritual_chalk.des: The most basic of chalks, used for standard circles.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.ritual_locate_st:
Many dungeons and boss lairs are <warning>far away</warning> and hard to stumble upon. The <named>Locate Structure</named> ritual finds them for you.

<property>1.</property> Place the tablet into a <keyword>Ritual Brazier</keyword>.
<property>2.</property> <property>RMB</property> the brazier with the <magic>augments</magic> - the items that name the structure you want.
<property>3.</property> <property>RMB</property> the brazier with an empty hand to start the ritual.

When it finishes, the brazier drops a <positive>Wayfinder</positive> - a compass that points to the found structure and shows the distance to it.

Which items find which structure can be checked in <keyword>EMI</keyword> (press <property>U</property> on the tablet). Most boss lairs are found with the <named>Eye</named> of their boss.

If the augments match no structure, the ritual will not start. If there is no such structure nearby, it will fail.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.rowan_sapling.de: Only saplings can mutate. Fully-grown trees will not.
Rune Slabs allow for a few useful rituals, but in this form they still do nothing. You will need to smash them with an anvil together with some other ingredient to infuse them first.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.runed_tablet_2.d:
Beyond the <curse>Oculus</curse> lie the <curse>Outer Lands</curse> - a <glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.05>maze of crumbling stone</glitch> that serves no purpose but to test and trap its visitors. Your magic behaves strangely here.

Somewhere in the labyrinth an <keyword>Eldritch Reliquary</keyword> holds a <keyword>Runed Tablet</keyword> - the key to this labyrinth. Each tablet is <property>bound to its own labyrinth</property> and will not open another.

The tablet guides you: it <wave>hums faintly</wave>, then grows <flame>warm</flame>, then <fire><shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>burns</shake></fire> with the call of the lock as you get closer to the <keyword>Eldritch Lock</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.runic_charge.des: The <keyword>Runic Charge</keyword> provides an easy way to <positive>recharge</positive> your <keyword>rune slabs</keyword> after they are drained from a ritual
milf.quest.magic_step_i.runic_core.desc:
The Runic Core is the centerpiece of all Pagan rituals. Place it down and surround it with six infused slabs of the same type. Light it with some flint and steel, and then slay a creature atop it. This will perform the ritual that corresponds to the type of slabs surrounding the Runic Core.

View the Pagan Guide to see how to set up the slabs around the Runic Core.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.sage_burning_pla: You can place dried sage in these and light them up with flint and steel to prevent mob spawns.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.salis_mundus.des: <keyword>Flint</keyword>, a <keyword>Bowl</keyword>, <keyword>Redstone</keyword> and <property>three Vis Crystals</property> in a crafting table. This <magic>magic dust</magic> turns mundane blocks into thaumaturgical ones.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.sanity_soap.desc: <keyword>Sanity Soap</keyword> removes all temporary warp and has a small chance to reduce the normal kind. Starts from <named>Bath Salts</named>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_blank.desc:
Golems do nothing until they are told to - that is what <keyword>Control Seals</keyword> are for. Place a seal on almost any surface: it turns <soul>ethereal</soul>, so you can put a block in the same spot, and several seals can share a block on different faces.

Seals are visible only while you hold a golem, a seal or the <keyword>Golemancer's Bell</keyword>. <positive>RMB</positive> a seal with the bell to configure it, <positive>Shift + RMB</positive> to pick it up.
<named>Common settings:</named>
- <property>priority</property> from -5 to +5 - tasks of higher priority seals are done first;
- <property>required and forbidden traits</property> - which golems may take the task;
- <property>redstone</property> - a seal can switch off on a signal, cancelling its tasks;
- <aqua>color</aqua> - a colored seal gives tasks only to uncolored golems or golems of the same color (dye the golem).

Craft the bell as soon as you can - you will use it constantly.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_breaker.des:
Golems <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>break blocks</shake> in the <property>area</property>; harder blocks take longer. A filter chooses which blocks to break or ignore.

Golem mobility, the limited area and speed make it a poor mining tool, but it works in a pinch.

Golem: needs the <warning>Breaker</warning> trait (Breaker Arms).
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_breaker_adv:
The advanced <keyword>Block Breaker</keyword>: a <positive>9-slot filter</positive> and a <property>Silk Touch</property> option, so golems can collect blocks intact.

Golem: <warning>Breaker</warning> and <magic>Smart</magic>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_butcher.des:
A Guard seal tuned for <nature>animal farming</nature>: it targets only <property>adult animals</property> and always leaves at least <positive>one breeding pair</positive> alive.

Golem: <blood>Fighter</blood> and <magic>Smart</magic>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_empty.desc:
The opposite of <keyword>Store</keyword>: golems <wave>take items out</wave> of the container the seal is attached to and just hold them. Use other seals to tell them what to do with the items next.

A filter decides which items are taken or left alone. Options: <property>cycle through the whitelist</property> and <property>always leave at least 1 item</property>.

Golem: must <warning>not</warning> be <property>Clumsy</property>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_empty_advan:
The advanced <keyword>Empty</keyword> seal: golems take items out of the container it is attached to.

The advanced version has a <positive>9-slot filter</positive> instead of 1 and works only with <magic>Smart</magic> golems (a head with a biothaumic brain).
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_fill.desc:
Placed on the side of a container, it marks it as a <property>destination</property> for anything nearby golems are holding. Filter with a white- or blacklist; for whitelisted items you can set how many must end up inside (a gold star means unlimited). There is also an option to only accept items the container <property>already holds</property>.

Placed on a non-container block, golems simply drop items there - items within 1 block of the seal count towards the limit.

Golem: must <warning>not</warning> be <property>Clumsy</property>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_fill_advanc:
The advanced <keyword>Store</keyword> seal: marks a container as a destination for golem-carried items.

The advanced version has a <positive>9-slot filter</positive> instead of 1 and works only with <magic>Smart</magic> golems (a head with a biothaumic brain).
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_guard.desc:
Protects an <property>area</property>: any <blood>hostile creature</blood> it detects is attacked by nearby combat-capable golems. If the golem is <property>Deft</property>, slain creatures drop <positive>experience</positive> as if killed by a player.

This research also unlocks combat golem parts. Golem: must be a <blood>Fighter</blood> (Claws, Dart Launchers or the Aggression Module).
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_guard_advan:
The advanced <keyword>Guard</keyword> seal lets you choose what golems attack: <blood>monsters</blood>, <nature>animals</nature> and even <warning>players</warning>.

Golem: <blood>Fighter</blood> and <magic>Smart</magic>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_harvest.des:
Golems find fully-grown crops and other harvestable plants in the <property>area</property> and <nature>harvest</nature> them. They can also <nature>replant</nature> if seeds are available, and re-till farmland that turned back into dirt. Seeds can be requested through <property>provisioning</property>.

Golem: <property>Deft</property> and <magic>Smart</magic>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_lumber.desc:
A refined Block Breaker that only targets <nature>logs</nature> - and instead of the log the golem hits, it breaks the <property>farthest connected log</property>. Trees get chopped from the top down, which makes it a proper <nature>tree farm</nature>.

Golem: <warning>Breaker</warning> and <magic>Smart</magic>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_pickup.desc:
Constantly checks a marked <property>area</property> for dropped items and sends golems to <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>pick them up</wiggle>. You can set the exact size of the area and filter items with a whitelist or blacklist.

Golems only carry the items - combine it with a <keyword>Store</keyword> seal to tell them where to put them.

Golem: must <warning>not</warning> be <property>Clumsy</property>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_pickup_adva:
The advanced <keyword>Collect</keyword> seal: the same job of picking up dropped items in an area.

The advanced version has a <positive>9-slot filter</positive> instead of 1 and works only with <magic>Smart</magic> golems (a head with a biothaumic brain).
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_provider.de:
Like <keyword>Empty</keyword>, but takes an item out only when another seal <property>requests</property> it. Seals like Use or Stock can ask for <property>provisioning</property>: a golem then fetches the needed items from containers marked with a Provide seal.

The task uses the requesting seal's priority, and the golem must fit both seals' requirements. The Provide filter only limits what may be taken - the exact item is chosen by the requesting seal. Options: <property>single item only</property>, <property>always leave at least 1</property>. Filter: 9 slots.

Golem: must <warning>not</warning> be <property>Clumsy</property>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_stock.desc:
Like <keyword>Store</keyword>, but keeps a <property>minimum number</property> of items in its container at all times. It does not stop overstocking from other sources.

It needs <keyword>Provide</keyword> seals to know where to get the items. Filter: 9 slots.

Golem: must <warning>not</warning> be <property>Clumsy</property>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.seal_use.desc:
The golem acts like a player and <positive>left- or right-clicks</positive> the marked block - with an item it holds or a specific filtered item. The seal stays even if the block is removed, so it can click empty air.

Options: left click, click empty air, use an empty hand, simulate a <property>sneaky click</property>, and request <property>provisioning</property> of the whitelisted item.

Golem: <property>Deft</property> and <magic>Smart</magic>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.sender_node_2.de:
Actively tries to keep its connected inventory empty by pushing items/fluid out.

Push order:
1. <keyword>Gather Nodes</keyword>
2. <keyword>Storage Nodes</keyword>
milf.quest.magic_step_i.shake_amplitude_:
In §l<c value=#e4affa>Spectrum</c>§r§r, you can brew different <c value=#9BB8ED>AlCoHoL</c>§r beverages. <c value=#9BB8ED>Alcohol</c>§r has some §lvery§r <c value=#FEECD6>strong buffs</c>§r, but it needs to ferment in the barrels for <c value=#FEECD6>real-life days</c>§r. The <c value=#9BB8ED>longer</c>§r you keep the products in the barrel - the <c value=#9BB8ED>higher</c>§r % of alcohol you will get!§r

P.S. To start brewing beer, you must press the button stating that you are 18 years or older in the Spectrum guidebook! <c value=#d33b2b>It's important</c>§r! Don't worry, the quests for alcohol are purely optional, and not required for 100%.§r
Also sign *<c value=#9BB8ED>there</c>§r*, *<c value=#9BB8ED>here</c>§r*, and provide a <c value=#FEECD6>passport photo</c>§r!§r
<shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>BUT HOW DO YOU MAKE BEER?!</shake>
milf.quest.magic_step_i.shimmerstone_gem:
<c value=#FEECD6>Shimmerstone</c> is <magic>trapped light</magic> that grows alongside Ember deep inside <click action=open_quest value='rock_and_steam/everburning_roots_veins'><u>Everburning Roots Veins</u></click>.

<named>How:</named> aim your <keyword>Anima Caster Tome</keyword> at the veins. <positive>Crush</positive> will <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>split</shake> the roots and free a <c value=#FEECD6>Shimmerstone</c> - sometimes a couple more - along with some <flame>Ember Shards</flame>.

<warning>Don't use a chisel</warning> on veins you need for this: it knocks out only the Ember and leaves ordinary roots behind.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.sightshelf.desc: The <keyword>Shelf of Sight</keyword> doesn't boost level or power - instead it reveals extra enchantments that would otherwise stay hidden in the enchanting table's menu.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.sigil_of_rebirth:
The <keyword>fuel</keyword> of reforging. Put it in the <property>bottom-right slot</property> of a Reforging Table. <property>Common</property> reforges need none, then the cost grows with rarity: from <positive>1</positive> sigil for Uncommon up to <warning>5</warning> for Mythic.

It has one more use: on a <keyword>Smithing Table</keyword>, together with a <keyword>Runic Tablet</keyword>, it <magic><wave>rerolls</wave></magic> the hidden power of a <keyword>runic weapon</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.silent_spawner_r:
Spawned mobs make <wiggly>no sound at all</wiggly> - no hurt noises, no idle noises, nothing.

Your ears will thank you near a big farm.

Hold the rune and press <property>RMB</property> on a <keyword>Mob Spawner</keyword> - the rune is consumed.
With <keyword>Nether Quartz</keyword> in the other hand the effect is <magic>reversed</magic> - the quartz is not consumed.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.simple_reforging:
The simple table works up to <positive>Rare</positive> rarity. For <magic>Epic</magic> and higher you will need the full <keyword>Reforging Table</keyword>.

An item can be reforged <property>as many times as you like</property>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.sipping_fiend_fa:
Striking a creature sometimes lets you <blood>sip</blood> a bit of its life force to <positive>heal yourself</positive>. The fact that you do it by drinking their blood bothers you <glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.05>less than it should</glitch>.

Masks are applied by <magic>infusing</magic> a <keyword>Thaumium Fortress Helm</keyword>, so you need one first.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.skeleton_skull.d:
Skulls can increase both the capacity and recharge rate of an altar, with varying effectiveness.

Human skulls are particularly effective at channeling energy.

§lSkeleton Skull§r: §r
• 1x Power Capacity 
• +1x Recharge Rate
milf.quest.magic_step_i.slime_helmet.des: <keyword>Slime Boots</keyword> let you <positive>bounce off the ground instead of taking damage</positive>, and they work well with the <keyword>Slime Sling</keyword>
milf.quest.magic_step_i.slime_sling.desc:
Aim the Slime Sling at something solid and fire at it to launch *YOURSELF* in the opposite direction!

Allows you to reach great heights. I just hope you know how to make great landings.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.smelter_aux.desc: Each <keyword>Auxiliary Slurry Pump</keyword> attached to the side of a smeltery works as an extra processor and outputs essentia into its own alembics.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.smelter_basic.de: The <keyword>Essentia Smeltery</keyword> melts any item down into raw <magic>essentia</magic>. Put an <keyword>Alembic</keyword> on top to collect it.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.smelter_thaumium: A <magic>Thaumium</magic> smeltery: about <positive>90% efficiency</positive> instead of 80%, and faster.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.smelter_vent.des:
Every smeltery spits out some <poison>flux</poison>. <keyword>Auxiliary Venting Ports</keyword> attached to its sides filter the slurry and release the flux as <wind>harmless steam</wind>.

One vent cuts flux by about <positive>a third</positive>, more vents help further, but with <property>diminishing returns</property>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.smelter_void.des:
The most efficient regular smeltery: about <positive>95% efficiency</positive> instead of 80%, so far less essentia turns into <poison>flux</poison>. It breaks slurry down a bit faster than the basic smeltery, but <warning>slower</warning> than the thaumium one - choose it for purity, not speed.

<named>Crafting:</named> besides a <keyword>Thaumium Smeltery</keyword>, brass and void metal plates, it needs an <keyword>Advanced Alchemical Construct</keyword> - made from 4 <keyword>Alchemical Constructs</keyword>, 4 <curse>Void Metal ingots</curse> and a <magic><pulse>Primordial Pearl</pulse></magic>.

Pearls drop when a <keyword>Flux Rift</keyword> collapses (small chance), from dungeon crates and urns, and from the guardians of the <curse>Outer Lands</curse>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.source_berry_rol:
You can type <keyword>"@ars #c:food"</keyword> in the EMI to search for food that contains <magic>Source</magic>; the more food containing <magic>Source</magic> you consume, the <positive>stronger the magic buffs</positive> you receive from the food.

You can buy <magic>source berry</magic> in the <keyword>market</keyword>
milf.quest.magic_step_i.spa.desc:
Mixing salts by hand is a chore. Fill the <keyword>Arcane Spa</keyword> with water and bath salts and it mixes them and pumps the liquid into a <property>5x5 area</property> above it.

It can pump nearly any liquid, can be filled by automation or by clicking with a container, and a <property>redstone signal</property> turns it off.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.spawn_range_spaw:
Widens the area where the spawner places mobs by <positive>2 blocks</positive> per rune, up to <property>32</property>.

Make sure the area is suitable for the mob, or some spawns will fail.

Hold the rune and press <property>RMB</property> on a <keyword>Mob Spawner</keyword> - the rune is consumed.
With <keyword>Nether Quartz</keyword> in the other hand the range <magic>shrinks</magic> instead (down to 1) - the quartz is not consumed.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.spawner_chain.de:
Blow up a <keyword>Mob Spawner</keyword> with an <warning>explosion</warning>. The blast starts a cascade: a few seconds later the spawner <warning><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.6>detonates</shake></warning> on its own, scattering <keyword>Spawner Chains</keyword> - and releasing the mob that was stored inside.

<warning>Be ready for a fight</warning> and do not stand too close.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.spawner_rune.des:
A <magic>blank rune</magic>. It does nothing on its own.

All runes and their exact effects are visible in <keyword>JEI</keyword> under the uses of the <keyword>Mob Spawner</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.spectrum.desc:
§l<c value=#e4affa>Spectrum</c>§r§r - A unique mod, in a league of its own. §r

<warning>In future quests, Spectrum will be mentioned instead of Pastel.</warning>

You will have to deal with <c value=#FEECD6>mysterious</c>§r items, discover the <c value=#DEB3E0>magic</c>§r of gems, learn the secrets of the dungeons deep underground, and find out everything about the magic of §4c§6o§el§2o§br§9s§r, how you can tame this <c value=#DEB3E0>magic</c>§r and control it.§r

As you progress, you will discover a lot of new things that have §oalways§r surrounded you, even when you lacked the knowledge and tools to notice them.§r

§l<c value=#e4affa>Spectrum</c>§r§r is not designed for fast progress. Enjoy the mod, learn new things, there is no need to rush!§r

<c value=#ffb04f>P.S. If you ever feel like you don't understand something, pay attention to the advancements! Almost all content is unlocked by progressing through them! From crafting recipes, to new abilities, to magical stars falling from the sky!</c>§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.spectrum.title: Spectrum?
milf.quest.magic_step_i.spellcrafting.de:
Spellcasting revolves around the <keyword>Spell Book</keyword>: spells are assembled from <magic>Forms</magic>, <flame>Effects</flame>, and <positive>Augments</positive>.

A <magic>Form</magic> decides how the spell is cast - projectile, touch, area, and so on. 

An <flame>Effect</flame> decides what it does: <negative>damage</negative>, healing, breaking blocks, teleporting, and more. Multiple effects can chain in one spell.

<positive>Augments</positive> then modify the result - more damage, range, duration, or lower cost - and can often be stacked.

Combine them freely: an igniting projectile, a healing area spell, a touch spell that breaks and places blocks at once. <keyword>Experiment</keyword> to find what works.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.spinning_wheel.d: The Spinning Wheel is what allows the infusion of mundane Poppets with other materials to create magical Poppets.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.stabilizer.desc: Infusion is <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.3><warning>unstable</warning></shake>, and occult decorations help less than the books promised. <keyword>Stabilizers</keyword> near the altar are a far more reliable way to keep it calm. This entry appears once you have experienced instability.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.staff_rod_greatw: Staves are <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>bigger wands</shake>: a greatwood staff stores 125 vis of each type, silverwood even more. Too clumsy for the arcane workbench, but fine as a weapon.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.staff_rod_primal: The <magic><pulse>Primal Staff Core</pulse></magic>: silverwood capacity, regenerates vis on its own and adds <positive>+1 potency</positive> to any focus. Caps are still needed.
You can <positive>combine</positive> multiple <keyword>chests</keyword> or any other <keyword>storage containers</keyword> into a single, very user-friendly <keyword>crafting interface</keyword> - it's literally <named>AE2</named> on a minimal setup.

With a Dominion Wand in hand, shift + right click a storage container to designate it, and then right click the storage lectern to bind the two. 

Will not function without a bookwyrm, but can have more than one. Each bookwyrm allows connecting 8 more containers.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.storage_node_2.d:
Best used together with <keyword>Sender Nodes</keyword> (which push to it) and <keyword>Gather Nodes</keyword> (which pull from it).

Its <warning>filter</warning> controls which items/fluid it accepts and offers - leave it empty to store any item/fluid.
Anyone <c value=#FEECD6>interested</c>§r is invited to read the §l<c value=#e4affa>Spectrum</c>§r§r guidebook, no point in copying the information to here!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.sword.desc:
This allows you to deal harm to a creature; you can change the first glyph responsible for casting it - that is, it can be a <keyword>projectile</keyword>, <keyword>self-cast</keyword>, etc - so feel free to experiment.

You can <positive>enhance</positive> this and other spells using the <keyword>Amplify</keyword> glyph!
milf.quest.magic_step_i.sword.title: Sword
milf.quest.magic_step_i.table_core.desc: Don't forget to read the <keyword>guidebook</keyword> and check out the <keyword>advancements</keyword> - all of <named>Spectrum's</named> progress is tied to these two sources of information!
milf.quest.magic_step_i.taglock_kit.desc:
Sometimes, you may need to represent another person to perform magic. This can be achieved using a <keyword>taglock kit</keyword>

By <positive>using</positive> a <keyword>taglock kit</keyword> on a <keyword>Player</keyword> or their <keyword>bed</keyword>, you can collect a <property>sample</property> to use in magic.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.tallow.desc: <named>Hedge Alchemy</named> - turning cheap things into useful ones. <bone>Rotten Flesh</bone> becomes <keyword>Magic Tallow</keyword> and <keyword>Leather</keyword>, and later the crucible can multiply <keyword>gunpowder</keyword>, <keyword>slime</keyword>, <keyword>string</keyword> and more by feeding them their own essentia.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.thaumatorium.des: The peak of alchemy: the <magic>Thaumatorium</magic> automates crucible recipes, pulling essentia straight from your tubes. No more <glitch frequency=0.7 shiftChance=0.06>miscounted aspects</glitch>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.thaumometer.desc: Needs one crystal of each of the <property>six primal aspects</property>. Hold <positive>right-click</positive> on blocks, items and creatures to scan them and collect research points - <pulse><keyword>scan everything</keyword></pulse>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.thaumonomicon.de:
<positive>Right-click</positive> a <keyword>Bookshelf</keyword> with <keyword>Salis Mundus</keyword>. It only works after the dream from sleeping.

<warning>Pick the book up from the ground</warning> - that is what starts your research.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.thaumonomicon_li:
The Thaumonomicon of Sharing only makes a one-time copy. This book forges a <curse><wave>lasting bond</wave></curse> between two minds.

<named>How:</named> open it yourself to attune it, then hand it to your partner. When they open it, the book is spent - but from that moment <positive>every discovery either of you makes</positive> flows to the other, at any distance. The bond <property>never fades</property>.

Infused from a <keyword>Thaumonomicon of Sharing</keyword> with two <curse>Void Seeds</curse>, a <keyword>Zombie Brain</keyword> and an <keyword>Eye of Ender</keyword> - so it needs the <curse>Eldritch</curse> branch. Sometimes you may wonder <glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.05>whose thoughts you are thinking</glitch>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.thaumonomicon_sh:
Playing with friends? This book lets you <positive>share your research</positive> instead of everyone grinding the same entries.

<named>How:</named> use the book once - it <magic>attunes to your mind</magic> and fills with everything you have researched. Then hand it to your research partner: when they use it, all your recorded knowledge <wave>pours into their mind</wave> at once.

It is a one-time copy, not a lasting link - research you make later will not be shared automatically.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.thaumostatic_har: <wind><wave>Flight!</wave></wind> The harness runs on <fire>Potentia</fire> essentia: right-click it with filled jars, then press <keyword>H</keyword> while wearing it to toggle.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.titration_barrel:
The <c value=#FEECD6>Titrartion Barrel</c>§r allows you to create <c value=#9BB8ED>alcoholic beverages</c>§r and many other <c value=#FEECD6>dishes</c>§r. There is one §nnuance§r - fermentation processes take §l<c value=#FEECD6>real hours</c>§r or even <c value=#FEECD6>§ldays</c>§r§r§r§r.§r

To create the <c value=#FEECD6>desired</c>§r item in the barrel, put all <c value=#FEECD6>required</c>§r ingredients inside and close the barrel with a §4c§r§6o§r§el§r§2o§r<property>r</property>§9e§r§5d§r plank!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_i.tomes.desc: One utility provided by Apotheosis are <keyword>Tomes</keyword>. These act similar to a book when being enchanted, but can only receive enchantments for a certain type of item.  There are <keyword>nine tomes</keyword> in total, one each for <property>helmets, chestplates, leggings, boots, swords, bows, pickaxes, fishing poles</property>, and a final tome that accepts enchantments which do not fit on any of the others.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.tomes.title: Tomes
milf.quest.magic_step_i.tongue_of_dog.de: You can use the <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/a_cage_for_our_animal_friends'><u>Animal Pen</u></click> to get the amount of Tongue of Dog you need!
milf.quest.magic_step_i.torch.desc:
A <keyword>torch</keyword>, <keyword>candelabra</keyword> or <keyword>candle</keyword> can be an <property>effective means</property> of increasing your <keyword>altar's</keyword> <property>recharge rate</property>.

§lTorch§r:§r
• +0.5x Recharge Rate
milf.quest.magic_step_i.transmogrificati:
Change the appearance of your items
Used to <positive>transmogrify items</positive>.

Place the <keyword>fuel</keyword>, the <keyword>item whose appearance</keyword> you want to change, and the <keyword>item you want to change it into</keyword> on the table.
<keyword>Boots of the Traveller</keyword> run on vis, so you will need a <keyword>Recharge Pedestal</keyword> from <named>Auromancy</named> to keep them going. Worth it for the <bounce amplitude=1.5 frequency=1.2 phase=1.0>speed</bounce>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.treecapitator.de: <positive>Allows</positive> you to fell most of the <keyword>wood</keyword> or <keyword>leaves</keyword> from trees
milf.quest.magic_step_i.tube.desc:
<keyword>Essentia Tubes</keyword> carry essentia between smelteries, jars and machines, so you no longer have to <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>run around with phials</wiggle>.

<named>How it flows:</named> essentia moves only when something at the other end <wave>pulls</wave> it - this pull is called <property>suction</property>. <keyword>Warded Jars</keyword> and devices that need essentia create suction, alembics give essentia away. A jar that already holds some essentia only pulls <property>its own type</property>.

<named>One type per tube:</named> a tube can carry only <warning>one kind</warning> of essentia at a time, and the <property>strongest suction</property> decides which. Without valves a network gets <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>gummed up</shake> very easily.

<named>Gas from tubes:</named> if a tube <poison>vents gas</poison>, different suctions are fighting each other inside it. The gas color hints at which essentia types are causing the conflict - split the branches with valves or filters.

<named>Wand tricks:</named> click a section of tube with a wand to <property>connect or disconnect</property> it from its neighbours, click the center to rotate tubes like the valve.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.tube_buffer.desc:
Stores up to <property>8 essentia</property> of any mix of types. Its own suction is the minimum (1), so it mostly pulls from a source it touches directly - perfect for getting essentia out of devices that can hold <wave>different types</wave>.

Tubes connect on all sides. Each <keyword>Arcane Bellows</keyword> attached adds <positive>+32 suction</positive>. <positive>Shift + click</positive> a connection to choke its suction down to 1 (blue band) or 0 (red band).
milf.quest.magic_step_i.tube_filter.desc:
Mark it with a <keyword>label</keyword>, a <keyword>phial</keyword> or another item that shows a single essentia type, and only that essentia will <wave>flow through</wave>.

<positive>Shift + RMB</positive> with an empty hand removes the filter.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.tube_oneway.desc: Accepts suction from <property>one direction only</property>, so essentia cannot flow back. The <aqua>blue markings</aqua> show the side suction is accepted from.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.tube_restrict.de: A normal tube that <property>halves</property> any suction passing through it. Useful for setting priorities: the branch behind a restricted tube pulls weaker than the others.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.tube_valve.desc:
Works like a normal tube, but can be <warning>shut off</warning> by hand or with a <property>redstone signal</property>. Without valves a tube network gets gummed up very easily - the book calls them <pulse><keyword>essential</keyword></pulse>.

Click the middle of the valve with a wand to rotate it.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.turret_basic.des: A crossbow with a <glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.05>mind of its own</glitch>: it shoots any hostile mob in range. Place it over an upward-facing <keyword>dispenser</keyword> and it will reload itself.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.twinbound_feathe: Wave the <keyword>Twinbound Feather</keyword> against another player's feather to link the two - as long as you both keep the feather in your inventory, you can use a <keyword>Waystone</keyword> to teleport directly to each other.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.verdant_charm.de:
A charm that <positive><pulse>pulses with healing energy</pulse></positive> and washes all <poison>poisons and similar afflictions</poison> from your body. It does <warning>not</warning> heal actual wounds.

It has an internal store of vis and <warning>cannot</warning> draw it from the aura - charge it on a <keyword>Recharge Pedestal</keyword> (or with an <keyword>Amulet of Vis</keyword>). Two infusion enchantments can improve it: <nature>Lifegiver</nature> and <aqua>Sustainer</aqua>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.verdant_charm_li:
The <nature>Lifegiver</nature> enchantment makes the charm <positive><wave>regenerate the health</wave></positive> of whoever wears it - now it heals wounds too, not only poisons.

Applied by <magic>infusing</magic> a <keyword>Verdant Heart Charm</keyword>. Like the base charm, it runs on vis - charge it on a <keyword>Recharge Pedestal</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.verdant_charm_su:
The <aqua>Sustainer</aqua> enchantment makes the charm slowly <positive>feed</positive> whoever wears it and even provides <aqua><wave>breathable air</wave></aqua> - no more hunger or drowning worries.

Applied by <magic>infusing</magic> a <keyword>Verdant Heart Charm</keyword>. Like the base charm, it runs on vis - charge it on a <keyword>Recharge Pedestal</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.vis_battery.desc: Absorbs vis when the aura is above <property>95%</property> and releases it when it falls below <property>75%</property>. Keeps your chunk's aura steady.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.vis_generator.de:
Vis and mundane power usually <warning>don't mix</warning> - but this generator turns <magic>vis</magic> into <pulse><keyword>FE/RF</keyword></pulse>. It spins a magnetic linkage with vis, so magic and electricity never touch.

It draws vis <property>straight from the aura</property>: one point of vis gives <positive>1000 FE</positive>, but it outputs at most <property>20 FE per tick</property>. A <property>redstone signal</property> turns it off.

Keep an eye on the aura - a hungry generator can <warning>drain a chunk</warning>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.vis_relay.desc:
Catches the stream of an <magic>energized node</magic> and carries it onward as a <soul>beam of faded light</soul>.

Place it within <property>8 blocks</property> of an energized node or of another relay that already carries a stream - chains of relays can carry power far, though a stream can pass through only so many crystals before it frays. The bigger the node, the more <property>centivis</property> flows per second. Each relay also keeps a small buffer for bursts.

Devices drink from the nearest relay: a <keyword>Recharge Pedestal</keyword> charges wands from it, and the <keyword>Arcane Workbench</keyword> pays crafting costs from it. The relay itself loses nothing, but the node refills from its aura - a network that drinks faster than the aura recovers will <warning>run the land dry</warning>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.void_fragment.de: Required to craft the <keyword>Transmogrification Table</keyword>. Also allows you to make your items <keyword>invisible</keyword>!
Robes of a true thaumaturge: the protection of fortress armor, the bonuses of thaumaturge's robes, and a hood with built-in <keyword>Goggles of Revealing</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.void_seed.desc:
Something that does not belong to our reality. A <curse>Void Seed</curse> drops when a <keyword>Flux Rift</keyword> collapses - on its own or blown up with a <keyword>Causality Collapser</keyword>.

<positive>Scan it with your Thaumometer</positive>: that is what the <named>Unlock Eldritch</named> entry needs, along with the <named>Crimson Rites</named> and <named>Auromancy</named>. Completing it opens the <curse><glitch frequency=0.7 shiftChance=0.06>Eldritch</glitch></curse> tab - and gives you <warning>Warp</warning>.

Keep the seed: bound with metal, it becomes <keyword>Void Metal</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.void_siphon.desc:
Destroying a rift every time you need <curse>Void Seeds</curse> is impractical - and the <blood>Crimson Cult</blood>, of all people, knew a better way.

The <keyword>Void Siphon</keyword> slowly <wave>leeches energy</wave> from rifts within about <property>8 blocks</property> and condenses it into <curse>Void Seeds</curse> - a steady supply without blowing anything up. The <property>bigger the rift</property>, the faster the seeds form. Open the siphon to collect them.

<warning>The cost:</warning> the rift becomes <shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>more and more unstable</shake> and slowly <property>shrinks</property> as its energy is drained. Don't overuse it, or you will lose the rift - and an unstable rift throws out chaos more often. A <property>redstone signal</property> pauses the siphon.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.voidseer_charm.d: <curse><glitch frequency=0.7 shiftChance=0.06>In madness there is insight.</glitch></curse> Makes vis easier to manipulate - the more permanent warp you have, the bigger the bonus.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.wand.desc: The <keyword>Coille Slat</keyword> grants <positive>growth to plants</positive> and can be obtained by using the <keyword>Emerald Ritual</keyword>
milf.quest.magic_step_i.wand_2.desc: Two <keyword>Iron Caps</keyword> and a <keyword>Stick</keyword> in a crafting table - your first casting <magic>Wand</magic>. It is crude, but it can draw vis from the aura and from <keyword>Aura Nodes</keyword>.
<keyword>Copper Caps</keyword> work like iron ones, but channel <property>Ordo</property> and <property>Perditio</property> vis as efficiently as <named>gold</named>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.wand_cap_gold.de: <keyword>Gold Caps</keyword> waste less vis than iron ones. Better caps mean <positive>cheaper spells</positive>.
<keyword>Silver Caps</keyword> are like gold, but slightly better with the four elemental primals: <fire>Ignis</fire>, <nature>Terra</nature>, <wind>Aer</wind> and <aqua>Aqua</aqua>. The inert cap from the workbench must be <magic>infused</magic> before it works.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.wand_cap_thaumiu: Thaumium caps focus vis of every type <positive>very efficiently</positive>. The inert cap from the workbench must be <magic>infused</magic> before it works.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.wand_cap_void.de: Void metal resists magic, yet <curse>channels it with surprising ease</curse>. The best wand caps.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.wand_rod_blaze.d: Stores slightly more vis than a <nature>Greatwood</nature> core, and when its <fire>Ignis</fire> drops below <property>10%</property> it <pulse>slowly refills on its own</pulse> - no node needed.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.wand_rod_bone.de: Stores slightly more vis than a <nature>Greatwood</nature> core, and when its <bone>Perditio</bone> drops below <property>10%</property> it <pulse>slowly refills on its own</pulse> - no node needed.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.wand_rod_greatwo: A rod made from <nature>Greatwood</nature> holds far more vis than a stick. Greatwood trees grow in <nature>magical forests</nature>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.wand_rod_ice.des: Stores slightly more vis than a <nature>Greatwood</nature> core, and when its <aqua>Aqua</aqua> drops below <property>10%</property> it <pulse>slowly refills on its own</pulse> - no node needed.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.wand_rod_obsidia: Stores slightly more vis than a <nature>Greatwood</nature> core, and when its <nature>Terra</nature> drops below <property>10%</property> it <pulse>slowly refills on its own</pulse> - no node needed.
Stores slightly more vis than a <nature>Greatwood</nature> core, and when its <keyword>Ordo</keyword> drops below <property>10%</property> it <pulse>slowly refills on its own</pulse> - no node needed.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.wand_rod_reed.de: Stores slightly more vis than a <nature>Greatwood</nature> core, and when its <wind>Aer</wind> drops below <property>10%</property> it <pulse>slowly refills on its own</pulse> - no node needed.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.wand_rod_silverw: <soul>Silverwood</soul> is rarer and purer still. It also opens the path to <keyword>Staves</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.warp_plate.desc: The <keyword>Warp Plate</keyword> teleports players, mobs and items to another linked Warp Plate when they stand on it. When first placed, it pops out an <keyword>Attuned Shard</keyword> - bring that shard to a second Warp Plate to link the two. Sneak-use a plate to remove its shard.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.waystone.desc:
Craft and place a <keyword>Waystone</keyword>, then right-click it once to <warning>activate</warning> and name it - only then does it get added to your teleport network. Right-click and hold any waystone to open the list of every waystone you've activated and teleport to any of them.

Teleporting costs <property>XP levels</property> based on distance, and jumping between dimensions costs a flat amount extra - but teleporting <positive>to a global waystone is free</positive>, and using a <keyword>Warp Plate</keyword> as your starting point never costs anything.

Your nearby <keyword>pets</keyword> and <keyword>leashed mobs</keyword> teleport with you automatically.
A <keyword>Portstone</keyword> is a one-way teleporter - right-click it to open the <keyword>Waystone</keyword> selection screen and teleport to any activated waystone. It can also be attuned to a precious material to teleport to matching <keyword>Sharestones</keyword> instead.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.wican_ward.desc: The <keyword>Wican Ward</keyword> will be granted to you if you complete the <keyword>Amethyst Ritual</keyword> and will <warning>stop mobs from spawning</warning> in your area
milf.quest.magic_step_i.willow_altar.des: It has been noted that the book on this table consumes quite a lot of <warning>FPS</warning>, so <warning>keep that in mind!</warning>
milf.quest.magic_step_i.winch.desc:
To smash items without losing anvil durability, place a winch with a crank on its side. Put some rope in it. Then, right clicking the crank will pull the rope closer to the winch, and crouch + right click will let the anvil drop.

The winch has to be at least four blocks above the ground, otherwise it wouldn't be able to lift the anvil.

You need an <keyword>undamaged anvil</keyword> to use this block.

Also, make sure there are no items in the offhand while the winch is in operation!
milf.quest.magic_step_i.witch_hazel_alta: It has been noted that the book on this table consumes quite a lot of <warning>FPS</warning>, so <warning>keep that in mind</warning>!
milf.quest.magic_step_i.witch_oven.desc:
The <keyword>witch's oven</keyword> is a modified furnace used to collect <keyword>byproducts</keyword> and <keyword>fumes</keyword> made from burning materials.

Unlike a furnace, this oven <warning>cannot process ores</warning>. <positive>Place</positive> a <keyword>clay jar</keyword> into the middle slot for a chance to collect fumes.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.wither_skeleton_:
§lWither Skeleton Skull§r:§r
• +2x Power Capacity
• +2x Recharge Rate
milf.quest.magic_step_i.wool_of_bat.desc: You can use the <click action=open_quest value='first_steps/a_cage_for_our_flying_little_friends'><u>Aviary</u></click> to get the amount of Wool of Bat you need!
milf.quest.magic_step_i.yellow_dock_bush:
The bush will slowly grow and is harvestable.

Can be found in swamps or bought from the Merchant.
milf.quest.magic_step_i.youthful_spawner:
Spawned mobs appear as <nature>babies</nature> - if the mob has a baby form at all. Otherwise nothing changes.

Hold the rune and press <property>RMB</property> on a <keyword>Mob Spawner</keyword> - the rune is consumed.
With <keyword>Nether Quartz</keyword> in the other hand the effect is <magic>reversed</magic> - the quartz is not consumed.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.accelerating_in: An augment for the <keyword>Spirit Crucible</keyword>, using a superior conductor woven from Astral Weave: <property>+100% Focusing Speed</property>, with <positive>no drawbacks</positive> whatsoever - a straightforward speed boost.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.acid_oil_pot.de:
<warning>Lowers the effectiveness of armour</warning> by about <keyword>25%</keyword>.

Can be used together with a <keyword>Oil Pot Sash</keyword>. Pots will dig ore in an area like grenades. The ores will have <property>Fortune II</property> applied to them.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.acid_tox_pot.de: The <warning>acid</warning> was already <warning>potent</warning>. <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>§lLETS MAKE IT MORE!§r</shake> Now with access to <warning>stronger ingredients</warning>, I can <positive>reformulate</positive> the §l<warning>acid oil</warning> using <warning>toxin</warning>. As such, the <warning>acid effect</warning> has been amplified, making it <warning>reduce armor strength</warning> even more, while gaining the ability to <warning><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>dissolve diamond level ores</shake></warning>.§r
The <keyword>Advanced Prism</keyword> is an upgrade of the <keyword>Spell Prism</keyword> - use the <keyword>Dominion Wand</keyword> to aim it at a specific block instead of just a direction, and equip <property>Prism Lenses</property> to modify the redirected spell (arc/homing trajectory, speed changes, or effects like piercing and chaining that cost source).
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.affinity_fusion:
Alternatively, if I am struggling to find a certain affinity within an ingredient, I can instead FUSE other ones for a variable outcome. I can make a substance that will allow me to gain another affinity from three other poisonous materials. To do this I first must create the mix.

Next, in order to purify the mix for total reconstruct, I must heat it up in a small contained source.

Finally, with amalgamation of poisonous material, all I need to do is hold a magnifying glass and interact with the substance. With enough searching I can pinpoint an entirely new affinity associated with this ingredient. Because of the nature of the material, this inefficient method is the best I can manage if I am to remold an entirely new affinity.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.air_turret.desc: The <keyword>Air Turret</keyword> is an <keyword>Ars Elemental</keyword> defense turret that automatically fires at nearby hostile mobs, using the power of the <keyword>Air</keyword> school.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.alakarkinos_cha:
The <keyword>Alakarkinos</keyword> is a crab familiar that digs through material to find rare items. Bind it to a chest with the <keyword>Dominion Wand</keyword>, and it will search anything placed within 3 blocks around that chest, as long as <property>source</property> is available nearby.

In this pack it's fed <keyword>Gem Composite</keyword> instead of gravel or sand, and digs up <magic><pulse base=0.7 amplitude=0.8>rare materials from other mods that don't otherwise appear in this world</pulse></magic> - makes it your only way to obtain some of them.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.alchemical_forg:
I <warning>found</warning> it...

An §6ancient schematic§r to a <keyword>device long lost to time</keyword>.§r

One that fully realizes the <warning>power of toxin</warning> I have sought for so long.

How does it work??
The text roughly translates to "In mendus we pour it the liquor of life, of two side-by-side."
<shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>BUT HOW AND WHY??</shake>

…
Items must be arranged exactly like in the recipe or else the crafting will fail and the components will be lost.
<c value=#4EC847><fade>🛈 Toxin is used as fuel!</c></fade>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.alembic.desc:
The Alembic. An old device in the academy that will help purify liquids similar to how the crucible purifies solids. However, they are fragile. In order for this to work, I need a stronger glassy material. I know one located in the Nether. I must find it!

The alembic can refine weaker potions into their stronger variants without the need of additional material, purifying the liquid to a more concentrated form. Although this is not enough! The alembic has gotten them closer to binding with my paste, but its not pure enough.

I think I can devise a solution that uses only the most concentrated form of Netherwart! To unlock what <poison>poison</poison> has to offer us! I've collected all my notes, stood through consecutive nights. My mind has been awake past dusk more times than I can count. With the glass vials and my <poison>toxic paste</poison>...
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.all_rounder.des:
The <named>All-Rounder</named> is a theurgical utility tool forged from the power of both deities - hold a goblet while killing a creature with it, and the goblet <blood>fills with that creature's blood</blood>.

Pleasing a deity imbues the tool with their power, but favoring one side <curse>strips away the other's blessing</curse>. Only a truly <magic>balanced</magic> reputation lets you keep both powers at once.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.allow_scroll.de: The <keyword>Allow Scroll</keyword> works as a whitelist for your <keyword>Starbuncle</keyword> - it will only pick up and move items that are on the scroll's list, ignoring everything else.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.alteration_tabl: The <keyword>Alteration Table</keyword> is used to inscribe <keyword>Threads</keyword> onto magic armor - place the armor on the stand to see its available <property>Thread Slots</property>, then use a Thread on the display to add it. Take the armor back off to apply the changes, or interact with an empty hand to remove a Thread.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.angels_sight.de: An ancient ring, <named>Archangel's Sight</named> guides your ranged attacks toward the <keyword>nearest target</keyword> automatically. <property>Shift-click</property> the ring to cycle its mode - ignore other players, or aim only at enemies.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.any_azure_dike_: <keyword>Azure dike</keyword> allows you to <positive>pass through</positive> some §1blue§r barriers, and also <property>increases your survivability</property>!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.any_scalpels.de: Many parts of a mob, including ourselves, react differently when <poison>toxins</poison> are introduced in their bodies. This makes §6unique ingredients§r when certain mobs are <poison>afflicted</poison>. As such, we should extract them. When a mob <poison>dies while being afflicted with poison</poison>, they can drop §6special ingredients§r. However, a sword is too crude to extract them. As such, they must die by a <keyword>scalpel</keyword> in order to carefully extract these §6valuable parts§r.§r
This <keyword>map</keyword> shifts and changes as I move, almost as if it were alive, sensing my intentions.

Used in a structure, this atlas will guide me through treacherous terrain, across raging rivers and through dense forests to find similar structires.

<positive>Use them</positive> in various structures to <positive>mark them on the map</positive> and quickly find the one you need!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.azure_runewood_: Use the guidebook from the Enchanted mod to view the recipe
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.base_bangle.des: This ring can be upgraded to other rings
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.basic_spell_tur: The <keyword>Basic Spell Turret</keyword> casts <property>Projectile</property>, <property>Touch</property>, <property>Sensitive</property> and <property>Redstone</property> glyphs for free - inscribe a spell onto it, then feed it a <keyword>Redstone</keyword> signal to make it cast.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.bedrock_anvil.d:
§8Unbreakable§r anvil! §oBut that's not all...§r

• No repair XP limit
• Rename items for free
• Add descriptions
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.bedrock_dust.de: Nothing special, just some §l§6bedrock§r in your hand...§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.belt_of_the_mag: Normally, <property>Soul Ward</property> stops recovering for a while after you're hit. The <keyword>Belt of the Magebane</keyword> ends that downtime - it boosts <positive>Soul Ward recovery rate and capacity</positive>, and even absorbs the <warning>arcane essence</warning> of any magic damage you take, instantly converting it into Soul Ward recovery.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.belt_of_the_pro: The <keyword>Belt of the Prospector</keyword> blesses your explosions with <property>Fortune III</property>, and mining valuable resources has a chance to grant <curse>Avarice</curse> - stacking, temporary bonus that adds a <positive>1/10 chance per stack</positive> for an extra Fortune level when breaking blocks.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.belt_of_the_sta: Spirit Arcana can carry impurities of hunger and lust, catalyzed into <curse>Gluttony</curse> - a stacking amplifier for magic damage. The <keyword>Belt of the Starved</keyword> grants this effect whenever you eat <curse>rotten food</curse>, but be warned: it also <warning>drains your hunger faster</warning> in return.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.bismuth_flake.d: Small chunks can be found on <magic>walls</magic> in the §2Crystal Gardens§r <magic>biome</magic> in <magic>Deeper Down</magic>§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.black_hole_ches:
Collects items in a <property>huge radius</property>, can also collect xp if a §9Knowledge Gem§r is inserted!§r

• Has a radius of <keyword>12 blocks</keyword>.
• To <warning>turn off</warning>, <positive>place a full block above it</positive>.
• Has <keyword>filters</keyword> for which items are sucked.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.blank_thread.de: The <keyword>Blank Thread</keyword> is the base for crafting a <keyword>Thread</keyword> - imbue it in the <keyword>Enchanting Apparatus</keyword> with the right ingredients to turn it into a specific perk, then inscribe it onto armor at the <keyword>Alteration Table</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.blazing_diode.d: An augment for the <keyword>Spirit Crucible</keyword>, extracting the full force of a soul on fire: <property>-25% Fuel Usage Rate</property> and <positive>+25% Focusing Speed</positive> - lessens the fuel needed from a <keyword>Spirit Catalyzer</keyword> while also hastening the whole process.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.bloodroot.desc:
Grows in <nature>crimson forests</nature>.

You can also buy from <keyword>Wandering Trader</keyword>.

You can also get it from <keyword>Piglin Barter</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.bolt.desc: However, because of its size, its power has been <warning>scaled down</warning>. To compensate, I have created special <keyword>ammunition</keyword> - a <property>catalyst for oil</property>. By <positive>using the bolts on a placed oil pot</positive>, they can be <property>covered in oil</property>, applying its effect to hit targets. Do keep in mind <warning>some oils will not apply to the bolts</warning>.
The Cyclebow can store and fire a sequence of bolts. As such, the order they are fired is determined by when they are placed into the Cyclebow. This trait can make it devastating with different combinations of bolts. However, manually adding each bolt can be cumbersome. It also makes for a terribly unorganized inventory. As a result, I have designed an inexpensive and ingenious method for loading them.

To load bolts into the cartridge, crouch and use it. The cartridge will grab different bolts from your inventory, in the same order arrows would've been when using a bow. It will try to grab bolts from different stacks, but if there aren't enough unique stacks, it will grab the same stacks multiple times. We can then load the Cyclebow like we do bolts. If I wish to get the bolts back, I only need to crouch and use the filled cartridge.
The <magic>Bonechill Wand</magic> chills the soul of anything it strikes - the target is gripped by an <curse>icy hold</curse> that prevents all health regeneration, just like the claws of a wraith.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.bonelord_helm.d:
Death's rest is sacred - the <bone>Vestige of the Bone Paladin</bone> is a replica of the grave paladins' silver armor, worn to honor the dead and let their souls rest instead of being called back into <curse>undeath</curse>.

While worn as a full set, it <positive>regenerates a portion of your ethereal hearts</positive> over time, and grants <positive>immunity to poison and withering</positive>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.bottle_of_decay: If some nasty bacteria is threatening your kitchen or your life, you can use this to clean the mess. Well, stop the mess from expanding, at least...
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.bottle_of_faili:
Oopsie!
If you play on a server, be <warning>cautious</warning> about these <keyword>bacteria</keyword>, otherwise they can §lget out of control§r…§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.bottomless_bund: A <c value=#FEECD6>Bottomless Bundle</c>§r§r allows you to store a §l<c value=#FEECD6>huge</c>§r§r amount of items of a single type, very handy in mines!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.brazier.desc:
The <keyword>Brazier</keyword> is the altar where all <curse>Eidolon</curse> <property>rituals</property> are performed - from summoning to locating structures.

<property>How to perform:</property>
<property>1.</property> Put the <magic>reagent</magic> on the Brazier.
<property>2.</property> Place the other components on <keyword>Stone Hands</keyword> around it. Some rituals also need items on <keyword>Necrotic Focuses</keyword>.
<property>3.</property> Light the Brazier with a <fire>flint and steel</fire>.

<property>Nuances:</property>
• Some rituals demand a <blood>sacrifice</blood> - creatures have to die near the burning Brazier. EMI shows how many hearts are needed.
• Lasting rituals keep working while the Brazier burns. <property>RMB</property> it with an empty hand to put it out and end the effect.
• Locating rituals take an empty <keyword>map</keyword> as the reagent and mark the found structure on it.

All rituals and their components are in <keyword>EMI</keyword> - press <property>U</property> on the Brazier.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.caustic_catalys: A <keyword>core augment</keyword> for the <keyword>Spirit Crucible</keyword>. The <keyword>Caustic Catalyst</keyword> harnesses the volatile reaction between Infernal and Aqueous arcana, granting <property>+100% Caustic Synergy</property> - the higher the Crucible's <warning>Instability</warning> climbs, the more it boosts <positive>Tuning Potency</positive>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.censer.desc:
Place it atop an altar to increase its capacity by 2.

Can also be used to burn plants, the incense from which will have effects based on what plant is burned.

Consult with your Ars Ecclesia for effects.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.cinderhearth.de:
Every <magic>magician</magic> should have a <magic>magic furnace</magic>.

By spending <c value=#ff8547>orange ink</c>§r, Cinderhearth smelts items, sometimes with interesting outcomes.§r

Other types of ink will enhance the smelting properties, be it speed, yield or xp produced, but it needs upgrades for that to work.

More in-depth information can be found in the guidebook.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.cleaving_axe.de: <keyword>Increases the chance</keyword> of dropping a <keyword>mob's head</keyword> when you <positive>kill it</positive> with this axe.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.codex.desc: The cornerstone of the Eidolon mod. A guidebook, spellbook and prayerbook all in one.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.coldsnap.desc:
Grows in <nature>taiga biomes</nature> (the cold ones).

You can also buy from <keyword>Wandering Trader</keyword>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.constructors_st: <c value=#C6BCE9>Constructor's Staff</c>§r - a tool for placing blocks in a defined pattern by spending §3Cyan Ink§r. §r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.copper_needle.d:
I will need a tool to administer the solution into an unfortunate specimen. Luckily, with the help of another doctoral tool, I can make a simple copper needle. One especially capable of handling dangerous solutions.

This process may be long, but it is invaluable to know what these natural affinities are. I need to inject these solutions into a strong enough subject, and when its at its lowest point, the affinity associated with the poisonous ingredient will reveal itself to me!

By holding the solution in one hand and then the needle in the other, I can put the solution inside the needle. Then once I find a very strong subject, I must bring their life to the brink (<poison>poison</poison> should do the trick). Once its at an inch of its life, that's when I use the needle.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.crimson_veil_el:
§lThe final quest for the middle phase of the game in magic. §r

§lEndgame still in WIP!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.crucible.desc:
The <keyword>Crucible</keyword> is the alchemy station of <curse>Eidolon</curse>: here you brew items whose recipes consist of <property>several steps</property> instead of a single craft.

<property>Preparation:</property> place the Crucible above a <fire>heat source</fire> - a campfire or fire on netherrack - and fill it with <aqua>water</aqua>. Wait until the water <wave>boils</wave>.

<property>Brewing:</property> every recipe consists of <property>steps</property>, done from top to bottom. Throw in all items of the current step - their order inside the step does not matter. When the liquid <pulse>changes color</pulse>, the step is done: <warning>hurry</warning> with the next one, the time is limited.

Some steps require <keyword>stirring</keyword> - <property>RMB</property> the Crucible the indicated number of times.

<warning>A mistake ruins the brew</warning> - wrong items or too long a pause and the reagents are lost.

All recipes and their steps are in <keyword>EMI</keyword> - press <property>U</property> on the Crucible.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.crystal_apothec: <keyword>Crystal Apothecary</keyword> automatically <positive>collects gemstone clusters</positive>. Anything - §6Topaz§r, §5Amethyst§r, <property>Certus Quartz</property> etc. It doesn't even need to be loaded!§r
One of the most important blocks for further progression. Learn more about how to use it by reading the Spectrum book!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.cyclebow.desc: This complex device is similar to its cousin, the regular crossbow. However, through extensive research and engineering, I have managed to compact it down to a single-handed crossbow that can fire two additional shots before needing to be reloaded.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.deny_scroll.des: The <keyword>Deny Scroll</keyword> works as a blacklist for your <keyword>Starbuncle</keyword> - opposite of the Allow Scroll, it will pick up and move any item that is NOT on the scroll's list.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.earth_turret.de: The <keyword>Earth Turret</keyword> is an <keyword>Ars Elemental</keyword> defense turret that automatically fires at nearby hostile mobs, using the power of the <keyword>Earth</keyword> school.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.echoing_sculksh: The <keyword>Echoing Sculkshelf</keyword> is an advanced bookshelf crafted from <warning>Warden</warning> drops - one of the strongest for your enchanting table, and it also reveals an extra hidden enchantment in the table's menu, same as the Shelf of Sight.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.empty_tox_pot.d:
We won't stop at simple oils. We have many more possibilities <shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>FOR MORE POTENCY!</shake> <poison>Toxin</poison> has opened new doors to its potential. <shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>AND WE WILL USE THEM GRACIOUSLY!</shake>

Using my alembic we can INFUSE our pots from just basic clay into a <poison>BEAUTIFUL TOXIN POT</poison>. Many of my more potent oils will need this enhanced container. For the simple clay pot was WEAK and shattered under the effects of <poison>toxin</poison>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.enchanter.desc:
Enchanter can enchant books with specific enchantments and improve them. 

Moreover, enchanter can to combine two conflicting enchantments. Doing so will require more experience, and a §ocertain unlock in the Guidebook§r!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.enchanter_scyth: The <keyword>Enchanter's Scythe</keyword> (Ars Hex) works like the Enchanter's Sword - inscribe a spell without a form at the Scribe's Table and it triggers on hit. Rebound-thrown scythes will also trigger Reactive spells.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.enchanters_fish: The <keyword>Enchanter's Fishing Rod</keyword> works as a normal rod, but hooking an entity lets you cast its inscribed <property>Touch</property> spell on it for as long as the line holds. Inscribe it at the Scribe's Table with a formless spell, same as the sword and gauntlet.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.enchanters_gaun: The <keyword>Enchanter's Gauntlet</keyword> is a spellcasting multi-tool that can also mine at diamond-tool hardness. It always casts <property>Touch</property> and must be inscribed at the Scribe's Table with a formless spell - spells cast with it get a source discount.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.enchanters_knif: The <keyword>Enchanter's Knife</keyword> (Ars Delight) is a lightweight blade - use it on grass, wheat or rice to get extra stems without spending durability, right-click a pumpkin to carve it, and kill animals with it for a chance at rare secondary drops.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.enchanters_shie: The <keyword>Enchanter's Shield</keyword> grants you a short burst of <property>Mana Regeneration</property> and <property>Spell Damage</property> whenever you block damage with it, and repairs itself over time using your source.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.enchanters_swor: The <keyword>Enchanter's Sword</keyword> applies a <property>Touch</property> spell before damaging an entity, and grants all your spells extra <property>Spell Damage</property>. Inscribe it at the Scribe's Table with a spell that has no form, e.g.:
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ender_dropper.d:
The <c value=#9BB8ED>Ender Dropper</c>§r is an opposite of the <c value=#9BB8ED>Ender Hopper</c>§r. With each <c value=#d33b2b>redstone pulse</c>§r, it ejects an item from your personal <c value=#9BB8ED>Ender Chest</c>§r. §r

§oBe careful:§r What's stopping someone from putting a button next to it and stealing from your Ender Chest?§r

Ender Droppers only work when you are online.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ender_hopper.de:
Designed like a regular §8hopper§r in shape and function, the <c value=#9BB8ED>Ender Hopper</c>§r has the special ability to place items directly into your <c value=#9BB8ED>Ender Chest</c>§r.§r

Ender Hoppers only work when you are online.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ender_source_ja: The <keyword>Ender Source Jar</keyword> allows you to store <property>source</property> in an ender-connected <keyword>Source Jar</keyword>. Each jar you <positive>place</positive> will link to the same <property>pool of source</property>, allowing you to use the <keyword>Source Jar</keyword> from <keyword>anywhere</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ethereal_source:
§lThere's only one way to make liquid source!§r

<keyword>1 Ethereal Source</keyword> -> <keyword>8 liquid source</keyword>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.exchanging_staf: Allows <positive>exchanging one block for another</positive>. Can change <keyword>multiple connected blocks simultaneously</keyword>. Handy when dealing with <keyword>EBF coils</keyword>!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.fabrication_che:
A <c value=#DEB3E0>Fabrication Chest</c>§r has four special slots for <c value=#FEECD6>Crafting Tablets</c>§r.§r

Automatically crafts items while resources are present.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.familiar_amethy: The <keyword>Amethyst Golem Familiar</keyword> is a defensive companion - it halves knockback taken and knocks back attackers. Give it an <keyword>Amethyst Shard</keyword> to grant yourself <property>Shielding</property> for 3 minutes.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.familiar_bookwy: The <keyword>Bookwyrm Familiar</keyword> buffs its mage - it reduces the source cost of spells and increases spell damage by 1. Purely a companion, with no other effects.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.familiar_drygmy: The <keyword>Drygmy Familiar</keyword> increases the damage of <property>Earth</property> spells by 2 and gives a chance for extra loot when you kill mobs yourself, similar to Looting.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.familiar_starbu: The <keyword>Starbuncle Familiar</keyword> grants you <property>Speed II</property> while summoned. Give it a <keyword>Gold Nugget</keyword> to consume it and briefly reveal nearby gold ore.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.familiar_whirli: The <keyword>Whirlisprig Familiar</keyword> reduces the source cost of <property>Earth</property> glyphs by half and grants bonus saturation from food - a personal buff version, separate from the worker Whirlisprig that generates materials near its flower.
The <keyword>Wixie Familiar</keyword> is a personal buff companion, separate from the worker Wixie that autocrafts items and potions at the Wixie Cauldron.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.filtering_shelf: The <keyword>Filtering Shelf</keyword> lets you <warning><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>blacklist</shake></warning> enchantments from your enchanting table - insert an enchanted book with a single enchantment on it (like a <curse>curse</curse>) into the shelf, and that enchantment will stop appearing on future enchants. Holds up to <keyword>6 books</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.fire_turret.des: The <keyword>Fire Turret</keyword> is an <keyword>Ars Elemental</keyword> defense turret that automatically fires at nearby hostile mobs, using the power of the <keyword>Fire</keyword> school to burn them.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.firenando_famil: The <keyword>Firenando Familiar</keyword> (Ars Elemental) is a combat companion with 80 health and armor - it automatically targets nearby hostile mobs with homing projectiles that <flame>ignite</flame> and knock them back, regenerates over time, and goes dormant instead of dying (revive it with Magma Cream or Blaze Powder).
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.flashjack_famil: The <keyword>Flashjack Familiar</keyword> (Ars Elemental) increases the damage of <property>Lightning</property> spells by 2 and reduces movement-based spell costs by 20%. It can also be linked to a <keyword>Spell Turret</keyword> with the Dominion Wand to hijack it and aim at its own target.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.gem_composite.d:
Alakarkinos allows you to collect many magical items, such as <keyword>Chthonic Gold</keyword>, <keyword>Shimmerstone Gems</keyword>, <keyword>Brilliance</keyword>, <keyword>Soul Shards</keyword>, and <keyword>Onyx Powder</keyword>. To use it, you need to select a <property>container</property> where Alakarkinos will store items and provide it with a small amount of <magic>Source</magic>. 

In order for Alakarkinos to use a block, you must place it in the world; to automate this process, you can use the <click action=open_quest value='magic_step_i/block_placer'><u>Block Placer</u></click> from Spectrum.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.germinated_jade: In this §9structure§r, you have found a <keyword>Hibernating Bulb</keyword>, wonder if you can <positive>revive</positive> it.§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.glass_hand.desc: <shake><warning>Handle with care!</warning></shake> The <curse>Glass Hand</curse> doubles the damage dealt by all your attacks - but any damage you take is <shake>quintupled</shake> in return.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.gravity_belt.de: The <wind>Gravity Belt</wind> makes you feel almost as light as air - equipped, your fall <positive>slows dramatically</positive> and you take only a <keyword>quarter</keyword> of the usual fall damage.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.holy_symbol.des:
Use the <positive>Touch of Light</positive> spell on a <property>gold inlay</property> to create this.

<warning>If you don't have the Touch of Light spell yet</warning>, experiment with the mod to unlock it.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.impurity_stabil: An augment for the <keyword>Spirit Crucible</keyword> that subverts the wicked spirit's tendency to prey on the weak: <property>+40% Weakness Tuning</property>, giving a strong bonus to the <keyword>Crucible's weakest attribute</keyword> (besides fuel usage and instability), at the cost of <curse>+8% Tuning Strain</curse>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.incandescent_am:
<keyword>Amalgam</keyword> spawns in <magic>Deeper Down dungeons</magic>.

Can also be <positive>brewed</positive> in the <keyword>Titration Barrel</keyword>. Makes it possible to break §7Dragon bone!§r

As an alternative, you can use a crystal on obsidian.
One <c value=#FEECD6>Ink Flask</c>§r can have only <c value=#9BB8ED>one ink type</c>§r. Ink Assortment can contain all types at once, but has less storage space.§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ink_flask.desc: Used to store and transfer ink. The two ink containers equalize the amount of ink in them, so you can only really transfer half.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.intricate_assem: An augment for the <keyword>Spirit Crucible</keyword>, drawing power from unbounded fractal complexity: <property>+10% Fortune Chance</property>, letting a focusing cycle potentially produce <positive>double the usual items</positive>, at the cost of <warning>+10% Instability</warning> and <curse>-20% Focusing Speed</curse>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.jade_vine_petal:
After <positive>growing</positive> a <keyword>jade bulb</keyword>, <positive>collect</positive> some of its petals

You can read more about growing in the <keyword>book</keyword>!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.knowledge_gem.d:
Used to <positive>transfer <keyword>XP</keyword> to the <keyword>Enchanter</keyword></positive>

Also, you can <positive>enchant</positive> the <keyword>knowledge gem</keyword>:

§lEfficiency§r - increases the internal storage!§r
§lQuick Charge§r - increases the speed of XP transfer!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.magnifying_glas: Once I have enough data on a specific poisonous ingredient, I can hold my <keyword>magnifying glass</keyword> in my hand and hover over it in my inventory to see what <property>affinity</property> this poisonous ingredient is associated with. Oh, the beautiful art of experimental science!
