milf.quest.magic_step_ii.manipulation_tu: The <keyword>Manipulation Turret</keyword> is an <keyword>Ars Elemental</keyword> defense turret that automatically fires at nearby hostile mobs, <turbulence amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>confusing</turbulence> them so they may attack each other.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.mark_of_mastery: The <keyword>Mark of Mastery</keyword> (Ars Elemental) is used at the <keyword>Enchanting Apparatus</keyword> to upgrade a <keyword>Lesser Focus</keyword> into a <keyword>Greater Focus</keyword>, removing its off-element penalty and adding powerful bonuses. It's also required for crafting Elemental armor.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.me_source_jar.d: The <keyword>ME Source Jar</keyword> plugs <property>source</property> into your <keyword>ME network</keyword> - it acts as a regular Source Jar that also stores and exposes source over AE2, so ME-side machines can push and pull source just like any other network resource.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.mending_diffuse: An augment for the <keyword>Spirit Crucible</keyword>, using Living Flesh to sympathize with natural healing: <property>+15% Restoration Chance</property> - each time a focusing cycle finishes, it has a chance to <positive>slightly repair</positive> the <keyword>Impetus</keyword>. It <curse>cannot mend</curse> an already fractured one, though.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.mending_oil_pot: <positive>Mends</positive> the items at the cost of <property>oil</property>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.mermaids_gem.de: If you pay attention while fishing in the <property>deep waters</property>, you will see some <keyword>strange spheres</keyword> sometimes rise to the surface.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.midnight_chip.d: To obtain the §l§0mid§5night §5shard§r, you need to suffocate a living creature in the §l§5mid§0night §l§5so§0lu§5ti§0on§r.§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.mimic_scroll.de: The <keyword>Mimic Scroll</keyword> is placed in an item frame on an inventory - a <keyword>Starbuncle</keyword> will then only deposit items that already exist in that inventory, matching its existing contents.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.mind_shielding_: Worn on the head, the <magic>Mind-Shielding Plate</magic> resists unwanted intrusions into your mind, grants <positive>immunity to nausea</positive>, and lets you retain three quarters of your levels on death.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.mirecap.desc: Hold down the right mouse button + Shift key on the "warped fungus" or "crimson fungus"!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.moonstruck_nect:
<keyword>Moonstack nectar</keyword> can <positive>completely repair tools</positive> or give <property>Regeneration 3</property> for a short period of time if you eat it!

You can <positive>collect nectar</positive> by pressing <positive>RMB</positive> with an empty <keyword>Glass Bottle</keyword> at the moment when the vine turns pink.

The last stage of growth is only possible with a <keyword> full moon</keyword>!

You can read more about it in the <keyword>book</keyword>!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.more_plants.des:
My catalogue of ingredients, although plentiful, can be limiting in its color. I do not have enough ingredients to expand my ideas, my vision! But I know how I can get more. It may seem like these are all the flowers and herbs the world has to offer, but I know simple plant life can be so much more complex. I will imbue these plants, strip them down to their genetical make-up, and create new plants. COMPLETELY REMADE BY MY HAND.

Plants can become new variations of their original. To do so, they need the right items. Through botany, I've learned the practice of grafting and its use in my research. When right-clicking a planted poisonous crop with an item containing an affinity, I can convert it into something new. But the item I use must have a compatible affinity. The crop as well must be a seedling so that it can properly meld with the material.

I should not try to graft materials I know little about. I must first fully understand both the plant I am grafting and the item I am using by discovering both of their affinities. Otherwise, the graft will fail before it even starts, destroying all my efforts. I have already documented all the available variants each of the plants can change into, and their affinities that must be grafted onto them.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.myceylon.desc: Those shrooms look grim, but their §lbark§r is so yummy§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.mysterious_lock:
Steve and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
Create this <keyword>compass</keyword> and find a <magic>mysterious structure</magic>!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.necklace_of_bli: The <keyword>Necklace of Blissful Harmony</keyword> hides your presence from nearby foes, <positive>reducing their aggression</positive> towards you. Its effect is <property>especially potent</property> against creatures carrying a <curse>Wicked</curse> spirit.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.necklace_of_the: The <keyword>Necklace of the Mystic Mirror</keyword> boosts your <property>Arcane Resonance</property> by 100%, <positive>amplifying every effect</positive> that triggers on collecting a <warning>Spirit</warning> - like health regen from the <keyword>Ring of Curative Talent</keyword> or Soul Ward/mana recovery from the <keyword>Ring of Manaweaving</keyword>.

The <keyword>Necklace of the Narrow Edge</keyword> mystically focuses your scythe strikes - <positive>+40% Scythe Proficiency</positive> and the <property>Rebound</property> and <property>Ascension</property> augments, but it <curse>disables Scythe Sweeping</curse>, so only a single target takes the full brunt of the blow.
The <glitch frequency=0.8 shiftChance=0.05><keyword>Necrotic Focus</keyword></glitch> (Ars Elemental) is the corrupted version of the Summon Focus - it boosts <property>Anima</property> school spells and, if your summoned wolves, undead or vexes die while you wear it, they <warning>resurrect once</warning> as stronger revenants that mirror your Homing spells and heal you on kill.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.nightshade.desc:
Grows in <nature>dark forests</nature>.

You can also buy from <keyword>Wandering Trader</keyword>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.oanna_bloom.des: Hold down the <positive>right mouse button + Shift key</positive> on the <keyword>Lily Pad</keyword>!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.oblivion_pickax: This pickaxe <c value=#ECB4B4>deletes</c>§r all of the blocks it mines. Quite handy when you don't care about the blocks you are mining!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ocelot_mint.des:
Grows in <magic>jungles</magic>.

Can be used to <positive>breed</positive> <keyword>ocelots</keyword>.

You can also buy from <keyword>Wandering Trader</keyword>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.oil_base.desc: Now, for those empty pots. They can be filled with replacement oil without recreating the composition in the pot. Just by making this base, we can refill all our oil containers and even sashes. BEAUTIFUL.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.oil_pot_bandoli:
Now that I have a much more durable leather, I only need a very durable metal. The strongest I can find to withstand the chemicals. That's when I came across ancient debris. It's quite fitting it is deep within the bowels of the Nether.

It was time to expand my arsenal. I have realized the potential Netherite has. So much I could do with such a durable material. And I'll start it with this new Oil Pot Bandolier.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.oil_pot_sash.de: Allows you to <positive>throw oils</positive>. Can become <property>handy</property> in the future.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.oil_pots.desc:
You can use an <keyword>oil pot</keyword> by <positive>placing it</positive> with <positive>Shift + RMB</positive> and clicking it with a <keyword>weapon</keyword>. The weapon will gain the <property>effect of the oil</property>. 
Alternatively, you can hold the <keyword>oil pot</keyword> in your <keyword>offhand</keyword> and the <keyword>weapon</keyword> in your <keyword>main hand</keyword>. 
All of these actions <warning>consume a bit of oil</warning>... maybe there's a way to <positive>make it infinite</positive>?…
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.oil_pots.title: Oil pots
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.paltaeria_fragm: Note that <property>paltaeria fragments</property> will float away once they're mined! Place something above to catch them, or come up with something more clever.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.paracausal_flam:
Ah, a pact that binds forever is a heavy thing. <curse><pulse base=0.6 amplitude=0.9>Geasa</pulse></curse> are potent, yes, and can achieve powerful effects, but their downsides are constant companions. These pacts can be <keyword>forsworn</keyword> on the <fire>Brazier</fire>, allowing you to decide what price you are willing to pay.

To forswear a geas, assemble it on the <fire>Brazier</fire> as you did initially, but use the <flame>Paracausal Flame</flame> to kindle the Brazier instead. This will burn the contract away instead of inscribe it. The rest of the process works the same, including <curse>Weakness</curse>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.particle_spawne:
It's practically <c value=#C6BCE9>/particle</c>§r!§r

The particle generator <c value=#FEECD6>allows</c>§r you to create most of the <c value=#CAE4C8>Minecraft</c>§r particles. Incredible special effects for any <c value=#9BB8ED>build</c>§r!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.pedestal_moonst:
<positive>Improve</positive> your <keyword>final pedestal</keyword>!

Don’t forget to check out the <magic>church in the city bellow</magic> for all the <keyword>necessary blocks</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.pedestal_onyx.d: Before improving an <keyword>altar</keyword> make sure you have all the blocks to improve it, some blocks need to be created in the <warning>previous altar</warning>!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.plague_doctor_h:
An outfit from a bygone age. Their style was very fitting in their time. With some minor improvements, I've made it coat me perfectly. Now, for the remaining parts.

I must admit, my pants were the most tattered of all my attire. So having fresh leggings is a euphoric feeling. Otherwise, the breeze would have made my skin crawl and my nights freezing.

To avoid having fungus feet, some nice pair of boots will be invaluable. Always a fresh pair, except these ones are already infused with my <poison>toxin</poison>. Almost feel like my feet are being cleansed by the fumes. Plus the pain.

Finally, the centerpiece of the suit. The mask that personified the period. The Plague Mask. Although I've placed a convenient hood over it for days of rain. This mask will greatly benefit the sometimes overpowering <poison>toxins</poison>.

The plague doctor outfit has a rather potent effect. When afflicted by a hazardous ailment such as slowness or blindness, the effect won't last as long. The amount of time the effect is reduced by depends on how many parts of the outfit I am wearing. It can even nullify the effect completely, if it's already applied for a very short span of time.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.planarium.desc:
The <keyword>Planarium</keyword> is a jar that holds its own small <keyword>pocket dimension</keyword>. Name it with the <keyword>Name Glyph</keyword> or an anvil to create a unique dimension, then <positive>sneak-interact</positive> with the jar to enter it.

Blocks placed inside are rendered on the jar itself. To leave, just break any of the boundary walls. Use the <keyword>Dominion Wand</keyword> on a boundary wall and then on a spot inside to set your <keyword>spawn point</keyword> for next time.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.planter.desc:
In <keyword>Planter</keyword>, you can grow specific plants such as the <keyword>Mirecap Mushroom</keyword> / the <keyword>Flowering Oanna</keyword> / <keyword>Sildrian Seed</keyword> / <keyword>Sprig Of Avennian</keyword>

Use an <keyword>athame</keyword> to <positive>gather plants</positive>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.poison_blend.de: After reviewing my old studies, I managed to obtain some recipe for making specialty blends for consumption. Maybe I'll try some a little each day. Although not a leaf more. This is a rather dangerous game.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.portable_brazie: The <keyword>Portable Brazier Relay</keyword> (Ars Controle) lets you carry a ritual's effects with you, as long as the <keyword>Ritual Brazier</keyword> stays loaded and has a supply of <property>source</property>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.potion_flask.de:
<poison>Toxic paste</poison> is extremely unstable. But its volatility will be the highlight of my next alchemical instrument! Potions are too refined, too narrow. By creating a flask that yields greater capacity and putting a little bit of the paste inside, I can make a much more efficient and possibly renewable potion container.

To fill the flask, I need another potion in my other hand and then use the flask to pour it inside. Because of how unstable the paste is, I will be able to create a <poison>toxic formula</poison> that can refill its contents without recompositing another potion. This makes the potions renewable! However, because of its <poison>toxins</poison>, it has a high <poison>toxicity level</poison>. Monitor your toxicity levels with the toxicity gauge after repeated use of the flask.

What's even more curious is, if I ever get my hands on an enchanting book that roughly translates to «Refill», then the contents of my empty flask will be refilled just by sleeping through the night! Although I have my qualms with enchanting, I cannot deny its utility in my experiments!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.potion_workshop: A more advanced <keyword>station</keyword> for creating <keyword>potions</keyword>. Can also create some other liquids.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.prestigious_pal: This glove-shaped charm, the <named>Prestigious Palm</named>, lets you touch what once escaped your grasp - roughly <property>doubling</property> your interaction range.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.prickly_bayleaf: Those <keyword>prickly leaves</keyword> can only be acquired with <keyword>shears</keyword> - <warning>no other tool will work</warning>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.prismatic_focus: An augment for the <keyword>Spirit Crucible</keyword> that bends the flow of arcana rather than light: <property>-15% Instability</property>. Keep in mind, stability can only prevent the <keyword>Impetus</keyword> from taking <warning>additional</warning> damage - it won't undo damage already dealt.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.prismatic_web.d: Can be used to <positive>remove</positive> <warning><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>curses</shake></warning>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.q0f0e6466872157:
Place a Goblet on an altar to increase its capacity by 2. 

It can also be filled with blood by killing something atop it, which is used for some magic.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.q173490a557431c: Some <c value=#C6BCE9>endermen</c>§r appearing in your world hold blocks that seem to emit an <c value=#ECB4B4>spooky aura</c>§r.§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.q21ec4b09de3636: Give your <named>Ars Ecclesia</named> to the village cleric!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.q27b5155ad94e69: Find a <magic>lost city</magic> in the <magic>Deeper Down</magic>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.q28044eac12575b: <positive>Grow</positive> the <keyword>Kindling</keyword> and take its feather by pressing <positive>Shift + RMB</positive> with <keyword>Shears</keyword> on the adult.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.q28a2fcbc095f29: <positive>Use</positive> the <keyword>poison paste</keyword> on <keyword>farmland</keyword>. Can farm <keyword>plants</keyword> from this mod, but will destroy neighboring "normal" farmland.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.q2d8c9df5e216e0: Sometimes, you've started to notice <c value=#C6BCE9>stars</c>§r falling from the sky. Try <c value=#FEECD6>breaking</c>§r them and collecting their <c value=#C6BCE9>fragments</c>§r and <c value=#C6BCE9>dust</c>§r, they are very useful!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.q2f9109dbadadee:
<keyword>Charms</keyword> are a set of curios enchanted with strong protection magics. They range from allowing you to walk on <keyword>Powdered Snow</keyword>, to saving you from the <keyword>Warden's</keyword> powerful <property>Sonic Boom</property>.

Each charm has a specific amount of <keyword>charges</keyword> available to protect you. Once the charges have been <warning>depleted</warning>, pop them into an <keyword>Imbuement chamber</keyword> to charge them back up.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.q30e5427b2f94dc: Collect all <c value=#FEECD6>available</c>§r pigments. Unfortunately, you <c value=#d33b2b>don't see a way</c>§r to get brown pigment with your CMY gemstone pallete. If only there was a way to get black...§r
<c value=#C6BCE9>Quitoxic Reeds</c>§r can be found in <c value=#CAE4C8>swamps</c>§r!§r

Grows on mud or clay. While growing, <c value=#FEECD6>consumes</c>§r mud and clay blocks around itself, turning them into dirt.§r

§n§l<c value=#FEECD6>Tip:</c>§r§r§r use the <c value=#CAE4C8>Nature's compass</c>§r to find the swamp easier! It spawns in all swamps, not only vanilla ones! To get one, progress some more in the main questline.§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.raven_cloak.des: The <named>Raven Cloak</named> unfurls into a pair of wings. Tap or hold <keyword>jump</keyword> to flap and glide through the air, then hold <keyword>sneak</keyword> to land <wave>gently</wave>.
By fusing a <keyword>Soulwoven Pouch</keyword> with rot, it sprouts teeth and becomes the <shake><warning>Ravenous Pouch</warning></shake> - it works like a magnet, <positive>automatically</positive> sucking up items lying on the ground, but only the kinds it already has some of stored inside.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.redstone_mixtur:
However, there is a catch to mutagens. Not all of them are the same, and the one I get greatly depends on the INGREDIENTS I CONSUME. As such when eating substances or making blends, I must be mindful of which ones I eat, as each ingredient contains an affinity for one aspect of the world that another may not share.

To discover these affinities within <poison>poisonous ingredients</poison>, I must do one of two things. Either I consume it in great quantities until I figure it out, which is quite painful. Or something much more efficient. I've learned a way to deconstruct an ingredients chemical makeup into a more pure substance. And watch its effects as a third party spectator.

Redstone is quite sensitive to the <poison>toxic components</poison> of poisonous ingredients, as seen used by my toxicity gauge. First, I must turn it into a mixture.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.redstone_soluti: Next, I must heat it in a crucible to remove any impurities.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.regeneration_to: If I feel particularly HORRIBLE, then I may want to produce this regeneration oil pot. Fragrant and REVOLTING to the touch, it does the opposite of what most of my oils do, and as such would be quite appealing to doctors in the field.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.relay.desc:
The <keyword>Source Relay</keyword> transports <property>source</property> between <keyword>Source Jars</keyword> and other <keyword>Source Relays</keyword>.

To pull source from a jar, use the <keyword>Dominion Wand</keyword> on the jar and then on the relay. To send source between relays, or from a relay to a jar, use the wand on the relay first and then on the target. Relays can only reach up to <keyword>30 blocks</keyword> away. Sneak while using the wand on a relay to clear its connections.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.relay_collector:
The <keyword>Source Relay: Collector</keyword> works like a regular <keyword>Source Relay</keyword>, but will automatically draw source from any <keyword>Source Jars</keyword> within <property>5 blocks</property>, even if they are not linked to it.

See the <keyword>Source Relay</keyword> for usage instructions.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.relay_deposit.d:
The <keyword>Source Relay: Deposit</keyword> works like a regular <keyword>Source Relay</keyword>, but will automatically deposit source into any <keyword>Source Jars</keyword> within <property>5 blocks</property>, even if they are not linked to it.

See the <keyword>Source Relay</keyword> for usage instructions.
The <keyword>Source Relay: Splitter</keyword> works like a regular <keyword>Source Relay</keyword>, but can take from and send to <property>multiple jars</property> at once.

It has a much higher throughput than a regular relay, which is split evenly amongst all of its connected jars. See the <keyword>Source Relay</keyword> for usage instructions.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.relay_warp.desc:
The <keyword>Source Relay: Warp</keyword> works like the <keyword>Source Relay: Splitter</keyword>, but can teleport <property>source</property> an unlimited distance between other <keyword>Warp Relays</keyword>.

Beyond <keyword>30 blocks</keyword>, there is a <warning>chance that some source will be lost</warning> during the warp.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.repair_pylon.de: Working with the <keyword>Spirit Crucible</keyword> tends to <curse>wear down and fracture</curse> your <keyword>Impetus</keyword>. Feed the <keyword>Repair Pylon</keyword> some <warning>Spirit Arcana</warning> plus a matching repair material, and it will <positive>automatically find and repair</positive> any damaged Impetus sitting on a nearby Item Pedestal, Item Stand or in the Crucible itself. It can also repair <keyword>ordinary and magical tools</keyword> the same way using <warning>Spirits</warning> instead of experience - restoring <property>half their durability</property>, or <property>three quarters</property> for gear made from materials that resonate with spirits.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.resolute_belt.d: An exceedingly heavy belt - the <bone>Resolute Belt</bone> renders you almost <property>immovable</property>. Any knockback you receive is not only negated, but <curse>reflected</curse> back onto your attacker.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.resonance_tuner: A <keyword>core augment</keyword> for the <keyword>Spirit Crucible</keyword>. The <keyword>Resonance Tuner</keyword> dampens the clash between Aerial and Earthen arcana, granting <property>+100% Resonance Tuning</property> - <positive>heavily reducing</positive> (or even eliminating) <warning>Instability</warning> at the cost of a slower process.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.resonant_pickax:
Could be used to <positive>mine pure resources</positive>, as well as some <warning>fragile blocks</warning>

Like the <keyword>Resonance</keyword> enchantment, this pickaxe also allows you to mine <warning>spawners</warning>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.reversal_pick.d:
This peculiar tool seems to disobey normal material properties.
The harder a block is, the quicker this pick breaks it; the softer a block is, the more resistance it gives.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ring_of_alchemi: The <keyword>Ring of Alchemical Mastery</keyword> manipulates the potions running through your blood - each time you collect a <warning>Spirit</warning>, it <curse>partially filters out negative effects</curse> while <positive>prolonging positive ones</positive>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ring_of_arcane_: The <keyword>Ring of Arcane Prowess</keyword> feeds off excess magical energy - every time you collect a <warning>Spirit</warning>, you gain a small amount of <positive>experience</positive>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ring_of_curativ: The <keyword>Ring of Curative Talent</keyword> reacts to <warning>Spirit</warning> collection - every time you pick one up, it <positive>restores a small amount of health</positive>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ring_of_despera: The <keyword>Ring of Desperate Voracity</keyword> makes <curse>rotten food</curse> a bit more bearable, letting you gain more hunger and saturation from it. It also <positive>extends the duration</positive> of the <curse>Gluttony</curse> effect granted by the <keyword>Belt of the Starved</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ring_of_esoteri: The <keyword>Ring of Esoteric Spoils</keyword> grants <property>+1 Spirit Spoils</property> - every mob you kill with a <keyword>Scythe</keyword> now <positive>sheds an extra Soul</positive> on top of its usual drop, letting you farm <warning>Souls</warning> much faster.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ring_of_manawea: <property>Soul Ward</property> is a powerful barrier, but it's slow to recover on its own. The <keyword>Ring of Manaweaving</keyword> reacts to <warning>Spirit</warning> collection, <positive>accelerating the recovery</positive> of your Soul Ward and Spell Mana every time you pick one up.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ring_of_the_dem: The <keyword>Ring of the Demolitionist</keyword> <positive>amplifies explosions</positive> - if raw explosive power isn't enough, this ring makes sure you're never lacking in <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>dakka</shake>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ring_of_the_hoa: Explosions are chaotic - great for mining, terrible for looting. The <keyword>Ring of the Hoarder</keyword> entangles the blast with your soul, causing all the <positive>debris and loot</positive> to appear <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>right at your feet</shake> instead of scattering everywhere.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ring_of_the_how: The <keyword>Ring of the Howling Maelstrom</keyword> alters the <property>Rebound</property> enchantment - when you throw your scythe, <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>cutting winds</shake> spin around it, damaging nearby foes, at the cost of a longer cooldown. Wear it together with the <keyword>Necklace of the Narrow Edge</keyword> to concentrate the winds into a small storm the moment your scythe lands a hit.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ring_of_the_ris: The <keyword>Ring of the Rising Edge</keyword> alters the <property>Ascension</property> enchantment - at the cost of reduced damage, foes cut by its wind blades are <wave>launched upwards</wave>, great for crowd control. Wear it together with the <keyword>Necklace of the Narrow Edge</keyword> to launch enemies with far greater force.
The <keyword>Ritual of Binding</keyword>, cast near an entity, turns it into a <keyword>Bound Script</keyword> - use that script to learn the entity as a <keyword>Familiar</keyword> in your spell book. Summoning a familiar gives you <warning><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>Familiar Sickness</shake></warning> for a short while, preventing you from summoning another one right away.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.ritual_wilden_s: Without augments, the <keyword>Ritual of Wilden Summon</keyword> summons a random assortment of Wilden monsters for a short fight. Augment it with a <keyword>Wilden Spike</keyword>, <keyword>Wilden Horn</keyword> and <keyword>Wilden Wing</keyword> instead to summon the <warning><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.2>Wilden Chimera</shake></warning> boss.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.rotating_spell_: The <keyword>Rotating Spell Turret</keyword> can be aimed with the <keyword>Dominion Wand</keyword> at a target position - it slowly rotates towards that heading before firing, letting you set up sweeping or precisely angled shots.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.runewood_obelis:
Maximum: 4

Each one increases the altar crafting speed by 25%.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.runewood_totem_:
There are many different <keyword>rituals</keyword> - check them out in the <keyword>guidebook</keyword>!

One of the important rituals is the <property>5 Arcana</property>; it creates a <named>Soulwood sapling</named>. Be sure to read more about it in the <keyword>guidebook</keyword>!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.runic_workbench: The <pulse><keyword>Runic Workbench</keyword></pulse> is used to craft <warning>Runes</warning> and <keyword>Brooches</keyword> - trinkets equipped in their own accessory slots that grant <positive>passive bonuses</positive> like extra damage, speed or healing. <keyword>Brooches</keyword> also let you trade other trinket slots for more <warning>Rune</warning> slots, so you can stack even more bonuses.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.sanguine_amulet: The <blood>Sanguine Amulet</blood> quietly stores up the health you regenerate while at full hearts, then releases that <positive>stored healing</positive> the moment you're hurt.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.sapping_sword.d: The <blood>Sword of Sapping</blood> deals <curse>wither</curse> damage on top of its normal strike, and any damage dealt this way <positive>heals</positive> you back.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.scribes_table.d:
In this pack glyphs aren't crafted directly at the <keyword>Scribe's Table</keyword> - instead, craft a <keyword>Codex Entry</keyword>, <keyword>Lost Codex Entry</keyword> or <keyword>Ancient Codex Entry</keyword> to get a <positive>random glyph</positive> of that tier.

The table is still useful together with a <keyword>Blank Parchment</keyword> and your spell book: inscribe a spell recipe onto the parchment, then place it into a <keyword>Spell Turret</keyword> so it automatically casts your spell at the cost of <property>source</property>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.scryers_linkage:
Entangled block
The <named>Scryer's Linkage</named> <positive>links</positive> to another block, allowing machines to interact with its linked block from distance places.

It is capable of linking items, liquids, energy, redstone, and a few other things.

To configure it, use a Dominion Wand first on the block you want to link to, then the linkage.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.shapers_focus.d: The <keyword>Shapers Focus</keyword> is required to cast spells that manipulate blocks - Conjuration Essence and other block-shaping glyphs like <property>Snare</property> or <property>Dispel</property> need it to place, remove or transform blocks.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.shielding_appar: An augment for the <keyword>Spirit Crucible</keyword>, using the multiphasic property of Soulstained Steel: <property>+10% Damage Absorption Chance</property> and <positive>-5% Instability</positive> - gives a chance to <positive>completely absorb</positive> damage dealt to the <keyword>Impetus</keyword>, at the cost of <curse>-20% Focusing Speed</curse>.
The <keyword>Siren Familiar</keyword> (Ars Elemental) is a personal companion version of the Siren, separate from the tamed Siren used at a Siren Shrine to passively generate fishing loot.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.smoke_tox_pot.d: There are some situations where covering your tracks will be STUPID. As such I have improved on my fatigue oil composition and with some enhancements from <poison>TOXIN</poison>, I have managed to create this cloudy gas that weakens and blinds in a small area.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.soul_shard.desc: Once you've obtained your first <soul>Soul Shards</soul> with the Crystsallization Ritual, you'll be able to <positive>summon</positive> the mobs you need and kill them again and again!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.soul_touched_sc: The <keyword>Soul-Touched Sculkshelf</keyword> is an advanced bookshelf crafted from <warning>Warden</warning> drops - one of the strongest for your enchanting table, and it also reveals an extra hidden enchantment in the table's menu, same as the Shelf of Sight.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.soulbinding_bra:
The <pulse><keyword>Soulbinding Brazier</keyword></pulse> is used to swear a <warning>Geas</warning> - a magical oath bound <curse>semi-permanently</curse> to your soul, granting a powerful effect at the cost of a fitting drawback. Socket the <keyword>prime item</keyword>, <warning>Spirit Arcana</warning> and other ingredients into the brazier - if the items <positive>rise up above it</positive>, your recipe is correct.

Add <keyword>Ether</keyword> to start the craft. Once started - add your <curse>blood</curse> to the altar by pressing <property>RMB</property> (multiple players can contribute to a single ritual), then just wait.

You can also add the blood of any other creature. To do so, apply a <warning>weakness</warning> effect to it before lighting the brazier.

A player can have a maximum of <property>2 Geas</property> bound at once. They are also <curse>difficult to remove</curse>, so choose wisely.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.soulbone_amulet: Crafted from the bones of the dead and the heart of a wraith, the <soul>Soulbone Amulet</soul> grants <soul>ethereal hearts</soul> upon slaying an enemy - up to 10 by default, consumed before your normal health.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.soulfire_wand.d: A showcase of the power hidden within a shadow gem - the <magic>Soulfire Wand</magic> unleashes <fire>brilliant bolts of energy</fire> on every swing, dealing hefty damage to almost any target.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.soulwoven_banne: Banners can be repainted using souls
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.soulwoven_pouch:
Holds 512 items
The <pulse><keyword>Soulwoven Pouch</keyword></pulse> acts like a bundle, but also <positive>automatically</positive> snaps up any <warning>Spirits</warning> you collect, keeping your inventory clear of clutter. Stored magical items are <wave>rotated slightly out of reality</wave>, taking up less space than they normally would.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.source_condense:
The <keyword>Source Condenser</keyword> draws <keyword>source</keyword> from connected <keyword>source jars</keyword> and converts it into <property>liquid source</property>.

The resulting liquid can be put to a variety of uses, such as building a <magic>source stone generator</magic> powered by lava and liquid source.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.source_jar.desc:
The <keyword>Source Jar</keyword> stores <property>source</property> for later use, up to <keyword>10000</keyword>. Fill it by pouring liquid source into it, or right-clicking it with a bucket of liquid source.

Use the <keyword>Dominion Wand</keyword> on the jar and then on a device or relay to link them - once linked, the device will draw source from the jar automatically whenever it needs it.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.source_manipula:
<property>Source</property> is the magic energy of <keyword>Ars Nouveau</keyword>, used to power its devices.

In this pack it's obtained as <keyword>Ethereal Source</keyword>, which you convert into liquid source using the <keyword>Fluid Sourcelink</keyword>. From there it's stored in <keyword>Source Jars</keyword> and moved around with <keyword>Source Relays</keyword>. The next quests will walk you through each step in detail.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_arborists: Keep a <nature>sapling</nature> in your <keyword>first inventory slot</keyword> and cast it to <nature><wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>grow</wiggle></nature> and <positive>fell</positive> trees like a true magical lumberjack
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_arcane_sc: Marks the target with <curse>wicked magic</curse>: <property>Wither</property> eats away its life, and <property>Hex</property> makes it <warning>vulnerable to your next spells</warning>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_archers.d:
Summons a squad of <bone>skeleton archers</bone> with enchanted bows to fight for you

Replace <property>Pierce</property> with another <property>Amplify</property> to get melee skeletons instead
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_autoharve: Aim at a <keyword>slab or fence post</keyword> in the middle of a field: for a while the spell keeps <nature>growing</nature> and <positive>harvesting</positive> the crops around it. Works great in a <keyword>spell turret</keyword>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_berry_pic:
Meant for a <keyword>spell turret</keyword>: <nature>grows</nature> and <positive>harvests</positive> a field of up to <property>32</property> <keyword>Source Berry</keyword> bushes at rapid speed

Works on <positive>modded bushes</positive> too - any bush that grows from <nature>bone meal</nature> and is harvested with <keyword>RMB</keyword>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_binder.de: The <keyword>SpellBinder</keyword> (Not Enough Glyphs) is an alternative to the spell book that can hold up to 25 spells from caster tomes or parchments - great for spells you're done tweaking, or for sharing magic without handing over your whole book. It also has its own Thread slots for special bonuses (like Focus, Randomize or turning it into a melee weapon).
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_bladestor: Surrounds you with a <keyword>whirling ring of blades</keyword> that <warning>cut</warning> anything that comes too close
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_bow.desc: The <keyword>Spell Bow</keyword> is inscribed with a spell at the Scribe's Table - if you have enough source, your arrows become Spell Arrows that apply it on hit. Works even without arrows in your inventory (a harmless spell arrow is used), and Augment Arrows can empower the effect.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_bridge_ch: Fire it at the <keyword>opposite wall</keyword> of a chasm to build a <positive>narrow bridge</positive> you can walk across
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_cloudkill: Leaves a lingering <poison>poisonous cloud</poison> where it lands, and the cloud keeps <warning>damaging</warning> everything inside
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_conjure_g: Conjures a <keyword>3x3</keyword> patch of <nature>sand</nature>, <flame>smelts</flame> it into <positive>glass</positive> and picks it up. Best used in a <keyword>spell turret</keyword> with a chest next to it to collect the glass
The <keyword>Spell Crossbow</keyword> works like the Spell Bow, but the source cost is deducted when you load it rather than when you fire - if you have enough source, the loaded bolt applies your inscribed spell on hit. Augment Arrows can empower it too.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_dome_of_b: <aqua>Evaporates</aqua> all liquid around you, giving you room to <positive>breathe and move</positive> underwater
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_ethereal_:
Makes the blocks ahead of you <magic>intangible</magic> for a while, opening a <positive>path through walls and floors</positive>

<warning>Get out before the blocks come back!</warning>
Clears out a <keyword>huge area</keyword> at once and puts the drops <positive>straight into your inventory</positive>

Carry a <property>Jar of Voiding</property> so that cobblestone doesn't <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>flood your bag</shake>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_fire_rune:
Places a <flame>fire rune</flame> on a wall or floor that triggers when an enemy touches it

Make it permanent with <named>Runic Chalk</named> and put a <named>source jar</named> nearby for a simple <positive>base defense</positive>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_flight.de: Launches you up and lets you <wind>glide</wind> through the air like with an elytra for a <positive>long time</positive>. Swap <property>Self</property> for <property>Touch</property> to give it to another player
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_floating_: Cast it <wind>mid-air</wind> to create a <positive>temporary platform</positive> under your feet
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_horn.desc: The <keyword>Spell Horn</keyword> (Ars Elemental) is a chargeable casting tool - hold the charge to cast your inscribed spell on yourself and nearby entities, the longer you charge it, the wider the area of effect.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_ice_field: Creates an <aqua>icy field</aqua> of <warning>damaging spikes</warning> that <property>snares</property> enemies for a while
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_improved_: An <keyword>electric</keyword> projectile that <warning><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>shocks</shake></warning> the target, then after a short <property>Delay</property> strikes it with a <warning>second discharge</warning>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_instant_t: <wind>Teleports</wind> you to where you're looking, up to <property>128 blocks</property> away
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_miners_fo: Mines a <keyword>whole ore vein</keyword> at once with <positive><pulse>Fortune</pulse></positive> and picks up the drops
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_mirror.de: The <keyword>Spell Mirror</keyword> reflects any spell projectile that hits it at a mirrored angle - it can be placed on walls, floors or ceilings, and needs a supporting block behind it to stay placed.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_nightstal: Grants you <magic><fade minAlpha=0.4 frequency=1.0>night vision</fade></magic> for a <positive>long time</positive>. Swap <property>Self</property> for <property>Touch</property> to give it to another player
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_prism.des: The <keyword>Spell Prism</keyword> redirects any <property>Projectile</property> spell that hits it in the direction the prism is facing, and sends a signal to nearby <keyword>Observers</keyword> whenever it redirects a spell.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_rainbow_r: The spell leaves a trail of <positive>floating platforms</positive> behind it - a solid walkway right in the air. Set the spell color to rainbow for extra <wiggly>fun</wiggly>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_rocket_la:
Ever wanted to go to <magic><wave>space</wave></magic>? Launches you <wind>sky-high</wind>, and <property>Bounce</property> makes sure you <positive>survive</positive> the fall

Swap <property>Self</property> for <property>Touch</property> or <property>Projectile</property> to launch someone else. <warning>Works on blocks too</warning>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_surface_s:
Aim <keyword>straight at the ceiling</keyword>: the spell bores a tunnel through the stone and <wind>launches</wind> you up for a <positive>quick exit</positive> from the depths

<warning>Leaves a hole in the world</warning>
Conjures a <keyword>box of mage blocks</keyword> around you. A good spell to cast <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>in a panic</shake>!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_tunnel.de:
Digs a <keyword>3x3 tunnel</keyword> and picks up everything it breaks. Pairs nicely with a <property>Jar of Voiding</property>

Replace <property>Pierce</property> with <property>Extract</property> if you need Silk Touch
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_turret.de: The <keyword>Spell Turret</keyword> is an upgrade of the <keyword>Basic Spell Turret</keyword> - it can cast a spell using any glyphs, not just the free ones, at the cost of <property>source</property>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_unnoticed: <wind>Teleports</wind> you forward, makes you <magic><fade minAlpha=0.4 frequency=1.0>invisible</fade></magic> and leaves a <keyword>decoy</keyword> behind to take the hits
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_wall_of_s: Raises a <positive>permanent</positive> wall of <keyword>stone</keyword> - seal off a passage in a pinch or put up a wall in seconds
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_yeet.desc: Sends the target <wind>high into the sky</wind>, <warning>hurts</warning> it on the way and then <bounce amplitude=1.5 frequency=1.2 phase=1.0>slams</bounce> it back down with <property>Gravity</property>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spell_zeus_voll: Calls down a straight <keyword>line of lightning</keyword> in front of you, <warning><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>striking everything</shake></warning> along the way
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spellweaving_ax: The <keyword>Spellweaving Axe</keyword> is imbued with <keyword>aqueous arcana</keyword> - once <pulse>primed</pulse>, every block you break spawns up to <property>4 loci</property> that automatically seek out and break far-out matching blocks, letting you <positive>clear whole trees</positive> in seconds.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spellweaving_pi: The <keyword>Spellweaving Pickaxe</keyword> is imbued with <keyword>earthen arcana</keyword> - once <pulse>primed</pulse>, every block you mine spawns up to <property>4 loci</property> that automatically seek out and break nearby matching blocks for you, mining <positive>whole veins</positive> in an instant.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spirit_altar.de: The <pulse><keyword>Spirit Altar</keyword></pulse> is the heart of Malum's infusion crafting. Kill mobs with a <keyword>Scythe</keyword> to reap their <warning>Spirits</warning> - place the <keyword>base item</keyword> together with the required <warning>Spirits</warning> on the altar itself, then arrange the other crafting ingredients on the surrounding <keyword>Runewood Item Pedestals</keyword>, and the altar will <wave><positive>weave</positive></wave> them together into the infused result.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spirit_catalyze: Simply placing the <keyword>Spirit Catalyzer</keyword> near a <keyword>Spirit Crucible</keyword> does nothing on its own - <warning>right-click it with fuel</warning>, just like a furnace (regular coal, charcoal or a lava bucket all work). Once burning, it boosts any Crucible within <property>4 blocks</property>, <positive>speeding up its focusing process</positive>. Up to <property>8 fueled Catalyzers</property> can stack together for even more speed, but each one also raises <warning>instability</warning>, risking extra damage to the <keyword>Impetus</keyword> inside.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.spirit_crucible:
The <pulse><keyword>Spirit Crucible</keyword></pulse> performs <keyword>Spirit Focusing</keyword> - socket an <keyword>Impetus</keyword> (a durable reagent, like the <keyword>Alchemical Impetus</keyword>) together with <warning>Spirit Arcana</warning>, and it will <positive>transmute</positive> new resources cycle after cycle, slowly <curse>damaging the Impetus</curse> each time until it fractures. Speed it up with a <keyword>Spirit Catalyzer</keyword>, tune its stats with a <keyword>Tuning Fork</keyword>, and keep a <keyword>Repair Pylon</keyword> nearby to mend the Impetus before it breaks for good.

You can push its stats around with <keyword>Augments</keyword> (up to 4 in the Crucible itself, or one in each nearby <keyword>Spirit Catalyzer</keyword>). Here's what each attribute they touch actually does:

<property>Focusing Speed</property> - how fast a cycle completes. 

<property>Fuel Usage Rate</property> - how much fuel a cycle burns through. 

<warning>Instability</warning> - the risk of the Impetus taking <curse>extra damage</curse> per cycle. 

<positive>Fortune Chance</positive> - odds of a cycle producing double the items. 

<positive>Chain Focusing Chance</positive> - odds of an extra cycle firing right after the current one. 

<positive>Restoration Chance</positive> - odds of the Impetus <positive>healing slightly</positive> after a cycle. 

<positive>Damage Absorption Chance</positive> - odds of fully blocking a hit of damage to the Impetus. 

<keyword>Resonance Tuning</keyword> - slows the process but heavily cuts Instability. 

<keyword>Weakness Tuning</keyword> - boosts whichever attribute is currently weakest. 

<keyword>Misfortune Reversal</keyword> - turns Impetus damage into a bonus once it's healed. 

<keyword>Caustic Synergy</keyword> - converts rising Instability into more <keyword>Tuning Potency</keyword>. 

<curse>Tuning Strain</curse> - makes the <keyword>Tuning Fork</keyword>'s attribute-shifting cost more.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.stabilized_warp: The <keyword>Stabilized Warp Index</keyword> is an upgrade of the regular one - it lets you access your <keyword>Storage Lecterns</keyword> remotely across <keyword>dimensions</keyword> as well, not just within the same one.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.starbuncle_char:
The <keyword>Starbuncle</keyword> is a little familiar that carries items between inventories for you - it collects nearby drops and hauls goods from one container to another, and will also harvest fully grown <keyword>Source Berry</keyword> bushes on its own.

Bind it to inventories with the <keyword>Dominion Wand</keyword>, and use <keyword>Allow</keyword>/<keyword>Deny</keyword> scrolls to filter which items it's allowed to move.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.starbuncle_shad: <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0><keyword>Starbuncle Shades</keyword></wiggle> disable a Starbuncle's ability to pick up items or harvest Source Berries - use the Dominion Wand on it to remove the shades again.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.storm_stone.des:
When <warning><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.6>lightning</shake></warning> hits the ground, it leaves <property>small shards</property> behind.

Use <keyword>lightning rods</keyword> to have more consistent <named>Storm Stone</named> generation. You can use the <magic>Fusion Shrine</magic> to summon <warning><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.6>thunderstorms</shake></warning>!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.stratine_fragme: Quite <c value=#FEECD6>bad</c>§r for bridges and diving!§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.stratine_gem.de: <keyword>Rare gemstones</keyword> that can be obtained while <positive>mining stratine ore</positive>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.straw_effigy.de: To speak with the powers that be, an <named>icon</named> is needed first. The <bone>Straw Effigy</bone> is crude, but once placed atop an <keyword>altar</keyword> it gives your prayers something to <magic>direct themselves at</magic> - maybe they'll be heard.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.summon_focus.de: The <keyword>Summon Focus</keyword> is a curio that buffs your summoning spells - equip it to make your summoned creatures stronger.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.suspicious_devi: A <keyword>core augment</keyword> for the <keyword>Spirit Crucible</keyword>, made by opposing Arcane and Eldritch arcana. In theory it should create balance - in practice, the two forces <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>violently reject each other</shake>, causing a <curse>corruptive explosion</curse> that spawns <curse>Blight</curse>. <warning>This entry is a warning, not a recommendation.</warning>
A <keyword>core augment</keyword> for the <keyword>Spirit Crucible</keyword>, harnessing the opposition between Wicked and Sacred arcana, granting <property>+100% Misfortune Reversal</property>. When your <keyword>Impetus</keyword> takes damage, the <keyword>Sympathy Drive</keyword> remembers - and when it's healed by a <keyword>Mending Diffuser</keyword>, it <positive>'forgives' the damage</positive>, repairing further and boosting stats for the next <property>3 cycles</property>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.t3_glyphs.title: t3 glyphs
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.temporal_stabil:
TPS-metr
The Temporal Stability Sensor shows how unstable the time of the world is.

Using a comparator, you can find out how close the world is to lagging, with higher redstone output meaning the world is closer to lagging.

You can use this to turn off farms automatically to prevent the server from lagging.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.time_sand_pouch: Allows to store §otime§r while the §mbottle§r <keyword>Pouch</keyword> is in the player inventory. When enough time is stored, you can <positive>speed up block entities</positive>. More clicks = more speed increase. §r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.timer_spell_tur: The <keyword>Timer Spell Turret</keyword> fires automatically on a timer (default 1 second) - right-click to increase the interval, punch to decrease it, or sneak for 10-second steps. Setting it to 0 or feeding it a Redstone signal disables it. Lock it with the <keyword>Dominion Wand</keyword> to prevent further changes.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.totemic_staff.d: Shows the working radius of totems.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.tox_gauge.desc:
To use the §5device§r, I simply hold it in my §ohand§r (or as a §lcharm§r on my person) and what will appear is a gauge that displays <keyword>useful information</keyword> about my bodies chemical composition. The <poison>toxicity</poison> gauge examines 3 important parts of my body. The <poison>toxins</poison>, my <property>tolerance</property>, and the §9thresholds§r I can reach!§r

The §2green bar§r displays how much toxins are <poison>already in my system</poison>. Of course §oeating§r or §odrinking§r <poison>poisonous</poison> substances will increase this amount. And if my diet is poison-less, the toxins will very <poison>slowly dissipate</poison> from my body till none remains. But that isn't the goal is it?§r

And as much as I want to §5experiment§r with my own chemical makeup, the <warning>flesh</warning> is weak and the body needs to adapt. The §5purple§r bar displays my bodily tolerance of toxin I can hold. Exceed this amount and there are §4dangerous§r consequences. I must make sure the §2green§r bar §4never reaches the apex of the purple§r.§r

The <property>tolerance</property> is quite important. In order to be able to hold onto more <poison>toxins</poison>, this §5purple bar§r must increase. And to do that, the body must adapt to the <poison>poisonous substances</poison>. This means I must consume more to slowly build up that bar.§r

If however, I were to intake a large amount of <poison>toxins</poison> that exceed my tolerance, then the skull indicator will turn <warning>red</warning>. This tells me <warning><shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>I must detox myself</shake></warning> as soon as possible as any §4extra bit of toxin will consume me§r, making any bit of my autonomy permanently removed. I can detox with §2regeneration potions§r or a §2golden apple§r!§r

This §5device§r will help me greatly in my research to come. Especially when I review my research on §5ancient poison rituals§r and §2blends§r. I need to ensure I don't get too excited and keep this device on me at all times so I don't go over my limits. I have a feeling this device will evolve from being less of a precaution to a wonderful future prospect.§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.toxic_blend.des: With <poison>toxic paste</poison> in my arsenal, I can improve on the techniques of the ancients. I can create a more powerful blend using it. But I must be incredibly careful. My system may not be able to handle it if I haven't already grown accustomed.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.toxic_formula.d: I've almost done it! The material that can be used to unlock the <warning>full potential of poison</warning>. I have formulated this concoction to prepare the <warning><shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.0>final creation</shake></warning> of the ultimate substance! But I'll need to enter the <magic>Nether</magic> one more time.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.toxic_leather.d:
My clothes are torn to bits. I feel my own academy attire does not reflect my truest desires. I must attain a new wardrobe. And I have the perfect material to make it out of.

A perfect amalgamation of <poison>poison</poison> and purpose. The leather of animals felt missing something tactile and comfortable. By imbuing it with my <poison>toxin</poison>, I can create a hardened and more durable material. And it smells of progress all over!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.toxic_paste.des: Used to make Toxic Formula, Canisters, as well as other items.
Using <keyword>glass vials</keyword>, I can create a container that's reinforced with <keyword>Copper</keyword>. This larger much heavier container is a valuable part. A presage to the grand creation of...
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.toxin_flask.des: With even greater potential in material, I can enhance both the <property>capacity</property> and the <property>duration</property> of the <keyword>flask</keyword> even further. Now I can keep the effect for <keyword>triple the normal length</keyword>. This power is <warning><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.3>UNBELIEVABLE</shake></warning>!
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.toxin_tox_pot.d: <warning>Toxin Oil!</warning> Like its predecessor, but <warning><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.3>WAY MORE VOLATILE</shake></warning>. Using <warning>toxin</warning> as a base, we can use a deadly effect that produces a <warning><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.3>LETHAL result</shake></warning>, which poison has always lacked. My magnificent creation can now be offered to EVERYONE.
The <keyword>Deepshelf of Arcane Treasures</keyword> unlocks <keyword>treasure enchantments</keyword> in the enchanting table that you can't normally get there, like <property>Mending</property>, <property>Frost Walker</property>, <property>Soul Speed</property> or <property>Swift Sneak</property>. Many treasure enchantments are <curse><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>curses</shake></curse>, so pair it with a <keyword>Geode-Encased Bookshelf</keyword> for stability first.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.tuning_fork.des: Displays the total number of <keyword>buffs</keyword> in the <keyword>Crucible</keyword>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.umbral_spirit.d: <positive>Killing</positive> <keyword>villagers</keyword> or <keyword>players</keyword> there is a chance to drop this §l<property>spirit</property>§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.unholy_effigy.d: The dark lord is pleased, and has revealed some knowledge of their otherworldly appearance - now represented in this <curse>Elder Statue</curse>. It allows far <magic>more powerful dark rites</magic> than your crude straw effigy ever could.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.unholy_symbol.d:
Use the <curse>Touch of Darkness</curse> spell on a <property>pewter inlay</property>.

<warning>If not yet unlocked</warning>, try experimenting with the mod - it unlocks progressively.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.upgrade_speed.d: <c value=#DEB3E0>Pylons</c>§r allows to <c value=#FEECD6>speed up</c>§r crafts in §l<c value=#e4affa>Spectrum</c>§r§r multiblocks. Also, they can be used as upgrades for <c value=#9BB8ED>Modern Industrialization</c>§r machines.§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.void_amulet.des: The <named>Void Amulet</named> is imbued with supernatural defense - when worn, incoming projectiles are <positive>absorbed and nullified</positive> instead of striking you, though it needs about ten seconds to recharge afterwards.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.void_jar.desc: The <keyword>Void Jar</keyword> destroys items on pickup and grants a small amount of <property>source</property> in return. Sneak-use it to turn it on/off, and use an item in your off hand (or on the Scribe's Table with the jar on it) to set which item it consumes. It must be in your hotbar to work.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.void_prism.desc: The <keyword>Void Prism</keyword> simply <fade minAlpha=0.2 frequency=0.8>destroys</fade> any spell projectile that passes through it - useful for safely disposing of stray projectile spells in automated setups.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.wand.desc: The <keyword>Wand</keyword> is the basic casting tool - inscribe any spell recipe on it at your spell book and right-click to cast, at the cost of <property>source</property>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.warded_mail.des: Inscribed with runes and sanctifying salts, the <magic>Warded Mail</magic> bolsters any armor worn over it, letting it <positive>defend against magical attacks</positive> that would normally pierce straight through.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.warp_index.desc: The <keyword>Warp Index</keyword> lets you access your <keyword>Storage Lecterns</keyword> remotely, without walking up to them, as long as you stay in the same dimension.
An augment for the <keyword>Spirit Crucible</keyword> that rejects cause and effect: <property>+10% Chain Focusing Chance</property> - whenever a cycle finishes, it can sometimes <positive>trigger an extra cycle</positive> almost instantly. Chained activations stack a bonus to <positive>all other attributes</positive>, but that comes with <warning>+15% Fuel Usage Rate</warning> and <curse>+5% Tuning Strain</curse>.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.warping_spell_p: The <keyword>Warping Spell Prism</keyword> <wave amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.0>warps</wave> a redirected spell projectile anywhere in the world - even across dimensions.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.water_hemlock.d:
Grows in <nature>swamps</nature>.

You can also buy from <keyword>Wandering Trader</keyword>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.water_turret.de: The <keyword>Water Turret</keyword> is an <keyword>Ars Elemental</keyword> defense turret that automatically fires at nearby hostile mobs, using the power of the <keyword>Water</keyword> school to slow them down.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.wilden_horn.des: You can summon a mob using a <click action=open_quest value='magic_step_ii/brazier'><u>brazier</u></click>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.wilden_spike.de: You can summon a mob using a <click action=open_quest value='magic_step_ii/brazier'><u>brazier</u></click>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.wilden_wing.des: You can summon a mob using a <click action=open_quest value='magic_step_ii/brazier'><u>brazier</u></click>
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.witchfire_tox_p: Blaze powder was already as <warning>VOLATILE</warning> as toxin. It burns just like toxin does. So a thought came to me. Was there a way to <warning>mix these substances together</warning> to create the <warning>ultimate purifying effect</warning>. That's when I created this miraculous fusion. §l<flame><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.3>WITCHFIRE</shake></flame>.§r
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.wixie_hat.desc: The <keyword>Wixie Hat</keyword> lets your familiar transport <property>potions</property> as well - once equipped, use the <keyword>Dominion Wand</keyword> to link it between <keyword>Potion Jars</keyword>, and it will move potions between them.
milf.quest.magic_step_ii.xp_jar.desc: The <keyword>XP Jar</keyword> works just like the <keyword>Void Jar</keyword>, but grants <property>experience</property> instead of source when it destroys an item. Sneak-use it to turn it on/off, and it must be in your hotbar to work.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.activation_cry: The <keyword>Activation Crystal (Weak)</keyword> starts any ritual. Right-click the Master Ritual Stone with it once all supporting stones are in place. Stronger crystals (<keyword>Awakened</keyword>) are required for Tier II rituals.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.advancedmagnet:
- The <keyword>Advanced Magnet</keyword> <positive>picks up Items and Experience</positive> within a <property>configurable range</property>!

- Items can be filtered with a <keyword>whitelist or blacklist</keyword>

- Range for both Items and Experience can be <property>individually configured</property>
Potion-brewing is a pedestrian art. Any hedge-witch with a cauldron can boil nether wart into a serviceable tincture. By weaving <positive>Essentia Vitae</positive> into the brewing process, you <magic>transcend</magic> the crude limitations of conventional alchemy.

Forged upon the <named>Ara Vitae</named>, the <keyword>Alchemy Flask</keyword> holds eight doses of whatever elixir you fill it with. Once drained to its dregs, rinse it with water to prepare a fresh vessel. Flasks may also be transmuted into projectile forms:
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.altar_compass_: <named>Compass</named> will help you find the right structure!
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.angel_wings.de: Crafted by imbuing an Elytra with a Blood Feather and organic matter. Provides extended gliding with minimal durability loss during normal flight, though firework boosts and Riptide hits drain it fast. Blood Feathers repair them.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.arcane_scribe_: Draw magical circles on any solid surface. Hold the tool and press <positive>Use</positive> to inscribe. Each inscription consumes one charge (<keyword>20 uses total</keyword>). Place a <keyword>base item</keyword> on the array, then a <keyword>catalyst item</keyword> to activate it.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.array_collecti: <positive>Draws</positive> dropped items within <property>2 blocks</property> toward its centre. Place atop a chest and collected items deposit directly inside.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.array_day.desc: <positive>Advances</positive> the world to the next <magic>sunrise</magic>. <warning>Consumed on use</warning>.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.array_deflecti: Projects a column of protective force (roughly 6 blocks tall, 3 wide) above it, reflecting any projectile that passes through back the way it came. Requires an Tabula Animata and a diamond.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.array_elevator: Folds space between two aligned glyphs for a seamless vertical elevator. Place at least two arrays directly above one another on the same block column, at any distance up to 64 blocks. Jump while standing on an array to teleport upward to the next array above; Sneak to descend to the nearest below. Multiple arrays can be chained for multi-floor shafts. Each search is limited to the same X/Z column, so precise alignment matters.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.array_endless_: Scribed with a <keyword>Block of Lapis</keyword> and awakened by a <soul>Sea Pickle</soul>. <positive>Pipes water</positive> into every fluid container touching its six faces; every 5 ticks it deposits up to <property>6 buckets</property>, spread evenly across neighbours. Only whole-bucket fills commit. The cache of adjacent tanks reacts instantly to neighbour changes, backs off progressively when every tank is full (with a slate-grey particle puff to signal the stall), and <warning>parks completely</warning> on a redstone signal.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.array_freeze.d: <positive>Converts</positive> nearby water sources to <property>ice</property> and covers exposed solid ground in a thin layer of <property>snow</property> within a <keyword>3-block radius</keyword>. Dissipates once everything in reach is frozen.
<positive>Transmutes</positive> raw materials dropped nearby into their smelted forms (<property>10 EV</property> per stack from the owner's network). Items within its radius will not despawn while awaiting processing; processes all valid stacks simultaneously, with cook times matching a standard furnace.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.array_growth.d: Coaxes nearby crops and plants to grow faster in a 2-block radius, applying a gentle acceleration each second.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.array_light.de: <positive>Radiates illumination</positive> from invisible sources above the <magic>array</magic>, lighting an area without cluttering it with torches.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.array_movement: <positive>Launches</positive> entities horizontally in the direction they face.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.array_night.de: <positive>Draws</positive> the world forward to the next <magic>sunset</magic>. <warning>Consumed on use</warning>.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.array_rain.des: <positive>Commands the weather</positive>, toggling rain on or off at a cost of <property>500 EV</property> from the owner's anima. <warning>Consumed on use</warning>.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.array_repulsio: An invisible ward that pushes hostile creatures away in a 5-block radius. Crafted from iron and lapis, accessible to apprentices.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.array_signal.d: Outputs a redstone signal from 0 to 15 proportional to the EV stored in the owner's anima, scaling linearly up to 1,000,000 EV. Requires a bound Arcane Ash to function.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.array_spike.de: A cruel ward: any living creature that steps onto it suffers a full heart of damage. Nearly invisible once inscribed, ideal for defending passages or feeding automated arrangements.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.array_spirit_s: Combines Spike's cruelty with a deeper purpose: when a non-player creature steps onto it, the array deals a heart of damage and releases 0.5 units of raw Spiritus into the surrounding chunk. Has a brief cooldown; players are immune. Requires an Tabula Animata.
Emits a brief (half-second) redstone pulse whenever a mob or player steps on it. Like a pressure plate, but nearly invisible.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.array_undertow: Scribed with Kelp and awakened by Redstone Dust. Opens a vitaemantic current through the open column of air directly above the glyph, lifting or drowning any entity that enters. Right-click with an empty hand to reverse the flow; the array remembers its direction across world reloads. Strength scales with additional Redstone in the redstone slot (acceleration) and Kelp in the kelp slot (terminal velocity); right-click the array with more ingredients to stack them.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.athanor.desc: The <keyword>Athanor</keyword> is an advanced ore processor with <property>doubled yields</property>. Feed it <property>Fuel Cells</property> and <property>Cutting Fluid</property> - three grades of fluid (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced) each improve efficiency.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.augmenting_tab:
Reforging rerolls <property>everything</property> at once. The Augmenting Table works with a <magic>single affix</magic> and leaves the rest of the item intact.

Put an <keyword>affix item</keyword> in the upper slot and <keyword>Sigils of Enhancement</keyword> in the lower one, then pick an affix from the list:

- <named>Upgrade</named> - makes the affix <positive>25% stronger</positive>. Costs <warning>2 sigils and 225 levels</warning>. Affixes without levels cannot be upgraded.
- <named>Reroll</named> - swaps the affix for another of the same type; the options are shown on the left. Costs <warning>1 sigil and 175 levels</warning>.

Worth it for <flame>Mythic</flame> gear, maybe for <magic>Epic</magic>.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.awakened_activ: Required for all <property>Tier III rituals</property>, including <keyword>Breaching the Edge of Demon Realm</keyword>.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.base_spiritus_: Spiritus is creature essence, the lifeblood of Hellfire Forge crafting. Mark creatures with Throwing Daggers, slay them, and collect the <property>Raw Spiritus</property> that falls.
A rare block found only in Heart Chambers. Beats at varying intervals, applying a health effect to all creatures in range - friend or foe alike.

Convert it between states using:

• Ghast Tear → Regeneration
• Heart Transplant → Health Boost
• Enchanted Golden Apple → Absorption
• Blood Bucket → Bloodclogged
• Poisonous Potato → Poison
• Wither Skull → Wither

Harvest with Silk Touch to keep its current type, otherwise it resets to empty.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.blood_orb_mast: Forged in the <keyword>Tier III altar</keyword> for <keyword>40,000 EV</keyword>. Required to power <property>Sentient Extraction</property> rituals and sustain the deeper blood workings of Tier III.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.blood_tank.des:
The Blood Tank is a portable reservoir for Essentia Vitae and other fluids. Fill or drain it by right-clicking with a bucket. Retains its contents when broken, ideal for transporting large volumes. Glows faintly according to its contents.

Each tier doubles capacity: from 16 buckets at tier 1 to 524,288 buckets at tier 16. Upgrade early and often.

Upgrading: combine two Blood Tanks + Glass + Bloodstone in a crafting table. Result is one tier above the primary tank, fluids merge. Same fluids add together, different fluids - primary tank's contents take precedence.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.bloodwyrm_head:
A modified Ender Dragon Head from End Cities. Purely cosmetic on its own, no effects.

Note: hints at a shared origin between the Ender Dragon and Bloodwyrms, but creating a true Bloodwyrm requires some additional element - the mechanism remains undiscovered.

A modified Ender Dragon Head from End Cities. Purely cosmetic on its own, no effects.

Note: hints at a shared origin between the Ender Dragon and Bloodwyrms, but creating a true Bloodwyrm requires some additional element - the mechanism remains undiscovered.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.breaching_the_: Perform the "Breaching the Edge of the Demon Realm" ritual to unlock your first starting dungeon!
Breaching the Edge of Demon Realm
The <keyword>Carving Knife</keyword> is a simple tool crafted from a <property>Stick</property>, an <property>Iron Ingot</property> and a <bone>Crystallized Bond</bone>. While it can be used as a Sword in combat - even supporting the same enchantments - it is <warning>ill-advised</warning> to do so. Instead, it is much more useful for <positive>carving off flesh</positive> from Tissue blocks, tearing scutes off of Turtles or harvesting the horns of a Goat.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.cinderglee_scy: The <keyword>Existential Executioner</keyword> allows you to inflict the <curse><fade minAlpha=0.3 frequency=0.7>Existential Burn</fade></curse> state onto enemies. It's best used against enemies with considerable regeneration or healing capabilities; or to otherwise slowly whittle down a greater target.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.concentration_:
Crafted by applying a Concentration Core to a Weaver Nest. Converts nearby experience orbs into Memory Cores - the same kind dropped by Weavers, which can be eaten for XP.

Holds XP up to an Enchanting Table's max level. A redstone signal pauses both weaving and orb collection. Starting a new cycle ejects any cores already inside. Mine with Silk Touch to relocate it intact - otherwise it breaks and only the Concentration Core survives.

A bit fragile, though tougher than a plain Weaver Nest.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.construct_the_: Place the <named>Ara Vitae</named> - the sacred basin at the heart of <magic>vitaemancy</magic>. Right-click it to deposit items for altar crafting. <property>EV</property> drains steadily during workings; <blood>crimson motes</blood> rising from the surface confirm it is underway.
By taking advantage of the remnant levitative energies left in a Shulker Shell and molding them through the use of a Blood Feather, a Counterweight can be made that will decrease the gravity experienced by the user. The effect is similar to that of a Potion of Slow Falling, while also being able to stack with it.

It works exceptionally well when used alongside methods of increasing jump height.
Find the little <soul>ghastlys</soul> and tame them - they'll help you find the <named>Mansion</named>!

Use <positive>Crimson Roots</positive> to tame it
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.crown_of_bones: Crafted from four Bones, four Horns, and a Skeleton Skull. Amplifies horn potion effects by one stage, but cuts duration from half to a third of the original. Offers very low defense, but accepts helmet enchantments and trims.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.crystallarium_:
The Crystallarium Maleficum seeds the first spire of a cluster: place it with open air above, and once the chunk's Aura holds at least 99 Spiritus of any single Aspect, it spends that Aura over roughly 1,000 ticks to form a single Spiritus Crystal of the chunk's dominant Aspect on its top face. After that first spire stands, the crystal grows under its own power; the Crystallarium has done its work.

Spires grow whenever the chunk holds at least a trace of the cluster's Aspect, with growth rate scaling against saturation, accelerating as the Aura fills. A chunk's natural cap is 100 per Aspect, though certain Rituals can raise it. Each new spire costs 45 Spiritus when the chunk's dominant Aspect matches the cluster, and yields 50 when burned in a Vas Maleficum (a net gain of 5 per spire). If the chunk's dominant Aspect does not match the cluster (for instance, a Raw-dominant chunk feeding a Ruina cluster), the cost rises to 90 Spiritus per spire and growth runs at 60% speed. Keep the chunk biased toward the Aspect you want to farm. A cluster may grow up to 7 spires tall.

If you carry more than 512 total Spiritus in your inventory (across any gems, any type), you may harvest clusters by right-clicking with an empty hand. This strips all but the central spire, leaving the cluster to regrow. A pickaxe will shatter the entire cluster at once for the impatient. Manual harvest yields a modest 5 Spiritus per cluster.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.crystallum_fra: Ritual §lCrystallum Fractura§r - Harvests mature crystal clusters and weaves a 2x growth aura + 1.25x spiritus injection across the chunks in range§r
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.demonite_ingot: <blood>deep blood-red</blood> decorative trim material. Apply at a smithing table like any other trim.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.diamond_tipped: Upgrade with a Diamond Block and another Blood Feather into Diamond-Tipped Ophanim Wings - while crouching, they trigger a stabbing attack that hits nearby enemies based on your body's facing direction (not where you're looking), dealing damage and consuming durability.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.discipulus_orb: Forged in the <keyword>Tier I altar</keyword> for <keyword>5,000 EV</keyword>. Expands your <magic>Anima</magic> further and unlocks <property>off-hand EV harvesting</property> - hold the orb in your off hand to collect EV directly from kills.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.dominus_orb_of: The penultimate(?) orb. Forged in the <keyword>Tier IV altar</keyword> for <keyword>80,000 EV</keyword>. Grants vast <magic>Anima</magic> reserves sufficient to sustain even the most demanding Tier IV rituals continuously.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.downgrades.des:
Info for nerds
Every upgrade has a shadow. Downgrades are imposed by the Ritual of Sentient Downgrade and exchange unwanted upgrade levels for a curse, freeing Upgrade Points to reinvest elsewhere.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.elemental_ritu: Many Tier II+ rituals require <property>elemental ritual stones</property> - Air, Water, Fire, Earth, or Dusk variants. Place them at their designated positions around the Master Ritual Stone.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.enhanced_telep:
Three focus tiers determine swap volume: Teleposition Focus (1×1×1), Enhanced Focus (3×3×3), Reinforced Focus (5×5×5).

Topologies: one-way, two-way, chained (A→B→C→A), vertical elevator. Mob spawners transfer with full NBT intact - spawn counts, cooldowns, and trial-spawner behavior preserved.

Tips: test links with non-living blocks first, mark destinations clearly, carry spare Foci.
The Eternal Youth is a consumable item that - quite simply put - imbues the animal it's used on with a never ending state of immortality as a youngling. If the animal in question is not currently young, it will be reverted to its youth. The immortality given is near absolute; the few ways of killing such an animal is either to lose it to the void or to use a second Eternal Youth on them.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.experience_tom: The <keyword>Tome of Peritia</keyword> is a vessel for <magic>captured experience</magic>, <positive>safe from the grasp of death</positive>. <keyword>Sneak and Use</keyword> to store a level, <keyword>Use</keyword> alone to retrieve it. Hold either action to transfer multiple levels rapidly.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.fire_scythe.de: The <flame>Flame Fiend</flame> is imbued with pure fire. When using it, not only is the victim set on fire, but they will also experience <warning><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.2>Flame Frailty</shake></warning>, a state during which being on fire will be more painful. Additionally, even enemies who are immune to fire won't be spared, as they get weakened and devoured by the pure flames from within.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.first_runes.de: Runes are inscribed plates placed around the <named>Ara Vitae</named> basin to enhance it. Craft <keyword>8 Rune Blanks</keyword> as the foundation - these will be upgraded into specialized runes.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.focus_tiers_an:
Three focus tiers determine swap volume: Teleposition Focus (1×1×1), Enhanced Focus (3×3×3), Reinforced Focus (5×5×5).

Topologies: one-way, two-way, chained (A→B→C→A), vertical elevator. Mob spawners transfer with full NBT intact - spawn counts, cooldowns, and trial-spawner behavior preserved.

Tips: test links with non-living blocks first, mark destinations clearly, carry spare Foci.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.grand_spiritus: The highest grade of Spiritus Gem. <keyword>Grand Spiritus Gems</keyword> fuel the most powerful Hellfire Forge recipes and are required for Tier V altar components.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.guilty_apple.d: To <positive>leave</positive> this <magic>dimension</magic>, take a bite of this <named>fragrant apple</named>!
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.heart_transpla:
<named>Heart Transplant</named> is a <keyword>workstation</keyword> for villagers 

<named>Ascetic</named> sells a variety of interesting <magic>Risus</magic>-related items, such as maps that help you locate various structures from the <magic>Risus</magic> mod!
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.hexhorn.desc: Crafted from a Blood Feather, Echo Pearl, and War Horn at a Smithing Table. Applies its loaded potion effects to all nearby enemies instead of allies. Supports the Flame enchantment, igniting victims along with the potion effect.
The Incense Altar multiplies Essentia Vitae gained from a single self-sacrifice. Instead of clicking dozens of times - one powerful offering with a significant multiplier.
