Usage: stand within 5 blocks of the altar to receive Blessed Sacrifice for 30 seconds. Right-clicking your Blood Orb drains nearly all your blood into the orb at once, after which Soul Fray sets in until the next blessing.

Building: place the altar on a 3x3 platform, extend 3-block-wide paths in all 4 cardinal directions using Path blocks. Place varied blocks around for Tranquility: dirt, water, lava, leaves, logs, crops, fire. The more expensive the path material - the higher the bonus: Wooden +60%, Stone +120%, Worn Stone +200%, Obsidian +300%. Check your current bonus with a Divination Sigil.

§lVERY§r quick example:§r
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.input_and_outp: <keyword>Input Nodes</keyword> extract from adjacent inventories; <keyword>Output Nodes</keyword> deliver into them. Each of 6 faces carries independent filters - configure whitelist, blacklist, priority, and keep-amounts per face.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.light_devourer:
A device consisting of a case with a <curse><pulse base=0.5 amplitude=1.0>dark mass</pulse></curse> at its center that swirls and consumes nearby light - essentially a contained miniature <magic>black hole</magic>.

Function: lets you place "false" darkness in an area. This artificial darkness prevents monsters from spawning in the affected zone.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.linear_ritual_: To build it, you need the following pattern, made with 16 Linear and 12 Curved Ritual Blocks, some Blood in the middle, and above that, a campfire. 12 Fires have to be created in total at the places where the Ritual Blocks point.
An upgraded coin pouch that automatically picks up coins from the floor
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.master_routing: The brain of the network - one per network. New nodes within 16 blocks auto-bind to the nearest master on placement. Use the <property>Node Router</property> tool to manually link nodes across longer chains.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.novicius_orb_o:
Lay a <keyword>Attuned Stone</keyword> upon the bare altar. With no <positive>Essentia Vitae</positive> of its own, the altar draws <blood>blood</blood> from any nearby who carry no <named>Blood Orb</named>, refining it into <positive>Essentia Vitae (EV)</positive> until the working completes. 

<positive>It never kills, taking only what it needs.</positive>
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.orb_filling_li:
The Orb Vitae Link doesn't craft - it charges. Seat a Blood Orb inside (use with orb in hand, empty-handed to take it back), and it pulls Essentia Vitae from its bound altar straight into the orb owner's Anima, at the altar's full tier and runes, until the network is full.

The Link sits lowest in the chain: it draws only while the altar is idle and no Vitae Link is crafting, sipping leftover essence so it never starves a working altar.

Apply a redstone signal to pause it - while powered, charging stops. Its comparator output rises with how full the owner's Anima is, ideal for switching off your blood engines once you are topped off.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.place_the_hell: The forge of demons. The <fire>Hellfire Forge</fire> crafts <property>Sentient Equipment</property>, <property>Explosive Charges</property>, and <property>Spiritus Gems</property> using Raw Spiritus as fuel. It is the core machine of the mid-game.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.place_the_mast:
Place the <named>Master Ritual Stone</named> to begin conducting rituals. Use the <property>Ritual Diviner</property> to see the stone placement pattern, then activate with an <magic>Activation Crystal</magic>.

You can read about existing rituals in the guidebook!
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.place_the_tabu: Place the <named>Tabula Vitae</named> - your alchemical workbench for brewing <property>Alchemy Flasks</property>, crafting <property>Anointments</property>, applying <property>Reagents</property> to tools, and filling Sigils with their elemental base items.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.place_the_tele:
The <named>Teleposer</named> doesn't teleport - it <positive>swaps</positive> everything above two linked blocks instantly: blocks, items, and entities together.

Setup: place two Teleposers, bind a Focus to the target via right-click, place it in the source, apply strong redstone power.

Cost: 1 EV per 2 blocks of distance, 1,000 EV cap per object, 10,000 EV cap per activation. Swaps involving blacklisted blocks (bedrock, portals, command blocks) abort without spending EV.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.q078a77490809e: It's easy to get lost in the <magic>maze</magic>, and there are plenty of <warning><pendulum frequency=0.8 angle=15.0>traps</pendulum></warning> and <property>puzzles</property> - make your way through the maze to reach the <blood><glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.05>true Azazel</glitch></blood>!
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.q10400ec9fefec: You can use the structure-finding ritual from the <click action=open_quest value='magic_step_ii/brazier'><u>Eidolon</u></click> mod or <click action=open_quest value='magic_step_i/ritual_locate_structure'><u>Ars Additions</u></click>.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.q146e3bd6bc57d: Defeat <blood><glitch frequency=0.7 shiftChance=0.06>The Divine Chariot Azazel</glitch></blood> and get the <named>mask</named> - it'll come in handy later!
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.q4a466ebb29c36: Solve the <property>puzzle</property> to gain access to the <magic>maze</magic>!
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.q5fbe128c3228a: Destroy the <fire>Nether Locker</fire>, and you might just get a <named>compass</named>!
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.q6f01728fa447d: Use the <named>compass</named> on the <property>monument</property> to find the <magic>head altar</magic>
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.reforging_tabl:
The full version of the <keyword>Simple Reforging Table</keyword>. It works the same way - item in the center, <keyword>rarity material</keyword> top-left, <keyword>Sigils of Rebirth</keyword> bottom-right, three choices to pick from.

The difference is the limit: this table can reforge items up to <flame><pulse>Mythic</pulse></flame> rarity, including <magic>Epic</magic>.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.regen_rose.des: If you stand on this <named>flower</named>, you can feel the <positive>regeneration effect</positive>!
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.ritual_diviner:
Right-click to select a ritual.

Right-click the Master Ritual Stone along with a Ritual Stone in your inventory to build the ritual-structure
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.ritual_of_mete: Watches for a specific catalyst item dropped within the ritual area, consumes it, and crashes a corresponding meteor from above. The meteor's sphere comes to rest with its lowest block one block above the Master Ritual Stone, so the ritual circle is preserved. The exact landing altitude is calculated per-catalyst from the recipe's outermost sphere radius. Catalysts are defined by meteor recipes (consult JEI); each names the meteor that answers.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.ritual_of_sent: Expands a worn Sentient Armor's upgrade capacity beyond its former limits.
The <named>Ritual Tinkerer</named> (also known as the Ritual Reader) is essential for mastery over your circles. Cycle between three modes with Sneak + Use:

• Information - reveals the purpose of the selected ritual.

• Set Spiritus Consumed - attunes the ritual to consume specific aspects of <click action=open_quest value='magic_step_iii/vas_maleficum'><u>Spiritus</u></click> from the Aura. Carry the desired Spiritus Crystals in your hotbar, one per aspect.

• Define Area - specifies the zone in which the ritual operates and displays the current boundaries. If multiple zones exist, Sneak + Use on the Master Ritual Stone cycles between them.

Some rituals can be expanded far beyond their default range, but EV cost scales to match. Tread carefully with your reserves.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.routing_condui: The <keyword>Routing Network</keyword> transports items, fluids, and energy between machines without hoppers or pipes. <property>Conduits</property> are passive relays that extend the network reach between active nodes. Lay them between your Athanor, Hellfire Forge, and storage.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.scythe.desc:
Compared to a sword, a scythe requires considerably more dexterity, making it a rather slow weapon to use. In return, it allows the user to attack at a a higher range, as well as a sweep a larger area.

The Unlit Vessel, while strong, still has more potential that can be unleashed - with the use of a Scorching Ritual
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sentient_armou:
The armour worn by a <keyword>Vitaemancer</keyword> is no inert collection of plates.

<named>Sentient Armor</named> breathes, learns, and grows alongside its wearer. Each piece begins equivalent to iron in its protection but carries <property>100 Upgrade Points</property> that it spends as you teach it new skills.

The armour is <warning><fade minAlpha=0.4 frequency=0.7>alive</fade></warning>, and it watches everything you do. Be deliberate in what you teach it. Hold sneak while examining a piece to see what it has learned so far.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sentient_extra: Throw a piece of Sentient Armor onto the small 5×2×5 area above the Master Ritual Stone. The ritual extracts every upgrade currently inscribed on it as separate Upgrade Tomes (one per upgrade, preserving accumulated experience), then strips the armor clean. The tomes can later be inscribed back onto a fresh chestplate.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sigil_air.desc: Launches you in the direction you're looking for 50EV from your Anima reserves. Useful for improved flights, but good luck improvising a landing.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sigil_blood_li:
Conjures light sources wherever you are aiming for a mere 10 EV from your Anima reserves.

The light's color can be changed, as well as its brightness.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sigil_bound_tr: This sigil can be linked to a storage container, and for the cost of 200EV from your Anima reserves, open that container remotely, and cross-dimensionally, for as long as that container is within a loaded chunk.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sigil_damned.d: passive sigil held in hand: +50 Spiritus Collection, +25 Bonus Sacrifice, +10 Blood Siphon (heals on kill, capped at 4 hearts)
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sigil_fast_min: Grants Haste 1 for 100 EV every 5 seconds from your Anima reserves.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sigil_frost.de: Freezes the water you walk over. Permanently. Drains 100EV every 5 seconds from your Anima reserves.
This sigil can contain 5 other sigils, letting you quickly switch between them.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sigil_lava.des: Allows you to conjure a liquid lava block for the cost of 1,000 EV out of your Anima reserves.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sigil_of_divin: Your first sigil. Right-click to instantly reveal your <property>Anima storage</property>, altar <keyword>tier</keyword>, <keyword>EV volume</keyword>, and <keyword>capacity</keyword> - your blood magic compass. Craft it with <keyword>Redstone Dust</keyword> base and a <keyword>Tabula Rasa</keyword> catalyst.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sigil_of_enhan:
The <keyword>fuel</keyword> of the <keyword>Augmenting Table</keyword>. Goes in its <property>lower slot</property>.

- upgrading an affix takes <warning>2</warning> sigils;
- rerolling an affix takes <warning>1</warning>.

Augmenting is <warning>expensive</warning> in levels too, so stock up on <positive>experience</positive>.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sigil_of_magne: Extends your item pickup radius to <keyword>7 blocks</keyword>. Drains <keyword>50 EV every 5 seconds</keyword> while active - remember to toggle it off between battles to conserve Anima.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sigil_phantom_: Creates floating platforms beneath your feet. Shift + right click to deactivate. Consumes 100EV/s from your Anima reserves.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sigil_seer.des: Provides even greater sight than it's predecessor, revealing stats such as Ara Vitae's crafting progress, speed, and more.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sigil_suppress: Activate this sigil to temporarily banish all fluids around you. You can use this to run across the ocean bed, or to walk across the Nether's lava lakes.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sigil_void.des: Deletes the block of liquid you are looking at for 50EV from your Anima reserves.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.sigil_water.de: Allows you to conjure a water block for the cost of 100 EV out of your Anima reserves.
<positive>Bestows true flight</positive> upon all within the <magic>circle</magic>.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.soul_scythe.de: The <keyword>Soul Scratcher</keyword> holds the spirit-burning <soul>Soul Fire</soul>. As such, it is considerably <positive>more powerful</positive> when wielded against living beings. Unfortunately, this does make it <warning>much weaker</warning> against enemies without soul, such as the Undead or the Offsprings.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.specialisation:
Info for nerds
The armour grows in many directions at once, but its capacity is <warning>finite</warning>. Trying to master everything yields mastery of nothing. Consider forging multiple chestplates, each trained for a specific purpose, such as a miner's set, a warrior's set, or an explorer's set. The <keyword>Vitaemancer</keyword> has devised Rituals to assist with focused training, and the <property>Ritual of Sentient Evolution</property> to imbue your armour with a greater capacity for growth. Stand upon the <named>Master Ritual Stone</named> while clad in <named>Sentient Armor</named>, and the circle pours its power into the symbiotic plates. The armour's potential <positive>expands</positive> beyond its former limits.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.spike_trap.des:
One of the first and easiest ways to automatically collect blood for your altar!

It pairs incredibly well with <click action=open_quest value='magic_step_iii/array_vortex'><u>Vortex Sigil</u></click> - one pulls creatures toward, while the other kills them and grants blood for altar.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.spira_infernal: To move Spiritus across distances, place a Spira Infernalis: each tick it probes a position 16 blocks away in each of the four cardinal directions, and if the probed position holds more Spiritus than the pylon's own chunk, the pylon pulls a small fraction of the difference. The flow equilibrates rather than draining the source dry, so chain pylons from a saturated chunk toward your worksite to ferry Aura over long distances.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.spiritus_gauge: While the Spiritus Aura Gauge rests in your inventory, it projects a spectral reading onto your vision. From top to bottom the bars measure Raw, Ruina, Invictus, Nihilum, and Vindicta. Hold sneak for a precise numerical reading (0 to 100 per Aspect).
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.spiritus_gem_c: The Common gem holds up to 1,024 Spiritus.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.spiritus_gem_l: Like the petty version, but can hold up to 256 Spiritus.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.spiritus_gem_p:
Compress <property>Raw Spiritus</property> in the Hellfire Forge to form a <keyword>Common Spiritus Gem</keyword>. This is the primary fuel for Sentient Equipment crafting and Hellfire Forge recipes.

This petty gem holds up to 56 Spiritus.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.strong_tau.des: You can find a small amount of Strong Tau in the dungeon, but if you're unlucky and only find weak tau, you can turn it into strong tau if a living creature - such as a pig - is standing on the plant while it grows. In this case, the plant will turn into strong tau the very first time it grows. Additionally, for a strong tau to grow, a living creature must be standing on the plant and transferring its life energy to it.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.tabula_aethere: Tier IV crafting substrate. Costs <keyword>30,000 EV</keyword>. The highest crafting tablet, required for Tier V altar construction components.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.tabula_animata: Tier II crafting substrate. Costs <keyword>5,000 EV</keyword>. Required for the <property>Sigil of Bound Treasures</property> and other advanced <magic>vitaemantic</magic> items.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.tabula_rasa.de: The fundamental crafting substrate for all <magic>vitaemantic</magic> creations. Costs <keyword>1,000 EV</keyword> at the Tier 0 altar. Nearly every recipe will ask for a <named>Tabula</named> - keep a stack on hand.
Stand on the <named>Master Ritual Stone</named> wearing <named>Sentient Armor</named>. The ritual <warning>wipes every upgrade</warning> from every Sentient piece you have equipped and resets used points to zero, giving you back a clean slate at the cost of all accumulated training. No tomes are produced; if you want to preserve the upgrades for later, use <property>Sentient Extraction</property> instead.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.tabula_robur.d: Tier I crafting substrate. Costs <keyword>2,000 EV</keyword>. Required for advanced <magic>vitaemantic</magic> recipes.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.tabula_spiritu: Tier III crafting substrate. Costs <keyword>15,000 EV</keyword>. Required for the <property>Ritual Diviner \[Dusk\]</property> and high-tier <magic>vitaemantic</magic> instruments.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.tabula_vial.de:
Where flasks empower the body, <keyword>Anointments</keyword> empower the hand. These are alchemical coatings for your tools, weapons, and Charges. Hold the anointment in one hand and press \[Use\] to apply it to the item in the other; not every coating suits every instrument, choose wisely. An anointment may also be applied via a smithing table where it takes the place of a smithing template, useful for two-handed weapons.

Unlike elixirs, anointments are <warning>not governed by time</warning>. They diminish with each use of the coated tool, fading stroke by stroke until spent. They are held in the <named>Tabula Vial</named>; ordinary glass cannot withstand the reactive compounds within.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.tesseract_2.de: <keyword>Tesseract</keyword> allows you to <positive>transport Items, Fluid and Energy</positive>. Tesseracts work at <property>any distance and even across dimensions</property>! Use <keyword>multiple channels</keyword> to have different groups of Tesseracts!
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.the_ritual_of_: Watches a 21×21×21 area around the Master Ritual Stone for the moment of any non-player creature's death and drops a charged Raw Spiritus item at the death position. The richer the kill (Wither, Ender Dragon, Warden), the more Spiritus per drop. EV cost scales with the number of deaths processed each tick.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.the_torment_ne: Server-friendly endgame EV. Reads the configurations of nearby vanilla and Trial Spawners, simulates the kills they would produce, and feeds the resulting EV directly to your altar; no entities are spawned, no chunks load up with corpses.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.threaders_of_t:
Crafted from <keyword>Skin Boots</keyword> combined with <blood>Blood Feathers</blood> and <bone>Ashen Remains</bone>, finished off with an <magic>Ophanim</magic> imitation - a "blessed" pair of boots that drastically <positive>boosts the wearer's agility</positive>.

Tradeoff: defense is <warning>nearly nonexistent</warning>, and they only accept Unbreaking and Mending enchantments. Still, the massive mobility gain often makes them worth wearing over regular armor.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.throwing_dagge: Mark your prey. Throwing an <keyword>Iron Throwing Dagger</keyword> at a creature marks it - when the marked creature dies, it releases <property>Raw Spiritus</property>. You will need this later.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.totem_of_unyie:
A modified Totem of Undying. Instead of preventing death, it delays it by 10 seconds - a delay that can be extended through repeated uses.

When triggered on death, it grants near invincibility plus boosted strength and speed for those 10 seconds, putting you in a berserk state. When the time runs out, <blood><glitch frequency=0.9 shiftChance=0.07>"Destined Death"</glitch></blood> hits - instant and absolute, with no chance to resist.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.training_brace: To impose order on the armour's undirected growth, the <keyword>Vitaemancer</keyword> wears the <named>Training Bracelet</named>, a focus inscribed in an <magic>Alchemy Array</magic>. With a copy of the relevant <property>Tome</property> in hand, you can <positive>set a level cap</positive> for any upgrade; once the armour reaches that limit it ceases training the skill. Only one bracelet is active at a time (priority: off-hand, Curios, main inventory, then add-ons). To allow all upgrades except one, set the bracelet to <warning>'allow others'</warning> mode and cap the unwanted skill at level 0.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.transcendent_o: The penultimate(!!) orb. Forged in the <keyword>Tier V altar</keyword> for <keyword>200,000 EV</keyword>. Grants absurd <magic>Anima</magic> reserves sufficient to sustain even the most demanding Tier IV rituals continuously.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.upgrade_tome.d:
Upgrade Tomes are crystallised records of a particular skill, each carrying the experience needed to inscribe one or more levels of its upgrade onto a chestplate. They come from three places:

• Dungeon loot. Tomes are scattered through the loot tables of The Mines (ore chambers, the Smithy) and the Foreman's hoard.

• Sentient Extraction. Throw an already-trained piece of Sentient Armor onto the small zone above this ritual's Master Ritual Stone and it will extract every upgrade currently inscribed on the armor as a separate Tome, preserving the accumulated experience. The armor itself is left stripped but intact. 

• Combining duplicates. Two tomes of the same upgrade can be merged at a vanilla crafting table to consolidate their experience.

Press \[Use\] while holding a tome to inscribe one level of that skill onto your worn chestplate, assuming sufficient Upgrade Points remain. Hold sneak and \[Use\] to inscribe as much as possible at once. The tome is consumed in the process, transferring its stored experience to the chestplate. If insufficient points remain, the tome applies what it can and retains the rest; unless less than one level's worth remains, in which case the tome crumbles to nothing.

Tomes are the key to deliberate specialisation; focus your training on the abilities that serve you best and discard the rest. Maintain separate chestplates for different purposes, each with its own set of tomes.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.upgrades.desc:
Info for nerds
Most upgrades are trained by performing the matching activity while wearing the chestplate; every time you do, the armour banks experience toward the next level. How much it banks depends on the upgrade:

• Proportional upgrades bank experience equal to the magnitude of the event: the damage taken or dealt, the health restored, the experience collected, or the distance moved. Bigger events teach the armour faster.

• Per-event upgrades bank a flat point each time: one per block mined, or one per tick spent on fire or poisoned.

A few upgrades (Brilliance, Curios Sockets, Elytra, Gilded) are not trained through activity at all and are simply applied from a tome. Each upgrade levels up at its own experience thresholds.

You can read more about all the Upgrades in the guide book!
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.upgrades.title: Upgrades
Demonic <property>Spiritus</property> can also exist in a diffused state throughout the very air. By burning Spiritus in a <named>Vas Maleficum</named>, you release it into the <magic>Aura</magic>, an invisible miasma that permeates each chunk of the world.

Feed the Vas Maleficum a charged Spiritus Gem, loose Spiritus, or Spiritus Crystals of any Aspect. Crystals are consumed once the chunk's Spiritus dips below 50; loose Spiritus and gem contents are consumed gradually as needed.

Apply a redstone signal and the Vas reverses direction: a Spiritus Gem placed inside is filled from the chunk's Aura instead of drained. The same vessel serves as both deposit and withdrawal point.

The Aura is chunk-based. Spiritus burned in one chunk fills only that chunk, up to a cap of 100 per aspect
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.veneficus_orb_: Forged in the <keyword>Tier II altar</keyword> for <keyword>25,000 EV</keyword>. The <named>Veneficus Orb</named> significantly expands your <magic>Anima</magic> pool and is required to conduct advanced rituals.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.vitae_link.des:
The Vitae Link is a bound relay that crafts on a linked altar's behalf, but only up to a tier you choose.

Creation: place an Ara Vitae inside a larger altar holding at least 1,500 Essentia Vitae - the lesser altar folds inward to form the Link.

Place the Link within 8 blocks of an altar. It draws Essentia Vitae straight from that altar's basin and borrows its rune bonuses. Sneak and use the Link to cycle its craft tier. Maximum is one tier below the altar it serves.

Use the Link with an item to load it, empty-handed to take the result back. It crafts in place, climbing the chain only as far as your chosen tier.

For automation: pipe into any side but the bottom to feed input, draw from the bottom to empty output. Only one Link crafts at a time.

Orb Vitae Link variant: seat a Blood Orb inside it - it will pull Essentia Vitae from the bound altar straight into the orb owner's Anima.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.warhorn.desc: Made by altering a Goat Horn. Can still be tooted, but can also be filled with a potion - blowing it applies that effect to all nearby pets and players. Duration is half the original potion's. Effects linger after use, and a new potion overwrites the old one.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.well_of_suffer: <positive>Harvests</positive> <property>Essentia Vitae</property> from the suffering of nearby creatures.
milf.quest.magic_step_iii.wip.title: WIP
milf.quest.petrochemical_party.wirecoil_: Redstone works quite differently when you use aluminum to transfer its signals, looks like the strength of the signal remains the same no matter the distance traveled, and you could do little adjustments inside relays to send different signal types, which opens great possibilities...
milf.quest.petrochemical_party_pp.annihi: <positive>Breaks and pickups blocks</positive>, can be enchanted with any <property>pickaxe enchantment</property>
milf.quest.petrochemical_party_pp.arcane:
A <keyword>Molecular Assembler</keyword> for <magic>arcane crafting</magic>. On its own it <warning>doesn't know any recipes</warning> - insert a <named>Knowledge Core</named>, and every recipe it remembers becomes available to <keyword>autocrafting</keyword>.

<keyword>Capacity Cards</keyword> add core slots: <property>up to 3 cores</property> (27 recipes). <keyword>Acceleration Cards</keyword> speed it up.

Vis is spent in order: <property>Vis Relay buffer</property> -> <property>wand</property> -> <property>essentia crystals</property> (only if no usable wand). An <named>Arcane Charging Card</named> lets it draw aura from nearby chunks.

Turns out the <bone>undead</bone> are <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>not very bright</wiggle>. The <named>ME Arcane Inscriber</named> <warning>forces</warning> recipes into a <keyword>Knowledge Core</keyword>.

Load a recipe into the grid and inscribe it. Loading a recipe the core already knows <property>erases</property> it instead.

One core holds <property>9 recipes</property>. §7Shift+RMB§r with a core in hand wipes it clean.§r

Your <keyword>Arcane Workbench</keyword>, hooked into ME. It <positive>refills the crafting grid and crystals</positive> straight from the network. Like a bare workbench, it draws vis from the aura of <property>its own chunk</property>.

Pick up a <keyword>Thaumometer</keyword> on the cursor and hover a stored item to <magic>scan</magic> it without taking it out.

Search by aspect: <property>%ignis</property> shows only items containing <aqua>Ignis</aqua>. Works only with <warning>discovered</warning> aspects.
milf.quest.petrochemical_party_pp.blank_:
A <bone>zombie brain</bone> that can <named>remember recipes</named>. Machines can't do research, but they can repeat a craft they were <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>shown</wiggle>.

Teach it in the <keyword>ME Arcane Inscriber</keyword>, then insert it into the <keyword>Arcane Assembler</keyword>. One core holds <property>9 recipes</property>.

§7Shift+RMB§r with a core in hand <warning>wipes</warning> its memory.§r
milf.quest.petrochemical_party_pp.diffus:
Modified <keyword>Formation</keyword> and <keyword>Annihilation Cores</keyword>, wrapped in <property>quicksilver</property> so <warning><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.2>corrosive</shake></warning> essentia doesn't eat the circuitry.

<named>Diffusion Core</named> - diffuses essentia and <glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.05>digitizes</glitch> it.
<named>Coalescence Core</named> - binds it back into <aqua>raw form</aqua>.

Base components for every essentia bus and terminal.
milf.quest.petrochemical_party_pp.entang:
Two <keyword>silverwood cores</keyword> infused around a <named>Singularity</named> come out as a <glitch frequency=0.7 shiftChance=0.06>bound pair</glitch>. Wands made from them share <positive>one vis reservoir</positive> - at any distance, <fade minAlpha=0.4 frequency=1.0>even between worlds</fade>.

Leave one wand on a <keyword>Recharge Pedestal</keyword> and carry the other.

<warning>Note:</warning> the Singularity goes on an <property>outer pedestal</property>, not the center. Cores from different infusions don't link.
milf.quest.petrochemical_party_pp.essent:
The <named>ME Essentia Interface</named> is a bridge between <keyword>ME networks</keyword>. Point an <keyword>Essentia Storage Bus</keyword> from another network at it, and the two networks <positive>see each other's essentia</positive>.

It also <aqua><wave>pulls essentia</wave></aqua> from any connected <property>tube</property> and gives it back to anything with stronger suction than a jar.

Like the item <keyword>Level Emitter</keyword>, but watches <aqua>one aspect</aqua>. Emits a <warning><pulse>redstone signal</pulse></warning> when its stored amount goes <property>above</property> or <property>below</property> the threshold you set.

Use it to start production when an aspect runs low, or stop it before it floods the network.

Works exactly like the item <keyword>Storage Bus</keyword>, but for essentia: lets the network <positive>read and fill</positive> essentia containers it faces.

Point it at an <named>ME Essentia Interface</named> of another network to <property>link the two</property>.

Digitized essentia is invisible until you build this. The <named>ME Essentia Terminal</named> shows <positive>all essentia</positive> your network can access.

You can <aqua>insert</aqua> and <aqua>extract</aqua> essentia through it with <keyword>phials</keyword> and <keyword>jars</keyword>.
milf.quest.petrochemical_party_pp.infusi:
No more pouring jars around the altar. The <named>ME Infusion Provider</named> exposes <positive>all essentia of your ME network</positive> to the <magic><pulse>Runic Matrix</pulse></magic> during <keyword>infusion</keyword>.

Works with <keyword>Essentia Storage Buses</keyword> too, so an infusion altar can run on its own <property>subnetwork</property>.
milf.quest.petrochemical_party_pp.upgrad:
Upgrade for the <keyword>Wireless Essentia Terminal</keyword>. §7Shift+RMB§r switches between <property>Terminal</property> and <property>Alchemy</property> modes.§r

In <aqua><wave>Alchemy mode</wave></aqua>:
<positive>RMB</positive> on a labeled jar - fills it with matching essentia from the network
<positive>LMB</positive> on a jar - empties it into the network, no label needed

Needs an <warning>active wireless connection</warning> and power.

By default arcane devices drink vis only from <property>their own chunk</property>. The <named>Arcane Charging Card</named> extends that to nearby chunks - <property>3x3 area</property> - and splits each draw <positive>evenly</positive> across them.

Goes into the <keyword>Arcane Crafting Terminal</keyword>, its wireless version and the <keyword>Arcane Assembler</keyword>.

Upgrade for the <keyword>Wireless Arcane Crafting Terminal</keyword>. §7Shift+RMB§r switches to <property>Drain mode</property>.§r

In Drain mode, hold <positive>RMB</positive> at an <magic><pulse>aura node</pulse></magic> to <soul>drain it</soul> into the wand inside the terminal - same rules as holding that wand directly. Release or look away to stop.
milf.quest.petrochemical_party_pp.vis_re:
Carries vis across your <keyword>ME network</keyword> between distant <magic>vis relays</magic>.

Place it on a cable facing a linked relay, §7Shift+RMB§r it with a <keyword>Memory Card</keyword> to record the <property>source</property>. Then <positive>RMB</positive> another interface to make it a <property>receiver</property>, or an <keyword>Arcane Terminal</keyword> / <keyword>Arcane Assembler</keyword> to recharge its wand.§r

Needs a <warning>channel</warning>, <warning>4 AE</warning> per draw, both chunks loaded and the <warning>same ME network</warning>.
milf.quest.petrochemical_party_pp.wirele:
The <keyword>Arcane Crafting Terminal</keyword> in your hand. Link it in a <keyword>Wireless Access Point</keyword> and charge it in a <keyword>Charger</keyword>.

The <property>grid, crystals and wand</property> stay inside when you close it. Vis is drawn from the aura of the <magic>chunk you stand in</magic> - an <named>Arcane Charging Card</named> expands the area.

With a <named>Drain Upgrade</named> it can <soul>drain aura nodes</soul> into the wand inside.

The <keyword>Essentia Terminal</keyword>, but <wind><wave>wireless</wave></wind>. Manage your essentia from anywhere within range of a <keyword>Wireless Access Point</keyword>.

Insert an <named>Alchemy Upgrade</named> to fill and empty jars directly from the network.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.adhesive.desc: <keyword>Adhesive</keyword> is a synthesized <positive>replacement for slime balls</positive> in recipes - no more hunting rare slimes.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.alchemy_tablet:
<magic>Ember alchemy</magic> - <property>most of your further Embers progress</property> goes through it.

<named>How:</named> put the central item into the <keyword>Exchange Tablet</keyword> (RMB). Around it place an <keyword>Alchemy Pedestal</keyword> for each ingredient: the ingredient on top, an <magic>aspectus</magic> underneath. Then hit the tablet with a <keyword>Beam Cannon</keyword> - it needs Ember and a <pulse>redstone signal</pulse> to fire.

Which aspectus goes where is <glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.05>different in every world</glitch>. Experiment, or make a <keyword>Codebreaking Slate</keyword> to see how many you guessed right.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.ancient_motive:
The <keyword>Ancient Motive Core</keyword> is the <flame>spark</flame> of ancient machinery, built around an <keyword>Everburning Roots Heart</keyword>.

It is the heart of the <keyword>Ember Activator</keyword>, and later it becomes the key to <magic>augmenting</magic> your tools and armor.

Place a tool, weapon or armor piece on the <keyword>Dawnstone Anvil</keyword>, then an <keyword>Ancient Motive Core</keyword>, and <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>hammer away</shake>.

The item gains the ability to <flame>absorb Heat</flame>, which builds up through normal use.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.anvil.desc: Later on, you will need to craft many items using the anvil crafting. Pay attention to the <click action=open_quest value='magic_step_i/winch'><u>winch</u></click>! You can <positive>craft several items at once</positive> with it, and it <warning>won't break the anvil</warning>!
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.any_c_ingots.d: Any <keyword>ingot</keyword> counts here - for example, one fresh off the <keyword>Ingot Stamp</keyword>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.any_c_plates.d: Any <keyword>plate</keyword> counts here - for example, one pressed on the <keyword>Plate Stamp</keyword>.
Fire <property>4</property> <keyword>unfired caminite bricks</keyword> and <property>4</property> <keyword>Everburning Roots</keyword> together in a <keyword>Bloomery</keyword> to get <property>8</property> <keyword>Archaic Bricks</keyword>.

They are the frame of your first Ember devices, and they look great next to caminite in buildings.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.archaic_circui:
An <keyword>Archaic Circuit</keyword> - ancient circuitry that <flame>still answers to Ember</flame>.

It is the base for more complex devices: the <keyword>Mechanical Core</keyword>, the <keyword>Intelligent Apparatus</keyword> and the <keyword>Explosion Charm</keyword>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.ash.desc: <bone>Ash</bone> is more useful than it looks: a poor fuel, a way to recolor stone, and an important <magic>alchemy</magic> ingredient - it is the base for soul sand and the Ashen Amulet.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.ashen_amulet.d:
While you wear the <keyword>Ashen Amulet</keyword>, every block you break and every creature you kill <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>crumbles to ash</shake> - and drops <warning>nothing but ash</warning>.

Power, yes. Well thought-out power - not so much.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.atmospheric_ga: The <keyword>Atmospheric Gauge</keyword> measures the <flame>density of Ember</flame> - the energy of the world's core - at your position.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.automatic_hamm:
Tired of swinging the hammer yourself? The <keyword>Automatic Hammer</keyword> works the <keyword>Dawnstone Anvil</keyword> in front of it - <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>harder and faster</shake> than you.

It needs a little Ember and a <pulse>redstone signal</pulse>.
The <keyword>Beam Splitter</keyword> divides Ember bursts. It has two small copper ports for input and two large dawnstone ports.

Each large port works as <property>its own Emitter</property> and gets half of the incoming Ember - link them to different targets with the hammer.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.bin.desc:
A simple lead barrel with an open top. The <keyword>Bin</keyword> holds a stack of any item.

Place it <property>under</property> a Stamp Base or Exchange Tablet and it will <positive>collect the outputs</positive> automatically.
The <keyword>Blasting Core</keyword> makes things <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>explode</shake>.

On tools it breaks nearby blocks along with the mined one. On weapons it blasts nearby creatures. On armor it blows back attackers when you get hit. Everything grows stronger with augment level.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.bolt_stamp.des: The <keyword>Bolt Stamp</keyword> casts <keyword>bolts</keyword> straight from molten metal.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.bronze_mesh.de: Same as <keyword>copper</keyword>, but with a small chance to catch <keyword>gold</keyword> and <keyword>iron</keyword>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.caster_orb.des:
The <keyword>Caster Orb</keyword> makes every swing of a tool or weapon <flame>fire a small Ember projectile</flame>, as long as you carry Ember. Its size and damage grow with augment level.

Since the item now shoots, it can also take projectile augments like the Focal Lens.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.catalysis_cham:
The <keyword>Catalysis Chamber</keyword> consumes <magic>catalysts</magic> for the Ignem Reactor.

Catalyst levels: <keyword>Ember Grit</keyword> - <property>2</property>, <keyword>Gunpowder</keyword> - <property>3</property>, <keyword>Glowstone Dust</keyword> - <property>4</property>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.catalytic_plug:
For the impatient: a <keyword>Catalytic Plug</keyword> attached to a machine <positive>doubles its speed</positive> while it is fed <wind>steam</wind> from the back.

Two plugs - <positive>4x</positive> speed. More than two, or more than one Mechanical Core in between, lowers efficiency.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.cinder_jet.des:
The <keyword>Cinder Jet</keyword> is an armor augment for <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>dashing</shake>: start sprinting and it will launch you forward, faster with each augment level.

Each dash uses Ember from your inventory.
Put any item into the <keyword>Cinder Plinth</keyword>, give it Ember, and it will <fire>burn the item</fire> into <bone>Ash</bone>.

A <keyword>Bin</keyword> underneath collects the ash automatically.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.clockwork_atte:
The <keyword>Clockwork Attenuator</keyword> controls <property>machine speed</property>. It has two settings toggled by a <pulse>redstone signal</pulse>: active and inactive.

Change the current setting with RMB and Shift + RMB.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.codebreaking_s:
A failed transmutation leaves <keyword>Alchemical Waste</keyword>, and that waste is a <magic>hint</magic>. The <keyword>Codebreaking Slate</keyword> stores up to <property>7</property> pieces and shows your guesses side by side.

<flame>Glowing spot</flame> - a correct aspectus on the correct ingredient. <soul>Pale spot</soul> - a correct aspectus on the wrong ingredient. Spots come in no particular order, one aspectus can appear several times, and not every aspectus is always needed.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.combustion_cha:
The <keyword>Combustion Chamber</keyword> simply <fire>burns fuel</fire> for the Ignem Reactor.

Fuel levels: <keyword>Coal</keyword> - <property>2</property>, <keyword>Nether Brick</keyword> - <property>3</property>, <keyword>Blaze Powder</keyword> - <property>4</property>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.copper_aspectu: The <keyword>Copper Aspectus</keyword> - a lively <magic>alignment</magic> needed for things like <keyword>Adhesive</keyword>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.copper_cell.de:
The <keyword>Copper Cell</keyword> does one thing: <positive>stores Ember</positive>. Fill it through an <keyword>Ember Receptor</keyword> and drain it with an <keyword>Ember Emitter</keyword>.

A broken cell <positive>keeps its stored Ember</positive>, so you can move it around freely.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.copper_crystal: Place the <keyword>Copper Crystal Seed</keyword> in the world and feed it with <keyword>Ember Injectors</keyword> - it will grow and drop <positive>copper nuggets</positive>. An <property>endless</property> source of copper, no mining needed.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.crystal_cell.d:
The <keyword>Crystal Cell</keyword> is <positive>mass Ember storage</positive>. It starts small, but every Ember fuel item you feed it raises its capacity - and the crystal on top <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>physically grows</wiggle>.

Its capacity can reach <property>1,440,000</property> Ember.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.dawnstone_anvi:
The <keyword>Dawnstone Anvil</keyword> is worked with the <keyword>Tinker's Hammer</keyword>.

<named>Repair:</named> place the damaged item, then its repair material, and <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>strike</shake>. A <positive>single material fully repairs</positive> the item.

<named>Disassembly:</named> place the item alone and hit it - it <warning>breaks down</warning> into what it was made of, so diamond armor gives back diamonds.

It is also where <magic>augments</magic> are hammered onto tools and armor.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.dawnstone_aspe:
An <magic>Aspectus</magic> is metal wrapped around an Ember Crystal. Placed under <keyword>Alchemy Pedestals</keyword>, it bends the energy of burning ingredients into a certain <magic>alignment</magic>.

The <keyword>Dawnstone Aspectus</keyword> is the first one you get - and every recipe needs the right ones in the right places.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.dawnstone_ingo:
<keyword>Dawnstone</keyword> - a <flame>bright alloy</flame> of copper and gold, made in the <keyword>Mixer Centrifuge</keyword>. Ember is woven into its very nature.

It is the base material for most advanced Ember machinery.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.dawnstone_mail: <keyword>Dawnstone Mail</keyword> makes the wearer <positive>immune to knockback</positive>. Just don't ask why mail is made of plates.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.diffraction_ba: The <keyword>Diffraction Barrel</keyword> turns any Ember projectile weapon into a kind of <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>shotgun</shake>: instead of a single shot it fires a <property>spread</property> of projectiles.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.dwarven_oil_bu:
Black gold. <keyword>Dwarven Oil</keyword> is made from raw fish and a cerebral plate in a <keyword>Clay Crucible</keyword> heated by a <keyword>Kiln</keyword>, working the bellows all the time.

It expands less than water when boiled, which makes <positive>safer boilers</positive>. Mixed with Soul Crude, it gives <keyword>creosote</keyword>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.eldritch_insig:
With the <keyword>Eldritch Insignia</keyword> on your armor, some monsters become <curse>afraid of you</curse> and won't attack - unless you provoke them.

The higher the augment level, the more creatures are <glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.05>intimidated</glitch>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.ember_activato:
The <keyword>Ember Activator</keyword> finally turns crystals into <flame>usable energy</flame>.

<named>How:</named> feed <keyword>Ember Shards</keyword> or <keyword>Crystals</keyword> into the <property>bottom</property> with a hopper or pipes. With a <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>fiery burst</shake>, activated Ember appears in the copper cage on top - pull it out with an <keyword>Ember Emitter</keyword>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.ember_bore.des:
Bedrock won't stop your machines. The <keyword>Ember Bore</keyword> is a <property>3x3x2</property> machine that digs <flame>Ember crystals</flame> from deep below.

<named>Requirements:</named> <property>overworld</property>, below <property>Y -57</property>, and the blades must touch at least <property>3 bedrock</property> blocks. Fuel it with normal furnace fuel; insert fuel and extract crystals with hoppers or pipes.
Hammer <property>4</property> <keyword>Ember Shards</keyword> together on an <keyword>anvil</keyword> and they <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>fuse</shake> into one <keyword>Ember Crystal</keyword>.

Crystals are a richer fuel for the Activator and go into emitters, receptors and many other machines.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.ember_crystal_: The Bore brings up <keyword>Ember Crystals</keyword>, <keyword>Shards</keyword> and <keyword>Grit</keyword> - finally an <positive>automatic</positive> source of Ember, no more chiseling roots.
<keyword>Ember Crystals</keyword> are what you feed the forge: the more you toss in with the item, the <positive>more likely</positive> the tempering succeeds.

An <keyword>Ember Crystal Cluster</keyword> - several crystals and shards <magic>alchemically fused</magic> together into one big chunk of <flame>raw power</flame>.

It feeds the hungrier machines and becomes the base for the <keyword>Wildfire Core</keyword>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.ember_dial.des: Attach the <keyword>Ember Dial</keyword> to anything that holds Ember and look at it to see <property>how much is stored</property>.
The <keyword>Ember Ejector</keyword> is a sturdier emitter that moves <property>ten times</property> more Ember at once.

Careful: normal receptors are quickly <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>overwhelmed</shake>, and the surplus is <warning>lost</warning>. Pair it with an <keyword>Ember Funnel</keyword>.
The <keyword>Ember Emitter</keyword> is the sending end. Placed on a machine, it sucks Ember into its own buffer.

While it gets a <pulse>redstone signal</pulse>, it periodically fires Ember bursts at the receptor it is linked to.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.ember_funnel.d: The <keyword>Ember Funnel</keyword> catches Ember from <property>several sources</property> at once and quickly passes it into the connected machine - <positive>nothing gets lost</positive>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.ember_injector:
The <keyword>Ember Injector</keyword> grows <keyword>Crystal Seeds</keyword>. Place a seed in the world, point injectors at it and give them Ember - the seed will slowly grow and <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>pop out metal nuggets</wiggle>.

Seeds also gain <property>purity</property> over time: the purer the seed, the more nuggets it drops. Check it with a Tinker's Lens. <warning>Breaking a seed resets its purity!</warning>
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.ember_receiver:
The <keyword>Ember Receptor</keyword> is the receiving end. Place it on a machine: every Ember burst it catches gets pushed straight into that machine, <positive>no redstone needed</positive>.

If the machine can't take everything, the excess is <warning>lost</warning> in a puff of smoke and sparks.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.ember_relay.de:
A burst of Ember can only travel so far. The <keyword>Ember Relay</keyword> <positive>extends the route</positive>.

Link it like any other pair: RMB the source, then RMB the relay, then RMB the relay and the destination. The burst will <wave>flow through it</wave> towards its target.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.ember_shard.de:
An <keyword>Ember Shard</keyword> is a small piece of <flame>solid heat</flame> - clear proof that the power of the world's core exists and can be tapped.

Shards are fuel for the <keyword>Ember Activator</keyword> and an ingredient in plenty of early Ember tech.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.everburning_ro:
Plain <keyword>Everburning Roots</keyword> - what remains of the veins once the Ember has been chiseled out of them.


That <fire>root pillar</fire> sticking out of the ground is made of them, top to bottom, and so is whatever it leads to. <soul>They have been growing for a very long time.</soul>
Don't throw them away: fired in a <keyword>Bloomery</keyword> together with <keyword>unfired caminite bricks</keyword>, they turn into <keyword>Archaic Bricks</keyword>.

A <property>hoe</property> breaks them much faster than any other tool.

The <keyword>Everburning Roots Heart</keyword> is the core of a <warning>rare</warning> underground growth in the overworld. Around it spread <keyword>Everburning Roots</keyword> and their <keyword>Veins</keyword>, all of them <flame>smoldering with Ember</flame>.

<soul>I've seen something like this before.</soul> A <fire>twisted pillar of roots</fire> <wiggle amplitude=2.0 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>crawling out of the ground</wiggle>, hung with vines, as if something underneath had been reaching for the light. Back then I walked past. Now I would follow it down - past the caves, until the stone turns <warning>black</warning> and <property>bedrock</property> is almost within reach. There are not many of them. I only stumbled on one by chance.

The Heart is needed to build an <keyword>Ancient Motive Core</keyword>, so dig it out and take it home. Need more cores later? Go looking for another nest.

Bring a <property>hoe</property> - roots give way to it far faster than to a pickaxe.

<keyword>Everburning Roots Veins</keyword> are roots with <flame>Ember crystals grown right inside</flame>.


Look closer at those root pillars, especially at their core, and at the tangle beneath them. Here and there the wood <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>glimmers</shake> - <flame>something has grown inside it</flame>.
<named>How:</named> hit the block in the world with a <keyword>chisel</keyword>. It will <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>crack open</shake>, drop an <keyword>Ember Shard</keyword> and turn into ordinary <keyword>Everburning Roots</keyword>.

A <property>hoe</property> breaks them much faster than any other tool.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.explosion_char: While you wear the <keyword>Explosion Charm</keyword>, explosions near you are <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>absorbed</shake> - their destructive force goes into the charm. No special bonus, just <positive>no crater</positive>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.explosion_pede: Put an <keyword>Explosion Charm</keyword> on this pedestal and it will <positive>protect the area</positive> from explosions on its own, no need to wear it.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.field_chart.de:
Searching for rich spots with a gauge is tedious. The <keyword>Field Chart</keyword> shows a <property>map of Ember concentration</property> over a large area.

RMB it to display the base Ember level of the area.
The <keyword>Flame Barrier</keyword> surrounds you with a <fire>shield of fire</fire> when you are hit: the attacker is <flame>set on fire</flame> and takes damage.

Each blast uses Ember; damage grows with augment level.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.flat_stamp.des:
The <keyword>Flat Stamp</keyword> works without molten metal: put an <property>item</property> into the base and the press <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>crushes</shake> it.

Raw ore gives <positive>2 crushed ore</positive>, and each crushed ore gives <positive>2 dusts</positive> for the melter. An <keyword>Ember Crystal</keyword> gets crushed into <property>3</property> <keyword>Ember Grit</keyword>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.fluid_dial.des: The <keyword>Fluid Dial</keyword> shows <property>which fluid and how much</property> is in the tank it is attached to.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.fluid_transfer:
The <keyword>Fluid Transfer</keyword> is the fluid version of the Item Transfer.

Set the filter with a <keyword>bucket</keyword> or another container holding the fluid - it <positive>isn't consumed</positive>. Without a filter it works as a <wave>one-way pipe</wave>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.focal_lens.des: The <keyword>Focal Lens</keyword> sharpens Ember weapons: fireballs become <positive>homing</positive>, and rays become <positive>piercing</positive>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.gear_stamp.des: The <keyword>Gear Stamp</keyword> casts <keyword>gears</keyword> from molten metal. This one is tougher to make: it is fired in a <keyword>Bloomery</keyword> with <property>bellows</property>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.geologic_separ:
Ores are never pure. The <keyword>Geologic Separator</keyword> filters out impurities while melting and gives a <positive>bonus metal</positive> - for example, a bit of gold when melting copper.

Place it <property>next to the Melter</property>, with the tap facing the melter's bottom block.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.glimmer_crysta:
A <keyword>Glimmer Crystal</keyword> is quartz infused with heat and Ember, eager to <flame>give its light away</flame>. Use it to place light sources anywhere.

Each use drains the crystal, but it <positive>slowly recharges</positive> while you stand in sunlight.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.glimmer_lamp.d:
The <keyword>Glimmer Lamp</keyword> is a crystal in a metal cage that <wave>launches</wave> light sources, so you can light up spots <positive>far away</positive>.

It has fewer charges and recharges slower in sunlight than the plain crystal.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.gold.title: Gold
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.gold_crystal_s: Place the <keyword>Gold Crystal Seed</keyword> in the world and feed it with <keyword>Ember Injectors</keyword> - it will grow and drop <positive>gold nuggets</positive>. An <property>endless</property> source of gold, no mining needed.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.heat_exchanger:
<keyword>Ember Grit</keyword> produces no Ember in the Activator by itself. The <keyword>Heat Exchanger</keyword>, attached to the <property>bottom</property> of an <keyword>Ember Activator</keyword>, multiplies produced Ember by <property>0.9</property> but adds a flat <positive>+300</positive> per item.

This lets you burn grit for power and squeezes a bit more out of shards and crystals.
The <keyword>Ignem Reactor</keyword> refines Ember crystals with a <flame>huge multiplier</flame>. Place it next to the top parts of both a <keyword>Combustion Chamber</keyword> and a <keyword>Catalysis Chamber</keyword>.

Multiplier = <property>fuel level + catalyst level + 1</property>. Keep both levels <warning>close to each other</warning>, or the reactor won't be happy.
Once an item's <flame>Heat</flame> bar is full, it must be tempered in the <keyword>Inferno Forge</keyword>.

<named>How:</named> power the forge with Ember, open the hatch on top and toss in the hot item plus some <keyword>Ember crystals</keyword>. <property>More crystals - better chances</property>. On success the item gains a level and an <magic>augment slot</magic>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.ingot_stamp.de:
The <keyword>Ingot Stamp</keyword> presses molten metal back into <keyword>ingots</keyword>.

Like all stamps, it is shaped from <keyword>caminite blend</keyword> and fired in a <keyword>Bloomery</keyword>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.intelligent_ap: The <keyword>Intelligent Apparatus</keyword> is an armor <magic>augment</magic>: creatures slain by the wearer drop <positive>more experience</positive>. Higher augment level - more XP.
The <keyword>Intelligent Apparatus</keyword> on your armor makes slain creatures drop <positive>more experience</positive>. Higher augment level - more XP.
The <keyword>Iron Aspectus</keyword> - a steady <magic>alignment</magic> that opens up new transmutations, including the <keyword>Ember Crystal Cluster</keyword>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.iron_crystal_s: Place the <keyword>Iron Crystal Seed</keyword> in the world and feed it with <keyword>Ember Injectors</keyword> - it will grow and drop <positive>iron nuggets</positive>. An <property>endless</property> source of iron, no mining needed.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.isolated_mater: <keyword>Isolated Materia</keyword> can <glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.05>become the material</glitch> of other items. On the anvil it <positive>replaces any repair material</positive>, so you can fix almost anything with it.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.item_dial.desc: The <keyword>Item Dial</keyword> shows the <property>contents of an inventory</property> it is attached to, slot by slot.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.item_dropper.d: The <keyword>Item Dropper</keyword> takes items piped into its top and quickly <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>spits them out</wiggle> straight down into the world.
The <keyword>Item Transfer</keyword> works like a pipe that connects only <property>front and back</property>, and items <positive>always prefer it</positive> over other routes.

RMB it with an item to set a <property>filter</property>.
The <keyword>Lead Aspectus</keyword> - another <magic>alignment</magic> for your recipes. The more aspecti you own, the more transmutations you can attempt.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.lead_crystal_s: Place the <keyword>Lead Crystal Seed</keyword> in the world and feed it with <keyword>Ember Injectors</keyword> - it will grow and drop <positive>lead nuggets</positive>. An <property>endless</property> source of lead, no mining needed.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.mechanical_cor:
Big machines like the <keyword>Ember Bore</keyword> have only one port. The <keyword>Mechanical Core</keyword> <positive>extends it</positive>: it works as a proxy to the items, fluids or Ember of the large machine it faces.

Up to <property>3</property> cores can be chained. Upgrades like the Catalytic Plug can also be attached through a core.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.mechanical_pum:
The <keyword>Mechanical Pump</keyword> draws <aqua>water</aqua> from the world, for example for the <keyword>Pressure Refinery</keyword>.

Ember converts poorly into motion, so a pump running on Ember alone is <warning>slow</warning> - build several.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.melter.desc:
The <keyword>Melter</keyword> is two blocks tall. Give Ember to the <property>bottom</property> block and put meltable items into the <property>top</property> one - they will <flame>melt down</flame>, and the molten metal can be piped out.

The melter works with <keyword>metal dusts</keyword>: one dust gives <property>60 mB</property> of metal.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.mini_boiler.de:
Ember machines give off heat - don't waste it. The <keyword>Mini Boiler</keyword>, attached to the side of a machine that uses or produces Ember, boils <aqua>water</aqua> into <wind>steam</wind>.

That steam feeds Catalytic Plugs, Wildfire Stirlings and even <keyword>Modern Industrialization</keyword> machines.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.mirror_relay.d: The <keyword>Mirror Relay</keyword> works like a normal relay, but Ember <wave>bounces off it</wave> like light off a mirror instead of passing through. Handy for turning a beam around.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.mixer_centrifu:
The <keyword>Mixer Centrifuge</keyword> creates alloys. Each of the <property>4 sides</property> of the bottom block is its own tank - pump a different molten metal into each.

Give the <property>top</property> block Ember, and once the right combination is inside, the alloy will <wave>mix</wave> and can be pumped out of the top.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.nugget_stamp.d:
The <keyword>Nugget Stamp</keyword> casts <keyword>nuggets</keyword>.

Add an <keyword>Ember Crystal</keyword> into the base and <property>200 mB</property> of metal will wrap around it, giving an <magic>Aspectus</magic> of that metal.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.plate_stamp.de: The <keyword>Plate Stamp</keyword> turns molten metal into <keyword>plates</keyword> - <positive>no more hammering</positive> them by hand.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.pressure_refin:
The <keyword>Pressure Refinery</keyword> is a much stronger Activator: it needs crystals, Ember and <aqua>water</aqua> and gives <property>1.5x</property> the yield by default.

Place it on a <keyword>metal block</keyword> surrounded by <flame>lava or fire</flame> and the yield goes up to <positive>3x</positive>, depending on how many hot blocks are around the base.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.q0083a8fb4eca2:
<magic>Augments</magic> - the way to give your gear new abilities.

1. Hammer a <keyword>Motive Core</keyword> into an item on the anvil - it starts gaining <flame>Heat</flame> as you use it.

2. When the Heat bar is full, temper it in the <keyword>Inferno Forge</keyword> for an <property>augment slot</property>.

3. Hammer augments onto it at the <keyword>Dawnstone Anvil</keyword>: item first, then the augment. Augments have levels, the item's level limits how many you can fit. Placing the item alone and hammering <positive>removes all augments</positive> for free.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.q0f5a8505e8066:
Deep beneath the overworld something is <flame>still burning</flame>. <named>Embers</named> is about <flame>Ember</flame> - the heat of the world's core locked inside crystals - and the machines that run on it.

Your <keyword>Ancient Codex</keyword> keeps notes on every device. Hover over any Embers item and hold <property>Ctrl</property> to open its entry, or press <property>Ctrl + RMB</property> on a placed block.

The codex explains how machines work, but its recipes <warning>may not match</warning> - check <keyword>EMI</keyword> and the quests for those.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.q20cff974a8f0e:
Your first <flame>molten metal</flame>! It can be pumped out of the melter into a <keyword>Stamp Base</keyword>, a tank or a <keyword>Mixer Centrifuge</keyword>.

Each dust gives <property>60 mB</property>. Want more? Later a <keyword>Geologic Separator</keyword> will add a <positive>bonus metal</positive> on top.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.reservoir.desc:
The <keyword>Reservoir</keyword> stores <aqua>huge amounts of fluid</aqua>. On its own it holds nothing - stack <keyword>Caminite Rings</keyword> on top, each adds <property>40 buckets</property>.

It is filled and drained only through the port at the bottom. <keyword>Caminite Valves</keyword> hold as much as a ring, but give <positive>4 extra sides</positive> for pipes.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.resonating_bel:
The <keyword>Resonating Bell</keyword> lets a tool <wave>ring through blocks</wave>: RMB a block and nearby blocks of the same type will <flame>light up</flame> - unless there are tons of them around.

The search area grows with augment level. Perfect for finding ores.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.rod_stamp.desc: The <keyword>Rod Stamp</keyword> casts <keyword>rods</keyword> straight from molten metal.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.salt.title: Salt
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.shifting_scale:
<keyword>Shifting Scales</keyword> grow on armor while you <property>stand still</property> and haven't been hit for a while - a third of a scale at a time.

Each hit breaks some scales off, and they <positive>block most damage</positive>, except hunger and drowning.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.silver_aspectu: The <keyword>Silver Aspectus</keyword> - silver has always been a good channel for the <magic>arcane</magic>. Needed for finer transmutations.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.silver_pickaxe: A <keyword>Silver Pickaxe</keyword> - bright and precise. Nothing magical, just a solid tool.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.smoky_tinker_l:
Too much information can be a curse. The <keyword>Smoky Tinker's Lens</keyword> on a helmet <property>turns off</property> the machine overlay that some helmets show.

It takes no augment slot, but the helmet needs a Motive Core first.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.soul_crude_buc:
<soul>Soul Crude</soul> is boiled out of <keyword>soul sand</keyword> and logs in a <keyword>Clay Crucible</keyword> heated by a <keyword>Kiln</keyword>, working the bellows all the time.

Mixed with <keyword>Dwarven Oil</keyword> in the Mixer Centrifuge it becomes <keyword>creosote</keyword>.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.soul_sand.desc: Through <magic>hellish synthesis</magic> on an <bone>Ash</bone> tablet you can make <keyword>Soul Sand</keyword> - matter from a strange faraway realm, no trip to the Nether needed.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.stamper.desc:
The <keyword>Stamper</keyword> shapes molten metal into useful forms.

<named>Setup:</named> place the <keyword>Stamper</keyword> <property>two blocks above</property> the <keyword>Stamp Base</keyword>, with <warning>one empty block</warning> between them - the press needs room to <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>slam down</shake>. Give the Stamper Ember and a <property>stamp</property>, then pipe molten metal into the Stamp Base.

A <keyword>Bin</keyword> under the Stamp Base collects the products automatically.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.superheater.de:
The <keyword>Superheater</keyword> <flame>cooks</flame> everything: mined blocks drop smelted, slain creatures drop cooked food, and targets take extra <fire>burn damage</fire>.

Higher level - more damage. Uses Ember from your inventory.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.tin_crystal_se: Place the <keyword>Tin Crystal Seed</keyword> in the world and feed it with <keyword>Ember Injectors</keyword> - it will grow and drop <positive>tin nuggets</positive>. An <property>endless</property> source of tin, no mining needed.
The <keyword>Tinker's Hammer</keyword> is your main Ember tool.

<named>Linking:</named> RMB an <keyword>Emitter</keyword>, then RMB a <keyword>Receptor</keyword> or <keyword>Relay</keyword>. There is no distance limit, but a burst that travels <warning>too long</warning> fades away along with its Ember.

It also <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>pounds</shake> items on the <keyword>Dawnstone Anvil</keyword> and disconnects pipes from each other.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.tinker_lens.de:
Can't tell which side of a machine does what? Hold the <keyword>Tinker's Lens</keyword> in either hand.

It shows the <property>purpose of every face</property>, what goes in and out, whether <pulse>redstone</pulse> is needed, the movement inside pipes and which receptor an emitter is linked to.
A Crystal Cluster is too <flame>wild</flame> for delicate work. The <keyword>Wildfire Core</keyword> is that fire <property>tamed</property> - the heart of injectors, reactors and many augments.
milf.quest.rock_and_steam.wildfire_stirl:
The <keyword>Wildfire Stirling</keyword> is the counterpart of the Catalytic Plug: fed with <wind>steam</wind>, it <positive>halves the Ember cost</positive> of a machine.

Two stirlings - a quarter of the cost. More than two, or more than one Mechanical Core in between, lowers efficiency.
<keyword>Winding Gears</keyword> on a tool: RMB to <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>wind it up</wiggle>. While wound, holding LMB attacks automatically and mining is faster, but the spring slowly unwinds.

On boots they make you <positive>jump much higher</positive>, bounce without fall damage, and jump farther after a sprint - as long as you hold a wound tool.
milf.quest.simple_machinery.addons.title: Addons
milf.quest.simple_machinery.bedrock_samp:
After a few seconds of <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>drilling</shake> the bedrock under the drill turns into a <positive>sample</positive> of one of the nearby ores

<warning><shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>The drill is destroyed in the process</shake></warning> - you'll need a new one for every sample

A chunk can hold <property>one sample of each ore</property>. If there are several deposits nearby, each new perforation in the same chunk gives the next ore, until all of them have a sample

Samples are used by ore-mining machines - for example, a <named>Quarry</named> needs a sample <keyword>below it</keyword> to dig up that ore
milf.quest.simple_machinery.blueprint.de: It totally makes sense that you can <positive>squeeze information</positive> out of <keyword>books</keyword> ´꒳\`
milf.quest.simple_machinery.chunk_loader:
Please note that the complete structure requires a <keyword>steel window block</keyword> at the top center.

It work for a <property>paper</property>, has a <property>radius of 32 blocks</property>, and displays the block it is loading inside itself; you can click on it to see the path to the loaded block.

To open the entry for this block in the book, you need to pick up an <keyword>Echo Shard</keyword>.
milf.quest.simple_machinery.ember_energy:
The <keyword>Ember Dynamo</keyword> catches Ember bursts like a receptor and turns them into <property>FE</property>.

Link an <keyword>Emitter</keyword> to it with the <keyword>Tinker's Hammer</keyword> and it will <wave>push the energy</wave> into the block it is attached to.
milf.quest.simple_machinery.excavation_b:
<keyword>Excavation Buckets</keyword> are a Bore upgrade: it can also dig up <keyword>gravel</keyword>, <keyword>flint</keyword> or <keyword>snow</keyword>.

The gravel or snow must be placed <property>touching the bore blades</property>.
milf.quest.simple_machinery.grindingdisk: §lUse this to extract the meteorite and all its contents!§r
Allows for <positive>downward gliding</positive>, works well with the <keyword>Slime Sling</keyword>
Give the <keyword>Item Vacuum</keyword> a <pulse>redstone signal</pulse> and it will <wave>suck in</wave> all loose items in a large area in front of it.

It has no inventory of its own and pushes items straight into a pipe or container at its back. Put an <keyword>Item Transfer</keyword> there to <property>filter</property> what gets picked up.
milf.quest.simple_machinery.labelgun.des:
Hover over the disk to see the <warning>warnings and errors</warning> for your program

Shift-right-click the manager with the <keyword>label gun</keyword> in your hand to load the labels from your program

You can now use the <keyword>scroll wheel</keyword> while holding shift to <positive>change the active label</positive>

Right click blocks in the world to <positive>apply or remove</positive> the label.

There is also a right-click menu for entering a <property>custom label</property> that may not be in your program yet.

Once you've assigned the labels, right click the manager while NOT holding shift to <positive>save the labels</positive> to the <named>Program Disk</named>

Your program should now be running without any issues
milf.quest.simple_machinery.manager.desc:
The <warning>Factory Manager</warning> is the core component of SFM. We want you to ease into what the mod is capable of, so as a reward, you’ll receive some cables, a couple of storage blocks, and, most importantly, a program disk containing your first program—it will help you figure out what you can do with this mod.

Place §lcable§r, §lstorage§r and §lFactory Manager§r as shown in the screenshot below.§r

And put §lour program§r in the §lmanager§r.§r
milf.quest.simple_machinery.multiblock_p:
Tired of building all those complex multiblock structures? Want to have an ability to <positive>easily move them around</positive> if you feel weak Feng Shui from it? We're presenting to you: <named>Multiblock Packer 3000 (Safety regulations edition)</named>.
With this bad boy you can forget about all the hassle of manually building structures FOREVER! With <property>advanced compacting technology</property>, we accomplished the ability to <positive>pack ANY multiblock</positive> into a single small box! You can carry it around, you can place it anywhere, and you can even take it back whenever you wish to! Our engineers at <named>PLACERS™</named> (Packing Logistics And Controlled Erections of Rebuildable Structures) have made the real revolution by discovering the new <named>PUSH®</named> (Piston it Until Shit Happens) technique, which allowed us to pack such great possibilities in such a tiny device.
Craft one for yourself today, and you'll get an <positive>unlimited supply of boxes</positive>, a Multiblock Packer 3000 (Safety regulations edition) PLACER, AND a little plushie of our demure, ditzy CEO for free!

<fade>ⓘ (We are not responsible for any injuries inflicted on the user by the machine. May contain traces of radioactive waste, horsehairs, and insulin. Not recommended for use for infants, piglins, and fairies) </fade>
milf.quest.simple_machinery.not_so_multi:
Another <positive>breakthrough invention</positive> of <named>PLACERS™</named> (Packing Logistics And Controlled Erections of Rebuildable Structures) engineers - the lesser one, but not less artifice: <named>Not So Multi But Still Block Packer 2099 3x3x3 Edition</named>! This small device can do what most of us can, but less most of us want to do - turn complex details into not-less-complex machines! Just shove all the constituents of a whole into one of the BIG square holes this thing has, and BOOM - the <named>HOLE®</named> (Hidden and Originally Least Expected) mechanism will do all the <positive>hard work</positive> for you!
(The inner workings of this apparatus are considered a <warning>corporate secret</warning>, but we can assure you that it's most logical that to make this thing you have to unpack one of the newer models in a similar lineup of machines, specifically the <named>Multiblock Packer 3000 (Safety regulations edition)</named>)
milf.quest.simple_machinery.oil_can.desc:
The <named>Lubricant Can</named> starts the perforation. Fill it with at least <property>4000 mB</property> of <named>Lubricant</named> - one perforation takes exactly that much

Hold the can in your <keyword>main hand</keyword> and <keyword>RMB</keyword> on the <keyword>bottom part</keyword> of a running drill. If something is wrong - wrong height, wrong fluid or no deposits nearby - you'll get a message saying what exactly
milf.quest.simple_machinery.postbase.des:
Decoration stuff
mod allows you to have very tall posts with some different types to choose from, instead of just the Treated-Wood, Aluminum and Steel variants.
milf.quest.simple_machinery.q68efb14826c:
Her eyes will gaze upon this work,
To find mere never-ending shirk,
From all those people who just smirk,
Upon receiving tasks from clerk,

And so she will declare one quirk,
For all those people who just lurk,
And those who might convey great irk,
To those who sometimes overwork:

"If you're to be the one who will,
Without the everlasting seal,
Become the one who makes things real,
The one who will fulfill my will,

Then be my guest and join the rest,
As our company digests,
All the secrets left to rest,
By those who craved this in their chests,

And the secrets that you'll learn,
All the power you so yearn,
You could keep them - we'll not spurn,
Just remember not to turn"
milf.quest.simple_machinery.sample_drill:
The <named>Core Sample Drill</named> is used to <keyword>bore into bedrock</keyword> and create <positive>bedrock samples</positive> - the base for automated ore mining

Place it <keyword>right on bedrock</keyword>, so that its bottom part stands at <property>Y -59</property>, and give it <property>power</property> - the drill must be <keyword>running</keyword>

There must be an <named>ore deposit</named> within <property>10 blocks</property> of you, otherwise there is nothing to sample. A <named>Stone Nose</named> helps to find them - it marks all deposits of one ore type around you
milf.quest.simple_machinery.so_what_s_th:
This is a simple example to help you understand how to <positive>assign labels</positive> and what the <keyword>mod syntax</keyword> is.

This program will <positive>move items</positive> from the <keyword>barrel</keyword> to the <keyword>chest</keyword> every <keyword>20 ticks</keyword>(<keyword>1 second = 20 ticks</keyword>) if you've done everything correctly!

We §l§2highly recommend§r§r that you check out this mod and start using it to automate tasks - it’s really convenient!§r
So what's the point of all this?
milf.quest.simple_machinery.steam_quarry:
The <named>Steam Quarry</named> digs ore <keyword>out of a bedrock sample</keyword>. Build it at the very bottom of the world, so that the sample lies <keyword>under the block right behind the controller</keyword> - the quarry mines only the ore of that sample

Put <named>drills</named> into its input hatch - they <warning>wear out</warning> from time to time. Better drills dig faster and give more ore, and <keyword>harder ores need better drills</keyword>

On steam it can run recipes of at most <property>2 EU/t</property> with bronze hatches and <property>4 EU/t</property> if at least one hatch is steel. <warning>Sample recipes need 3-4 EU/t</warning>, so don't forget a <named>steel hatch</named>

Not every ore can be quarried - check <keyword>EMI</keyword> to see which drills work with your sample
milf.quest.simple_machinery.survey_tools: Allows you to <positive>search for ore</positive> in chunks
milf.quest.simple_machinery.tyrfing.desc:
<keyword>Tyrfing</keyword> is a <curse>pulsating</curse> lead blade shaped through alchemy. Against most targets it is a bit duller than a normal sword...

...but the <warning>more armor</warning> the enemy wears, the <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>harder it hits</shake>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.abyssal_h:
<glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.05>It is alive. It is watching.</glitch>

Drops from the <blood>Ender Dragon</blood>, but only for the <curse>Worthy</curse> - those who spent <magic>99.5%</magic> of their time under the Seven Curses.

The heart of the most violent <soul>eldritch</soul> relics.

The heart in the recipe must be <property>tainted</property>: it becomes tainted on its own in the inventory of a cursed one.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.ancient_t: The <named>Eye of Chorus</named> is made of <magic>chorus fruit</magic> and leads to the <named>Ancient Tower Remains</named>. Three <keyword>Chorusling</keyword> spawners guard the ruins.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.angel_ble:
A <wind>spellstone of the sky</wind>.

- <named>Active:</named> a dash in the direction you look - also by pressing <property>jump in mid-air</property>.
- No <positive>fall or collision damage</positive>.
- A chance to <wind>deflect</wind> incoming projectiles, and your own projectiles fly much faster.
- <warning>Weakness:</warning> vulnerable to Withering and void damage.

Worn in the <property>spellstone slot</property>. The active ability is used with the <named>Spellstone Active Ability</named> key.
Found in in <property>desert and jungle temple chests</property>, or crafted on the <keyword>Spellstone Table</keyword>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.anglers_h: This <named>artifact</named> is compatible with fishing from the <magic>Starcatcher</magic> mod!
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.animal_gu:
For friends of all creatures.

- Your attacks <positive>cannot hurt animals</positive> - no more accidental hits.
- <nature>Hoglins</nature> around you become passive.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.annihilat:
