<blood>Eldritch weapon.</blood> Only the <curse>Worthy</curse> - those who have carried the Seven Curses long enough - can craft and wield it.

<named>Recipe:</named> a <keyword>tainted Heart of the Abyss</keyword> in the center, a <keyword>Nefarious Ingot</keyword> above it, a <keyword>Twisted Heart</keyword> below it, abyssal relics in all four corners, the side slots empty. The more <soul>Hearts of the Abyss</soul> you have obtained, the more corner relics <positive>come back</positive> after crafting.

<named>In battle:</named> every hit builds up <glitch>Annihilation Points</glitch> - the more damage and the tougher the target, the faster. Past a threshold, a hit may deal <blood>massive</blood> damage.

With the other hand empty:
- in the <property>main hand</property>, hold <property>RMB</property> to spend charge on a stronger strike;
- in the <property>off hand</property>, it can <wind>block</wind>, and a well-timed block grants charge.

<keyword>Annihilator</keyword> armor is made on the smithing table: netherite armor + <keyword>Annihilator template</keyword> + a <keyword>Portal Shard</keyword> for each piece.

The template is crafted from enderitium ingots, end stone and a <keyword>Bottle of Annihilation</keyword>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.antique_b:
It saves space and prevents you from losing the buffs from the books that grant them.

Can store any books tagged with BOOKSHELF_BOOKS
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.ascension:
The <keyword>Enigmatic Amulet</keyword> reborn among the stars. Instead of a single color bonus, it gives <magic><wave>the bonuses of all colors at once</wave></magic>: damage, sprint and swim speed, deflect chance, lower gravity, mining speed and lifesteal.

It also adds <property>+1 charm slot</property> and, like any Enigmatic Amulet, saves your items in a vessel on death.

The <keyword>Enigmatic Amulet</keyword> reborn among the stars. Instead of a single color bonus, it gives <magic><wave>the bonuses of all colors at once</wave></magic>: damage, sprint and swim speed, deflect chance, lower gravity, mining speed and lifesteal.

It also adds <property>+1 charm slot</property> and, like any Enigmatic Amulet, saves your items in a vessel on death.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.astral_du:
<magic>Power of all elements</magic>, mixed and frozen in a single instant.

Found in <property>End City chests</property>, and <keyword>Shulkers</keyword> drop it for those who bear the <blood>Seven Curses</blood>.

The main ingredient of every <wind>astral</wind> relic - the Heart of the Cosmos, the Ender Rod, starlight items and more.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.atmospher:
Light as a cloud: <wind>Atmospheric Boots</wind> reduce fall damage by <property>50%</property>.

They drop from the golem, and a spare pair can be crafted from an <keyword>Air Rune</keyword>, <keyword>Cloud Rods</keyword> and diamonds.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.atom_spli:
Hold <property>RMB</property> for <property>1.5 seconds</property> to fire an <glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.05>annihilation beam</glitch>, with <property>Shift</property> - a cluster annihilation bomb.

<positive>Unbreakable</positive>. Reloads by itself from <keyword>Bottles of Annihilation</keyword> in your inventory.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.avarice_s:
<keyword><wiggle amplitude=0.3 frequency=0.4>Greed has no bottom.</wiggle></keyword>

- Extra <keyword>Fortune</keyword>.
- <fire>Piglins</fire> stay neutral despite the Second Curse, and bartering is about <positive>twice as profitable</positive>.
- Any slain mob has a chance to drop an <positive>Emerald</positive>.
- Villagers give a <positive>35% discount</positive>.

<curse>For the cursed:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.axe_of_li:
<property>RMB</property> calls down a <magic><glitch frequency=0.7 shiftChance=0.06>lightning strike</glitch></magic> - <property>9 damage per tick</property>, <warning>ignoring armor</warning>.

<property>RMB</property> on a block sends an <magic>electric shockwave</magic> in the direction you look.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.berserk_e:
<blood>The closer to death, the stronger.</blood>

Attack damage, attack speed, movement speed and damage resistance grow with the <warning>percentage of health you are missing</warning>.

When damage strips <flame>Blazing Might</flame> from you, that damage is reduced based on the effect's level.

<curse>For the cursed:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.blank_scr:
An empty scroll. Add the right ingredients to get one of the <keyword>simple scrolls</keyword>: Ageless Wisdom, Explorer, Hunter, Survivor or Gift of the Heaven.

Scrolls go into a <property>separate scroll slot</property>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.blastproo: Reduces explosion damage by <property>35%</property>. Creepers behind your back are <positive>not so scary anymore</positive>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.blazing_c:
A <flame>spellstone of fire</flame>.

- Immunity to <fire>fire</fire>, temporary immunity to <fire>lava</fire> and clear vision in it.
- Burns those who hit you in melee.
- Every status effect on you wears off <property>twice as fast</property> - except <flame>Molten Heart</flame>, which lasts twice as long.
- <warning>Weakness:</warning> underwater creatures.

Worn in the <property>spellstone slot</property>. The active ability is used with the <named>Spellstone Active Ability</named> key.
Found in in <property>ruined portals, Nether fortresses and bastions</property>, or crafted on the <keyword>Spellstone Table</keyword>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.bless_amp:
Hold the tome and press <property>RMB</property> on an enchanted item in your inventory to <magic><pulse>upgrade its enchantments</pulse></magic>.

It can push them <positive>past the usual level limit</positive>.

<curse>Relic:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> or the <named>Ring of Redemption</named> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.bless_pot:
Brewed in a <property>Brewing Stand</property> with a <keyword>Pure Heart</keyword>.

Drink it to <positive>remove every negative effect</positive> on you and receive <soul>Pure Resistance</soul> - the more effects were removed, the stronger it is. Pure Resistance reduces damage and can block hits entirely.

<curse>Relic:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> or the <named>Ring of Redemption</named> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.bless_sto:
<positive><pulse base=0.6 amplitude=1.0>The fate reverses.</pulse></positive>

Hold the stone and <property>seek death</property> - the <blood>Ring of the Seven Curses</blood> will turn into the <named>Ring of Redemption</named>.

<warning>This cannot be undone.</warning>
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.buckler_o:
<property>Shift + hold RMB</property> for <property>0.5 seconds</property> to strike everything around you and fire three small <glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.05>annihilation bombs</glitch> for <property>8 damage</property>, <warning>ignoring armor</warning>.

<warning>Spends an Eye Crystal</warning> - get a spare one first.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.chaos_ely:
<blood>Wings of eldritch arrogance.</blood>

- Reduces damage taken <property>from behind</property>.
- Dive vertically into the ground to deal <warning>area damage</warning> on impact.

With the <keyword>Proof of Dimness</keyword> worn: an <soul>Abyss Boost</soul> that improves every aspect of the wings.

<blood>For the Worthy:</blood> only those who have spent <magic>99.5%</magic> of their time under the Seven Curses can craft and use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.chesed.de:
<magic>Chesed</magic> - a creature born from rocks corroded by <soul>sculk</soul>, wielding enormous magic power. <curse>No mercy for the merciless.</curse>

Throw the <keyword>Eye of Chesed</keyword> to find its arena, then <property>RMB</property> the boss spawner to read its abilities and start the fight.

You can use the structure-finding ritual from the <click action=open_quest value='magic_step_ii/brazier'><u>Eidolon</u></click> mod or <click action=open_quest value='magic_step_i/ritual_locate_structure'><u>Ars Additions</u></click>.

Chesed <warning>cannot be hurt directly</warning>, and its attacks pierce armor and shields. Wait for the <magic><glitch frequency=0.7 shiftChance=0.06>Lightning Ray</glitch></magic>, break a <keyword>crystal</keyword> with an <property>axe</property> to become <positive>Energized</positive>, then run to a <keyword>Ray Reflector</keyword> and let the ray hit it.

Destroy the <keyword>Monoliths</keyword> - while all of them are active, its final strike is <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.3>impossible to survive</shake>. And <warning>never look away from it</warning>.

Drops the <keyword>Lightning Core</keyword> and the <keyword>Phase Sphere</keyword>. Finish it with a <property>wrench</property> for a <property>50%</property> chance at an <named>Electronic Ender Core</named>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.chorus_bl: <property>RMB</property> <wiggly>teleports</wiggly> you to a random spot nearby - perfect for dodging a heavy blow.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.chorus_ca:
An upgraded <keyword>Sand Cannon</keyword>. Hold for <property>1.5 seconds</property> to fire a chorus bomb that infects enemies with <poison>Chorus Infection</poison>.

<warning>Every chorus item needs its own Chorus Crystal.</warning>
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.cloudy_te:
The <named>Eye of Air</named> is made of <wind>feathers</wind> and points to the <named>Cloudy Temple</named> on <wind>mountain peaks</wind> and <nature>meadows</nature>.

Four <keyword>Hovering Hurricanes</keyword> circle around it - deal with them before climbing to the top.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.collapsed:
Four <soul>soul torches</soul> make the <named>Eye of Ghost</named>. It leads back to the Overworld - to the <soul>Collapsed Kingdom</soul>, a dungeon hidden under <nature>forests</nature> and <nature>plains</nature>.

Its halls are still guarded by <fade minAlpha=0.4 frequency=1.0>the knights of a fallen king</fade>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.cosmic_he:
A <aqua>Heart of the Sea</aqua> reforged with ingredients from other dimensions into something <magic><wave>vastly more powerful</wave></magic>.

A key part of the strongest <keyword>astral</keyword> and <blood>eldritch</blood> relics. You will need several of them, so a steady supply of <property>Nether Stars</property> helps a lot.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.cosmic_sc:
<magic><typewriter speed=1.5>The Architect watches over the chosen.</typewriter></magic>

- When you take <warning>lethal damage</warning>, health is restored to <positive>50%</positive> and powerful buffs are applied. Has a long cooldown.
- Bonus damage against players who are not chosen, and your melee hits <fire>set them on fire</fire>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.curse_tra:
The dark twin of the <keyword>Tome of Hungering Knowledge</keyword>.

Hold it and press <property>RMB</property> on an enchanted item in your inventory: <curse>all curses</curse> move into the tome, and the item is cleansed. Useful enchantments stay where they were.

<curse>For the cursed:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.cursed_sc:
Bonus attack damage, mining speed and health regeneration - <curse>multiplied by the number of curses</curse> on all the gear you wear.

The more cursed enchantments you carry, the stronger you are. The current bonus is shown in the tooltip.

<curse>For the cursed:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.cursed_st:
<warning><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>A way to break the ring - at a price.</shake></warning>

Die in the <fire>Nether</fire>, in the middle of a <fire>large lava lake</fire>, with this stone in your inventory. The <blood>Ring of the Seven Curses</blood> will be <warning>destroyed forever</warning>, along with one of your <soul>Soul Crystals</soul>.

The stone is also needed to create the <named>Holy Stone</named> - the gentler path to freedom.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.cursed_xp:
Works like the <keyword>Scroll of Ageless Wisdom</keyword> - stores and gives back experience the same way.

- Your stats grow with your <magic>experience level</magic>, plus knockback resistance.
- <warning>Less experience</warning> from orbs.
- <warning>All experience is lost on death.</warning>

<curse>For the cursed:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.desolatio:
<soul><fade minAlpha=0.3 frequency=0.5>Nothing lives where you walk.</fade></soul>

- Slain mobs <warning>drop nothing</warning>.
- Neutral creatures do not spawn near you, and enemies do not hunt you.
- Unprovoked mobs around you <blood>simply die</blood>.

With the <keyword>Proof of Dimness</keyword> worn: an <soul>Abyss Boost</soul> - your first hit on an unprovoked creature marks it for <blood>execution</blood>.

<blood>For the Worthy:</blood> only those who have spent <magic>99.5%</magic> of their time under the Seven Curses can craft and use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.dimension:
A reinforced Respawn Anchor for those who don't trust glowstone. Right-click it to call this place home - just like the vanilla block.

Feed it <keyword>Eyes of Ender</keyword> instead of Glowstone Dust to charge it up (<property>up to 4 charges</property>), or let a dispenser do the job with an Ender Pearl from afar
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.dinosaur_: <property>RMB</property> on a block sends <bone>shockwaves</bone> in a circle around you.
Nothing special - it is just <positive>extremely durable</positive>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.dragon_br:
A bow steeped in <magic>dragon's breath</magic>.

<property>RMB</property> on the bow with a <keyword>Splash Potion</keyword> to absorb its effect - your shots will carry it. The absorbed effects and the ammunition the bow uses are shown in its tooltip.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.earth_hea:
Raw <nature>energy of the earth</nature>, condensed in the rock over countless ages. By itself it does nothing, but it is the <keyword>core</keyword> of many relics.

Found in <property>dungeon and mineshaft chests</property> and other underground ruins, can be <aqua>fished up</aqua> as treasure, or assembled from <keyword>8 Fragments of the Earth</keyword>.

In the inventory of a cursed one it becomes <curse>tainted</curse> - that is how the <keyword>Twisted Heart</keyword> begins.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.earth_pro:
<nature>The earth keeps its promise.</nature>

When a single hit would take a <warning>large share of your health</warning>, the charm <positive>blocks it completely</positive> and goes on cooldown.

<curse>Relic:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> or the <named>Ring of Redemption</named> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.eldritch_:
<blood>The Testament of Contempt.</blood>

- Your <positive>inventory stays with you</positive> after death. Experience and Soul Crystals are still lost.
- Creatures under your <soul>gaze</soul> are slowed and weakened.
- Bonus attack damage and lifesteal.

With the <keyword>Proof of Dimness</keyword> worn: an <soul>Abyss Boost</soul> - more damage to creatures with less health than you.

<blood>For the Worthy:</blood> only those who have spent <magic>99.5%</magic> of their time under the Seven Curses can craft and use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.enchanted:
<warning>Can be found once per game by one player</warning>

<obfuscate mode=random interval=30>Can be found in chests in <keyword>End City</keyword></obfuscate>

<warning>Can be found only once per game by one player.</warning>

<obfuscate mode=random interval=30>You can find it in the same place as a regular <keyword>Nectar of Ichora</keyword><obfuscate></obfuscate></obfuscate>
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.enchanter:
The pearl of a reckless <magic>enchanter</magic>.

- <property>+1 charm slot</property>.
- The Enchanting Table gives <positive>more and stronger</positive> enchantments.
- Enchanting can produce <curse>curses</curse> and <keyword>treasure</keyword> enchantments.
- <keyword>Lapis Lazuli</keyword> is no longer needed.

<curse>For the cursed:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.enchantme:
Hold the tome and press <property>RMB</property> on any enchanted item in your inventory: <magic>all enchantments</magic> move into the tome, and it turns into an <keyword>Enchanted Book</keyword>.

The item is left clean - a good way to save enchantments from gear you no longer need.

Bought from <property>goblin traders</property> and the <property>Wandering Trader</property>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.ender_rin:
Open your <magic>Ender Chest</magic> from anywhere - through the inventory or with a key.

Bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> get this ability from the cursed ring itself.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.ender_rod:
An Eye of Ender bound with <magic>astral power</magic> into a sturdy rod.

The <property>handle and framework</property> for etherium tools, the Dragon Breath Bow, the Ethereal Forging Charm and several spellstones. Sometimes found in <property>End City chests</property>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.ender_sla:
<magic><typewriter speed=1.2>To exterminate them all... Is such the only way?</typewriter></magic>

- Bonus damage and knockback against <magic>dwellers of the End</magic>.
- In the End, fully charged hits deal <blood>colossal</blood> damage to Endermen, and their drops turn into experience.
- Temporarily blocks teleportation of <keyword>Endermen and Shulkers</keyword> it hits.
- Players you hit temporarily cannot use Ender Pearls, the Twisted Mirror and similar teleports.

<curse>For the cursed:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.enigmatic:
Starts off dormant - just an inert eye sitting in your inventory. Right-click it to wake it up (give it a moment, it needs to "open").

Once active, wear it in a Curios slot to gain <property>+1 charm slot</property>, letting you equip an extra trinket. Waking it up also unlocks the <magic><fade minAlpha=0.3 frequency=0.6>Narrator</fade></magic> - a mysterious voice that starts commenting on your journey: entering the Nether or the End, fighting the Wither or the Ender Dragon, dying, respawning, and other key moments.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.entity_wa: <property>RMB</property> <wiggle amplitude=0.5 frequency=1.0 phase=1.0>pulls</wiggle> every creature within <property>4 blocks</property> straight to you.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.ethereal_:
The <keyword>Forger's Gem</keyword> fused with etherium.

- Items in your inventory <positive>lose durability far more slowly</positive>.
- Forged results come out with <keyword>better stats</keyword>.

Click an <keyword>Astral Pearl</keyword> onto it to <magic>enhance</magic> it further.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.etherium_:
A <aqua>spellstone of etherium</aqua> - the only one that exists <property>solely by crafting</property> on the <keyword>Spellstone Table</keyword>.

- <named>Active:</named> grants <wind>Blessing of Starlight</wind> based on your <keyword>Etherium Threshold</keyword>: more damage, and health restored when it ends.
- Armor, toughness and knockback resistance; raises the Etherium Shield threshold.
- Part of the damage you take <flame>empowers your next attack</flame>.
- Immune to pressure, pricking and explosion damage.

Worn in the <property>spellstone slot</property>. The active ability is used with the <named>Spellstone Active Ability</named> key.

Take an <keyword>Astral Pearl</keyword> on your cursor and click it onto your <keyword>Etherium Core</keyword> - the core is <magic><pulse>enhanced</pulse></magic> for good.

The bonus of the enhanced core is shown in the <named>Enhancement</named> line of its tooltip.

Breaks blocks in a <property>large area</property> at once - perfect for tunnels and quarries.

With the <magic>Etheric Resonance</magic> enchantment it gains an <named>Enhancement</named>: deals area damage.

A full set of armor from <aqua>etherium</aqua>. It is <magic>invisible while worn</magic> - show off your look, keep the protection.

With the <magic>Etheric Resonance</magic> enchantment it gains an <named>Enhancement</named>: extra resistance when the <property>whole set</property> is worn.

A <aqua>light, unnaturally tough</aqua> metal. The ore hides in the end stone of the <property>outer End islands</property>, where End Cities stand.

Mining it gives <keyword>Raw Etherium</keyword> - smelt it in a <property>Blast Furnace</property> into an <keyword>ingot</keyword>. Ingots and nuggets also turn up in <property>End City chests</property>.

A scythe that clears plants and soft blocks in a <property>wide area</property>.

With the <magic>Etheric Resonance</magic> enchantment it gains an <named>Enhancement</named>: <nature>automatic area harvesting</nature>.

While held, gives a chance to <positive>avoid damage</positive> entirely.

With the <magic>Etheric Resonance</magic> enchantment it gains an <named>Enhancement</named>: <property>RMB</property> to parry.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.evil_esse: You can only obtain it by killing the <blood>Wither</blood> while under a <curse>curse</curse>!
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.evil_ingo: Netherite steeped in <blood>Nefarious Essence</blood>. Heavy, dark and very rare - it is needed for the <keyword>Arrogance of Chaos</keyword> and the <keyword>Decision of Annihilation</keyword>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.execution:
Has a chance to <blood>behead</blood> slain monsters and drop their <bone>heads</bone>.

Each level of <keyword>Looting</keyword> raises the chance further.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.explorer_: Briefly <magic><pulse>highlights treasures</pulse></magic> around you - chests and other valuables become easy to spot.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.extradime:
A one-way door for <soul>other creatures</soul>.

- <property>Shift + RMB</property> where you stand to bind the eye to that spot.
- <property>RMB</property> on a living creature to <magic>teleport it</magic> there.

<warning>Works only within the same dimension.</warning>
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.eye_cryst:
Insert an <keyword>Eye Crystal</keyword> into the <magic>Teleport Machine</magic> to summon <curse><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.2>The Obliterator</shake></curse>.

<glitch frequency=0.7 shiftChance=0.06>Your doom approaches.</glitch>

Drops <keyword>Portal Shards</keyword>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.eye_of_ne:
A <magic>spellstone of the void between stars</magic>.

- <named>Active:</named> teleports you <glitch frequency=0.5 shiftChance=0.05>behind</glitch> the creature you look at; your next hit after that deals bonus damage.
- More <magic>magic damage</magic> dealt, less received.
- A chance to teleport away from any attack; no damage from Ender Pearls.
- <warning>Weakness:</warning> in water you are vulnerable to <warning>any</warning> damage.

Worn in the <property>spellstone slot</property>. The active ability is used with the <named>Spellstone Active Ability</named> key.
Found in in <property>stronghold and End City chests</property>, or crafted on the <keyword>Spellstone Table</keyword>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.fabulous_:
<wind><wave>Free flight anywhere.</wave></wind>

The price is your experience, and it drains <warning>fast</warning>. Within range of an active <keyword>Beacon</keyword> the flight is <positive>completely free</positive>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.fiery_boo: Press the ability key (<property>X</property> by default) to leave a <fire>trail of fire</fire> behind you as you walk.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.fiery_jaw: <property>RMB</property> pushes away everything within <property>3 blocks</property>, and you start <flame>breathing fire</flame>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.forgotten:
An <aqua>ancient spellstone of frost</aqua>.

- <named>Active:</named> freezes nearby mobs and deals massive damage.
- Immunity to freezing and <aqua>Frost Walker</aqua>.
- Freezes melee attackers; frozen targets take more damage and barely move.
- Resistance to projectile and sonic damage.
- <warning>Weakness:</warning> fire damage.

Worn in the <property>spellstone slot</property>. The active ability is used with the <named>Spellstone Active Ability</named> key.
Found in in <property>igloos and ancient city ice boxes</property>, or crafted on the <keyword>Spellstone Table</keyword>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.frostbitt:
Blocking with this shield <aqua>freezes</aqua> the attacker for <property>3 seconds</property>.

<warning>The sword and the shield both need a Frozen Rune</warning> - one golem is not enough for both.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.gate_pear:
Before you attempt to conquer this <magic>Gateway</magic>, we strongly recommend that you prepare yourself, put on your <keyword>best armor</keyword>, equip your <keyword>best weapons</keyword>, upgrade them, and stock up on some <keyword>potions</keyword> - the battle will be <warning><shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>truly challenging</shake></warning>!

You’ll only get <warning><shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>three lives</shake></warning>, and you’ll have a <warning>limited amount of time</warning> to complete the level before the <magic>portal closes</magic> and you have to start over.

The <named>Gateway of Legends</named> calls forth the guardians of the Overworld and Nether lairs - <wave>one by one</wave>, each with its own retinue:

• <bone>Ancient Guardian</bone> with <keyword>Ambushers</keyword> and <keyword>Spiky Worms</keyword>
• <fire>Dune Sentinel</fire> with a <warning>Bomber</warning> and <keyword>Husks</keyword>
• <nature>Overgrown Colossus</nature>, alone
• <aqua>Frostbitten Golem</aqua> with <keyword>Stray</keyword> archers
• <nature>Warped Fungussus</nature>, alone
• <bone>Skeletosaurus</bone>, alone
• <flame>Lava Eater</flame>, alone
• <curse>Withered Abomination</curse> with <keyword>Wither Skeletons</keyword>

Every boss here is <warning>reinforced</warning> and drops <warning>no trophies</warning> - only the retinue keeps its usual loot. You get <warning><shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>three lives</shake></warning> and a <warning>limited time</warning> for each wave.

Clearing the gateway is one of the conditions to reach <magic><pulse>World Tier: Summit</pulse></magic>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.geburah.d:
<curse>Geburah</curse> - a divine construct and eternal judge who has become a <blood>malicious tyrant</blood>.

Throw the <keyword>Eye of Geburah</keyword> to find its arena, then <property>RMB</property> the boss spawner to start the trial. <warning>A ranged weapon is strongly recommended.</warning>

You can use the structure-finding ritual from the <click action=open_quest value='magic_step_ii/brazier'><u>Eidolon</u></click> mod or <click action=open_quest value='magic_step_i/ritual_locate_structure'><u>Ars Additions</u></click>.

Everyone on the arena becomes a <curse>Sinner</curse>. With every attack pattern Geburah declares new actions <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>sinful</shake> - jumping, standing still, killing, walking the wrong way around it. Watch the rules: <warning>too many sins mean instant death</warning>.

Drops the <keyword>Justice Core</keyword>, the <keyword>Divine Gear</keyword> - a turret that attacks <property>any</property> mob nearby - and a pile of <keyword>Polished Justicestone</keyword>. Finish it with a <property>wrench</property> for a <property>50%</property> chance at an <named>Electronic Ender Core</named>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.golden_ri:
Makes <fire>Piglins</fire> <positive>neutral</positive> towards you - no need to wear gold armor.

Also the base for the <keyword>Magic Quartz Ring</keyword> and several cursed relics.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.golem_hea:
A <bone>spellstone of stone and iron</bone>.

- Bonus armor - much more armor, toughness and explosion resistance if you wear <property>no armor at all</property>.
- Melee and knockback resistance; immune to pressure and pricking damage.
- <warning>Weakness:</warning> magic damage.

Worn in the <property>spellstone slot</property>. The active ability is used with the <named>Spellstone Active Ability</named> key.
Found in in <property>dungeons, mineshafts and village armorer chests</property>, or crafted on the <keyword>Spellstone Table</keyword>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.guard_sum:
A <soul>Corrupted Soul</soul> bound to a <keyword>Golden Halberd</keyword>. Summons a tamed <soul>Guard</soul> - slower than the knight, but <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>hits harder</shake> and in a wider arc.

If he falls, revive the summoner with an iron ingot.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.guardian_:
Drops from the <aqua>Elder Guardian</aqua> if you bear the <blood>Seven Curses</blood>.

- In the inventory: <aqua>Guardians</aqua> around you become neutral and attack other monsters.
- On the hotbar: look at a monster to <warning>enrage</warning> it - it grows stronger and attacks the nearest monster, while the others gang up on it. Some monsters are immune. Has a cooldown.

<curse>For the cursed:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.heaven_sc:
Lets you <wind><wave>fly</wave></wind> within the range of an active <keyword>Beacon</keyword>, slowly spending your experience.

Removes the mining speed penalty while flying. A <keyword>Ring of Starlight</keyword> makes you count as being near a beacon anywhere.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.hell_blad: Can be found once per game by one player
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.hunter_gu:
For those who fight alongside <keyword>pets</keyword>.

All damage your pets take within a certain radius of you is <warning>redirected onto you</warning> - they stay alive while you have health to spare.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.hunter_sc: The more monsters you have slain - and the <property>more kinds</property> of them - the more <positive>damage resistance</positive> the scroll gives.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.ichor_cur:
Found in <property>Nether fortress and bastion chests</property>. Drink it to receive <curse>Curse of Penance</curse> for 32 minutes.

While it lasts, a <fire>Nether</fire> monster you are about to kill may <warning>refuse to die</warning>: it rises with more health and <soul>Pure Resistance</soul>, and a <magic>Purified Ichor Spirit</magic> appears beside it to heal it.

Slay the spirit to claim a <keyword>Sacred Crystal</keyword>.

<curse>For the cursed:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.ichor_dro:
The so-called <named>blood of gods</named>. Your curse awakens faint traces of <magic>divinity</magic> in the tears of Ghasts.

Drops from <fire>Ghasts</fire> while you bear the <blood>Seven Curses</blood>, and is also found in <property>Nether fortress and bastion chests</property>.

Needed for the <keyword>Spellstone Table</keyword>, the <keyword>Pure Heart</keyword> and the <magic>sacred</magic> branch of relics.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.infernal_:
<flame>Ashes of hellfire</flame> that still seethe with wrath.

Drops from <fire>Blazes</fire> while you bear the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> and lies in <property>Nether fortress and bastion chests</property>.

Goes into fierce, <warning>extreme</warning> items - and gets along with curses <curse>remarkably well</curse>.

For fighters who rely on <flame>Blazing Might</flame>.

- When Blazing Might is removed, <positive>part of it stays</positive>.
- At <property>full health</property> you take less damage.

A shield that <flame>burns with pride</flame>.

- When worn: puts out fire on you.
- Blocks <property>the moment it is raised</property>, stops Piercing arrows and <positive>cannot be disabled</positive> by axes.
- Sets melee attackers on fire; every successful block stacks <flame>Blazing Might</flame>.
- <warning>Attacks from behind deal 50% more damage.</warning>

<curse>For the cursed:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> can use it.

A spear that feeds on <flame>Blazing Might</flame>.

- While held, raises the <property>maximum level</property> of Blazing Might.
- At the maximum level, press <property>RMB</property> to unleash a <fire>piercing strike</fire> - the effect is spent.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.infinimea:
<nature><wave>Infinite Bone Meal.</wave></nature> Never runs out.

Also works on plants that ordinary bone meal ignores: <nature>cactus, chorus, nether wart, sugar cane and vines</nature>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.iron_ring:
A plain ring. On its own it is just decoration, but it is the <keyword>base</keyword> for every ring in this branch: <keyword>Exquisite</keyword>, <keyword>Ender</keyword>, <keyword>Miner's</keyword> and <keyword>Quenching</keyword> rings, plus the <keyword>Heart of the Golem</keyword>.

Also found in <property>dungeons, mineshafts and strongholds</property>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.knight_su:
A <soul>Corrupted Soul</soul> bound to a <keyword>Knight's Sword</keyword>. <property>RMB</property> on a block summons a tamed <soul>Knight</soul> - fast combos, and he <positive>blocks attacks</positive>.

If he falls, revive the summoner with an iron ingot.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.lost_engi:
A <property>spellstone of a forgotten machine</property>.

- Better mobility and toughness, extra critical damage.
- Item cooldowns are <positive>25% shorter</positive>.
- Immune to fall and explosion damage; <keyword>golems</keyword> ignore you.
- <warning>Weakness:</warning> magic damage, and <warning><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.5>lightning is fatal</shake></warning>.

Worn in the <property>spellstone slot</property>. The active ability is used with the <named>Spellstone Active Ability</named> key.
Found in in <property>stronghold and dungeon chests</property>, or crafted on the <keyword>Spellstone Table</keyword>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.majestic_:
Hold <property>jump</property> while flying to <wind><wave>keep accelerating forward</wave></wind> - no fireworks needed.

<warning>Accelerating wears the elytra out faster.</warning>
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.malkuth.d:
<named>Malkuth</named> - the Qliphoth of a benevolent king, whose blind generosity became his kingdom's demise. <curse>Consumed by rage, betrayed by life.</curse>

Throw the <keyword>Eye of Malkuth</keyword> to find his arena, then <property>RMB</property> the boss spawner to start the duel.

You can use the structure-finding ritual from the <click action=open_quest value='magic_step_ii/brazier'><u>Eidolon</u></click> mod or <click action=open_quest value='magic_step_i/ritual_locate_structure'><u>Ars Additions</u></click>.

His <keyword>Divine Armor</keyword> <warning>ignores any direct damage</warning>. Use the <keyword>cannons</keyword> on your side of the arena - but only the cannon of the element you are currently <fire>weak to</fire>: <fire>Fire</fire> or <aqua>Ice</aqua>. Protect them - in the second phase he will try to <shake amplitude=0.35 frequency=1.2>break your cannons</shake>.

Drops the <keyword>Fire and Ice Core</keyword> and the <keyword>Emberfrost Gauntlet</keyword> - a grappling hook that crashes down with Malkuth's strike. Finish him with a <property>wrench</property> for a <property>50%</property> chance at an <named>Electronic Ender Core</named>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.mending_m:
<property>RMB</property> with the mixture on any tool, weapon or armor piece to restore its durability <positive>completely</positive>.

Found in <property>End City chests</property> and sometimes <aqua>fished up</aqua> as treasure.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.miner_rin:
A <flame>pocket blast furnace</flame> on your finger.

- Blocks you mine drop <property>already smelted</property>.
- Hold <property>Shift</property> to smelt dropped items lying nearby.

Smelting uses the ring's <keyword>fuel bar</keyword>. It refills slowly on its own, or <property>RMB</property> on the ring with fuel to top it up.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.mining_ch:
A charm for those who dig deep.

Gives <wind>Night Vision</wind> while you are <property>underground</property>. Hold it and press <property>RMB</property> to turn night vision on or off.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.monster_c:
- Slain monsters drop <positive>twice as much experience</positive>.
- Bonus damage against the <bone>undead</bone>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.monstrous:
Hold <property>RMB</property> for <property>1.5 seconds</property> to <bounce amplitude=1.5 frequency=1.2 phase=1.0>leap into the air</bounce> and <warning>stun</warning> everything within <property>4 blocks</property> for <property>3 seconds</property>.

Every hit also deals <property>4 damage</property> to all enemies within <property>3 blocks</property>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.mossy_che: Press the ability key (<property>R</property> by default) to release <poison>poison clouds</poison> around you - they hurt mobs and <positive>heal you</positive>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.mossy_ham:
<property>RMB</property> on a block deals <property>10 damage</property> and <poison>poison</poison> to everything within <property>4 blocks</property>. With <keyword>bone meal</keyword> in your inventory, <nature>moss</nature> grows under every enemy hit.

Also works as a <positive>pickaxe</positive>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.night_scr:
<soul>The night belongs to you.</soul>

- <keyword>Phantoms</keyword> no longer spawn near you - even though you never sleep.
- Bonus attack damage, damage resistance and lifesteal that depend on the <property>light level</property> around you.

<curse>For the cursed:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.ocean_sto:
An <aqua>ocean spellstone</aqua>.

- <named>Active:</named> summons a <aqua>thunderstorm</aqua> at a large cost of experience.
- No need for air underwater, Night Vision and Aqua Affinity in water, no gravity and fast swimming.
- Resistance to underwater creatures.
- <warning>Weakness:</warning> fire damage.

Worn in the <property>spellstone slot</property>. The active ability is used with the <named>Spellstone Active Ability</named> key.
Found in in <property>shipwreck and buried treasure chests and big underwater ruins</property>, or crafted on the <keyword>Spellstone Table</keyword>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.ode_to_li:
Both guides in one, plus <positive>less redirected damage</positive>.

- Animals are protected from you, and damage to your pets is shared with you.
- <property>Attack</property> an animal with the book to lift its protection for that kind of animal - neutral animals around will turn on it.
- <property>Use</property> the book to calm the animals and restore protection.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.pure_hear:
The bright twin of the <keyword>Twisted Heart</keyword>: hidden corruption mixed with the faint <magic>divinity</magic> of <keyword>Ichor</keyword>.

Items made from it usually <positive>protect and support</positive> rather than destroy - but they still lean on the power of the curse.

The heart in the recipe must be <property>tainted</property>: it becomes tainted on its own in the inventory of a cursed one.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.q0cc9329a:
Find your first §l§6affix item§r!§r

Once you've completed this task, you'll be able to claim your reward: a <keyword>new button in the radial menu</keyword>!
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.q1905ed45: <wind>Cumulonimbus</wind>, the cloud golem, rules the <named>Cloudy Temple</named> on mountain peaks and meadows. Find it with the <keyword>Eye of Air</keyword> and deal with the four <keyword>Hovering Hurricanes</keyword> around it first.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.q3d7c097e:
The <magic>Chorusent</magic> - a giant of the End that <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.2>smashes the ground</shake> beneath its feet.

Drops a <keyword>Chorus Crystal</keyword>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.q46c168fc: Three <curse>Annihilation Pursuers</curse> guard the heart of the station. Each one drops an <keyword>Eye Crystal</keyword> - the key to the final boss.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.q587fcbe4:
The <magic>Shulker Mimic</magic> loves to send its victims <wave>floating into the air</wave>.

Drops a <keyword>Large Shulker Shell</keyword>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.quartz_ri:
Reduces <magic>magic damage</magic> you receive.

The base for the <keyword>Forger's Gem</keyword>, the <keyword>Ring of Starlight</keyword> and the <keyword>Angel's Blessing</keyword>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.redemptio:
<named>How to get it:</named>

1. Craft an <keyword>Unholy Stone</keyword>, then turn it into a <keyword>Holy Stone</keyword> with <magic>Sacred Crystals</magic>, a <keyword>Pure Heart</keyword> and <keyword>Ichor Droplets</keyword>.
2. Wear the <blood>Ring of the Seven Curses</blood> and hold the Holy Stone <property>in your hand</property>.
3. <warning>Die</warning> while holding it. The stone is spent, <aqua>lightning</aqua> strikes, and the cursed ring turns into the <named>Ring of Redemption</named> right in its slot.

In <warning>Hardcore</warning> you do not have to die - press <property>RMB</property> with the stone instead.

<warning>This cannot be undone.</warning> The ring's strength depends on how long you endured the curse, so do not rush.

<named><typewriter speed=1.2>A certification of your past...</typewriter></named>

The curses are gone, but the blessings of those who endured them <positive>remain</positive>:

- changed incoming and outgoing damage;
- constant <positive>Regeneration</positive>;
- bonus <keyword>Looting</keyword> and <keyword>Fortune</keyword>;
- unique drops from some creatures;
- you can still create and use <magic>unique relics</magic>.

The exact numbers are in the tooltip - they depend on how long you endured the curse.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.revival_l:
A <nature>spellstone of living growth</nature>.

- <named>Active:</named> regeneration for creatures around you, at a cost of experience.
- Slow natural regeneration; immune to Hunger, Poison and Withering.
- Your targets are <poison>poisoned</poison> and heal less.
- Crops around you grow faster; you can <nature>fly</nature> among plants.
- <warning>Weakness:</warning> fire and projectile damage.

Worn in the <property>spellstone slot</property>. The active ability is used with the <named>Spellstone Active Ability</named> key.
Found in in <property>jungle temples</property>, or crafted on the <keyword>Spellstone Table</keyword>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.sacred_cr:
The core of a <magic>Purified Ichor Spirit</magic>. To meet one, drink a <keyword>Bottle of Penance</keyword> and hunt in the <fire>Nether</fire>.

Pure and sacred, yet your curse does not reject it. It inherits the spirit's strange <positive>resistance and healing</positive>, so it goes into <property>defensive</property> relics - and into the <named>Holy Stone</named> that can <wave>reverse the curse itself</wave>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.sand_cann:
Hold the use button for <property>1.5 seconds</property> to fire an <warning>exploding sandstone bomb</warning>.

Keep it - it is needed later for the <magic>Chorus Cannon</magic>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.sanguinar:
The <keyword>Guide to Feral Hunt</keyword>, written in blood.

- Your <keyword>pets</keyword> deal more damage.
- If you wear the <blood>Emblem of Bloodstained Valor</blood> or the <curse>Scroll of a Thousand Curses</curse>, your pets get <positive>matching bonuses</positive> based on your own.

<curse>For the cursed:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.scorched_:
The <flame>Blazing Core</flame>, purified by sacred power.

- Immunity to <fire>fire damage</fire> and you can <flame>walk on lava</flame>.
- Natural regeneration while touching lava.
- <positive>Lifesteal</positive> against burning targets.
- A chance to resist attack damage.

<curse>Relic:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> or the <named>Ring of Redemption</named> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.shulker_h: Protects you from <magic>Levitation</magic> - no more long falls after a shulker hit.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.shulker_s: Blocking has a <property>60%</property> chance to give the attacker <magic>Levitation</magic>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.shulker_t:
Four <keyword>end stone</keyword> blocks make the <named>Eye of Shulker</named>. It finds the <named>Shulker Tower</named> in the <magic>End Highlands</magic> and <magic>Midlands</magic>.

The boss sleeps disguised as a <wiggly>shulker box</wiggly> - be careful what you open.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.skeletosa: Place the egg and wait - a <bone>Skeloraptor</bone> will hatch from it. It is a <positive>mount</positive>: press <property>R</property> to <shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=1.6>roar</shake> and scare away mobs.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.somber_ke:
Combine the ring and the blade into the <keyword>Somber Key</keyword>.

<property>RMB</property> in the middle of the <soul>Somber Trapdoor</soul> to break its lock. <warning>The Paladin waits below.</warning>

The <blood>Possessed Paladin</blood> - the last defender of the fallen kingdom, <glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.05>no longer in control of himself</glitch>.

Drops the <keyword>Soul Great Sword</keyword> and a <soul>Corrupted Soul</soul>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.soul_comp:
A compass for the <soul>torn soul</soul>.

When you die under the Seven Curses, a piece of your soul is left behind as a <soul>Soul Crystal</soul>, and your maximum health drops. The compass points to the <property>nearest lost crystal</property> - walk up to it to take that piece back.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.soul_grea:
<property>RMB</property> to <soul>parry</soul> around you: deals weapon damage plus <property>30%</property> of the reflected damage and <positive>heals you</positive> for <property>20%</property> of your max health. Cannot parry damage that ignores armor.

<property>Shift + hold RMB</property> for <property>1 second</property> while looking at a creature within <property>10 blocks</property> to release <soul>homing phantom daggers</soul>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.space_sta:
An <keyword>Eye of Ender</keyword> surrounded by four <magic>Enderitium Gems</magic> makes the <named>Eye of Annihilation</named>. It leads to the <glitch frequency=0.7 shiftChance=0.06>Space Station</glitch> on the outer islands.

<warning>This is the hardest place in the mod.</warning> Come prepared.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.spellcore:
The <magic><pulse>living core</pulse></magic> of spellstone magic.

Lies in the same chests as <keyword>spellstones</keyword>, and in the treasure of <property>spellstone huts</property>.

Needed to build the <keyword>Spellstone Table</keyword>, the <keyword>Spelltuner</keyword> and the <keyword>Resonator of Spell</keyword>, and to raise the Resonator's resonance level.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.spellston:
A blade made from a <keyword>Spellcore</keyword> and <keyword>Spellstone Debris</keyword> that can borrow the power of any <magic>spellstone</magic>.

Hold a spellstone in your <property>off hand</property> and press <property>RMB</property> with the sword to make it <wave>resonate</wave> with that stone. Each stone gives the blade its own three effects.

A blade that can <magic><wave>resonate</wave></magic> with any <keyword>spellstone</keyword> and borrow its power.

<named>How:</named> hold a spellstone in your <property>off hand</property> and press <property>RMB</property> with the sword - it takes on that stone's resonance. Every spellstone gives its own set of <positive>three effects</positive>: fire and explosions, riptide in water, freezing, poison and healing, chain blade, swapping places and more. The current set is shown in the tooltip.

Hold a <soul>Spellcore</soul> and press <property>RMB</property> on the sword to raise its <pulse>resonance level</pulse>.

The workbench of <magic>spellstones</magic>. Put <property>seven ingredients</property> and the required amount of <keyword>Spellstone Debris</keyword> into it to create a spellstone.

Every spellstone except the <keyword>Etherium Core</keyword> can also be found in chests - the table lets you make the ones that luck refuses to give.

Debris lies in the same chests as spellstones and in <property>spellstone huts</property>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.spelltune:
Hold it and press <property>RMB</property> on a spellstone in your inventory to <magic>tune</magic> the Spelltuner to that stone - the tooltip shows what the tuning gives.

While carried, it also <positive>shortens spellstone cooldowns</positive> and raises the chance to <keyword>discover spellstones</keyword> in chests.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.spiky_shi:
A shield that bites back: while blocking it has a <property>50%</property> chance to <blood>reflect damage</blood> to the attacker.

Needs an <keyword>Ancient Spike</keyword> from the <keyword>Spiky Worm</keyword>, a <keyword>Chiseled Ancient Dripstone Shard</keyword> from the <keyword>Ambusher</keyword> and a <keyword>Molten Metal Ingot</keyword> - smelt an <keyword>Anchor Handle</keyword> to get it. <warning>The anchor needs a handle too</warning>, so you will have to beat the guardian twice.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.starlight:
The <keyword>Starlight Bucket</keyword> is a universal bucket. <positive>Right-click</positive> it onto any other bucket in your inventory to copy that fluid into it, then use it exactly like the original bucket to place that content.

<warning>Works only with buckets that have the #c:buckets tag</warning>

<keyword>Etherium</keyword> soaked in <wind>starlight</wind>. The metal of the finest <magic>astral</magic> relics - the Amulet of Ascension, the Architect's Favor, the Astral Pearl and the Ring of Starlight.

<wind>Starlight Meteors</wind> sometimes fall from the sky in the <property>End</property>, away from the main island. Find where one landed and collect the <keyword>Particles of Starlight</keyword> it leaves behind.

A <keyword>Ring of Starlight</keyword> makes meteors fall more often.

Take the pearl on your cursor and <property>click it onto</property> an <keyword>Etherium Core</keyword> or an <keyword>Ethereal Forging Charm</keyword> in your inventory - the item is <magic><pulse>enhanced</pulse></magic> for good and the pearl is consumed.

An enhanced item shows its bonus in the <named>Enhancement</named> line of the tooltip.

- <wind>Starlight Meteors</wind> fall more often around you.
- You count as being <magic>within Beacon range</magic> wherever you are - great together with the <keyword>Gift of the Heaven</keyword> and <keyword>Grace of the Creator</keyword>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.survivor_:
- Slowly restores health in <keyword>bright light</keyword>.
- At <warning>low health</warning>: better stats and faster eating.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.the_bless:
<named><typewriter speed=1.2>In the endless journey of suffering, use this to light up the way forward.</typewriter></named>

- Strips beneficial effects from targets and may inflict <warning>Ichor Corrosion</warning> - lower defense, more damage taken.
- More damage to burning targets.
- Puts out fire on you and extends your invincibility after taking a hit.

<curse>Relic:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> or the <named>Ring of Redemption</named> can use it.
<glitch frequency=0.5 shiftChance=0.06>A shape that should not exist.</glitch> The power of <magic>all spellstones</magic> forced into one.

Crafted on the <keyword>Spellstone Table</keyword> from a <keyword>Heart of the Cosmos</keyword>, <property>six different spellstones</property> and 24 Spellstone Debris.

- <named>Active:</named> teleports you to a random place in one of the three main dimensions.
- Big bonuses to speed, mining, attack speed, Fortune and Luck.
- Immune to negative effects, falls, fire, lava and more; very strong hits are <positive>negated</positive> entirely.
- Deflects attacks and curses melee attackers with random debuffs.
- Lethal damage leaves you at <warning>1 health</warning>; at 1 health the active ability tries to save you instead.

Worn in the <property>spellstone slot</property>. The active ability is used with the <named>Spellstone Active Ability</named> key.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.the_end.d:
The End Access
Collect §l12 unique eyes§r to activate the portal.§r
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.the_great: <property>RMB</property> summons a row of <aqua>ice spikes</aqua> in front of you, and <property>Shift + RMB</property> on a block surrounds you with them.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.the_infin:
<glitch frequency=0.6 shiftChance=0.06>The abyss returns even the boldest gaze.</glitch>

- Extra knockback and lifesteal; accepts most sword enchantments.
- Every hit inflicts <poison>horrific debuffs</poison>.
- While held, a chance that lethal damage <positive>won't kill you</positive>.
- Weakens the effect of the <curse>Fourth Curse</curse>.

With the <keyword>Proof of Dimness</keyword> worn: an <soul>Abyss Boost</soul> - bonus damage for every harmful effect on the target.

<blood>For the Worthy:</blood> only those who have spent <magic>99.5%</magic> of their time under the Seven Curses can craft and use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.the_tesse: Hold <property>RMB</property> for <property>1.5 seconds</property> to open <magic>annihilation portals</magic> in a star pattern. While they open, their <wave>gravity pulls</wave> in nearby creatures.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.the_twist:
<curse><typewriter speed=1.2>On a path to take it all away...</typewriter></curse>

A blade for those who hunt the strongest: bonus damage against <blood>bosses and players</blood> and extra knockback.

<curse>For the cursed:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.thunder_s:
<aqua><shake amplitude=0.4 frequency=2.0>The storm answers.</shake></aqua>

- Immunity to <aqua>lightning</aqua>.
- Sweeping attacks deal <positive>full damage</positive>.
- After enough hits, the target is struck by <aqua>lightning</aqua>.
- More damage to armored targets.

<curse>Relic:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> or the <named>Ring of Redemption</named> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.totem_of_: If you combine it with the <curse><shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.0>evil essence</shake></curse> on the anvil, it will yield charges for the <named>Totem of Undying</named>

<property>RMB</property> on a block summons a tamed <nature>Mossy Golem</nature>. It fights by your side and <positive>speeds up crop growth</positive> nearby.

If it dies, the totem can summon it again. <property>Shift + RMB</property> on the golem makes it stand still.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.twisted_h:
A <keyword>Heart of the Earth</keyword> corrupted by the power of your curses. The base of almost every <curse>cursed relic</curse>: scrolls, emblems, the shield, the mirror and much more.

The heart in the recipe must be <property>tainted</property>: it becomes tainted on its own in the inventory of a cursed one.

<wiggle amplitude=0.4 frequency=0.4>There is no way back - only ahead.</wiggle>
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.twisted_m:
Gaze into the mirror to <magic><wave>return home</wave></magic>: to your bed or Respawn Anchor, or to the center of the Overworld if you have neither.

Unlike the concoction, the mirror is <positive>reusable</positive>.

<curse>For the cursed:</curse> only bearers of the <blood>Seven Curses</blood> can use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.violence_:
<blood>An accursed being is rarely worth making an enemy of.</blood>

- Shorter invincibility of your targets after a hit - <warning>faster combos</warning>.
- In combat you constantly gain <curse>Curse of Mania</curse>.
- <property>RMB</property> with the scroll on other items in your inventory to <curse>absorb their curse enchantments</curse>. Each unique curse absorbed improves attack speed, reach and knockback resistance.

With the <keyword>Proof of Dimness</keyword> worn: an <soul>Abyss Boost</soul> - a brief damage immunity after each of your attacks.

<blood>For the Worthy:</blood> only those who have spent <magic>99.5%</magic> of their time under the Seven Curses can craft and use it.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.void_enti:
Surround the warper with eight <magic>Infected Chorus Fruits</magic> from the End's <keyword>Choruslings</keyword>.

Now you <property>choose</property> which creature within <property>6 blocks</property> gets teleported to you.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.void_pear:
A <soul>spellstone of the void</soul>.

- You no longer need air; <positive>immune to all status effects</positive>.
- Your attacks inflict <warning>Withering</warning>.
- Creatures near you standing <soul>in darkness</soul> take massive damage and heavy debuffs.
- A chance that lethal damage won't kill you.

Worn in the <property>spellstone slot</property>. The active ability is used with the <named>Spellstone Active Ability</named> key.
Found in in <property>End City chests</property>, or crafted on the <keyword>Spellstone Table</keyword>.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.void_tome: <warning>Can be found once per game by one player</warning>
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.wand_of_c: <property>RMB</property> on a creature summons one big <wind>explosive cloud</wind> for <property>14 damage</property> and three small ones for <property>5 damage</property> each above your enemies.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.withered_: A chestplate made of the abomination's ribs. It protects you from <curse>Wither</curse> and inflicts it on anyone who hurts you.
Hold <property>RMB</property> to <shake amplitude=0.3 frequency=1.2>dash forward</shake>, cutting through everything in your way.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.wormhole_:
A potion that leads to <magic>a person</magic>, not a place.

The first player to hold it becomes its <keyword>target</keyword>. Whoever drinks it later is <wave>teleported to that player</wave>.

Brewed in a <property>Mixing Cauldron</property>, two at a time.
milf.quest.when_dungeons_arise.xp_scroll:
A <magic>bottomless store</magic> of experience.

- <property>Shift + RMB</property> - turn it on or off. <property>RMB</property> - switch modes (there is also a keybind).
- <keyword>Absorption</keyword>: takes your experience into the scroll while it is in the scroll slot.
- <keyword>Extraction</keyword>: gives the stored experience back.

While active, it also <positive>pulls in experience orbs</positive> from around you.
